attributes.description: In-care-of name for mail delivery when correspondence is directed through a third party (e.g., attorney, trustee, mortgagee). Common for additional insured notices.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau census tract code for the address. Used for demographic risk analysis, CRA compliance, and actuarial territory segmentation in pricing models.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name of the address. Used for territory rating, catastrophe aggregation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: coastal_indicator
attributes.description: Flags whether the address is within a defined coastal zone subject to enhanced windstorm, storm surge, or tidal flood exposure. Used in underwriting eligibility screening.
attributes.references: ISO Catastrophe Modeling; State DOI Coastal Zone Regulations

attributes.name: congressional_district
attributes.description: US Congressional district code for the address. Used for regulatory reporting, legislative tracking, and state DOI jurisdictional filings.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, CAN). Required for international policies, reinsurance bordereaux, and IFRS 17 reporting.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name for the address. Used for territory rating, surplus lines stamping, local tax jurisdiction, and catastrophe exposure aggregation.
attributes.references: ISO Territory Rating; NAIC Annual Statement; Surplus Lines Stamping Offices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX/MAR compliance for record creation tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); GLBA

attributes.name: distance_to_coast_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the location to the nearest coastline; used in wind and storm surge rating.
attributes.references: ISO Windstorm Rating; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_station_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the address to the nearest responding fire station. Used in ISO PPC determination and property rating for rural or semi-rural locations.
attributes.references: ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC); ISO ERC

attributes.name: do_not_mail_indicator
attributes.description: Suppresses physical mail delivery to this address per party preference or returned mail. Compliance with GLBA and state DOI notice delivery requirements.
attributes.references: GLBA; State DOI Notice Requirements; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation_code
attributes.description: USPS DPV result: Y=confirmed deliverable, S=primary match only, D=default match, N=not confirmed. Validates address deliverability for policy documents and billing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid for the party. Supports point-in-time reconstruction of the address in force at policy inception or loss date.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws; SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this address record ceases to be valid. Null indicates currently active. Enables historical address reconstruction for claims and regulatory audits.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Laws; SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS county code (2-digit state + 3-digit county). Used for catastrophe modeling, PML aggregation, and regulatory geographic reporting.
attributes.references: FIPS PUB 6-4; NAIC; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: fire_protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC) code (1-10) for the address. Directly impacts property insurance rating; class 1 is best, 10 is unprotected.
attributes.references: ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC); ISO ERC

attributes.name: geocode_quality
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates. Rooftop is highest precision; zip_centroid is lowest. Drives confidence weighting in catastrophe PML and AAL models.
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone; ISO Catastrophe Modeling

attributes.name: geocode_source
attributes.description: Name of the geocoding service or vendor that produced the latitude/longitude (e.g., Google Maps API, HERE, TomTom, ESRI). Supports data lineage and quality audits.

attributes.name: iso_territory_code
attributes.description: ISO-assigned rating territory code for this address. Used by the rating engine to apply territory-specific loss costs and rate factors per ISO circulars.
attributes.references: ISO Rating Territory Definitions; ISO ERC/Earnix

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables precise catastrophe hazard scoring, PML modeling, and territory assignment for insured locations.
attributes.references: WGS84; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone; ISO Catastrophe Modeling

attributes.name: line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. Used for mail delivery, risk location identification, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; ACORD Data Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, unit, floor, or building designator. Supplements address_line1 for complete delivery address.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Paired with latitude for precise catastrophe hazard scoring and exposure aggregation.
attributes.references: WGS84; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone; ISO Catastrophe Modeling

attributes.name: po_box
attributes.description: Post Office box number when the mailing address is a PO Box rather than a street address. Used for billing and correspondence when party does not receive street delivery.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Non-US postal code for international addresses (e.g., Canadian postal code, UK postcode). Distinct from zip_code which is US-specific. Used for international risk rating.

attributes.name: primary_indicator
attributes.description: Flags this as the primary address for the party when multiple addresses of the same type exist. Exactly one address per party per type should be primary at any time.

attributes.name: province
attributes.description: Province or region name for non-US addresses (e.g., Canadian provinces, Mexican states). Required for international policies and IFRS 17 geographic segmentation.

attributes.name: seasonal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the address is a seasonal or secondary residence (e.g., vacation home). Relevant for homeowners underwriting, vacancy conditions, and occupancy rating.

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: Native address identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Guidewire internal ID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse and the system of record.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (USPS abbreviation). Drives regulatory jurisdiction, rate filings, DOI compliance, and statutory reporting by state.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; NAIC State Reporting; DOI

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York). Used for loss date/time determination, FNOL timestamping, and notice deadline calculations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this address record. Used for change data capture, MDM deduplication refresh, and audit trail in the party data domain.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); Customer/Party MDM

attributes.name: usps_standardized_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been validated and standardized against the USPS Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS). Ensures deliverability and geocoding accuracy.

attributes.name: wind_pool_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address falls within a state wind pool or FAIR plan territory (e.g., Texas Windstorm, Florida Citizens). Affects coverage eligibility and reinsurance.
attributes.references: State DOI Wind Pool Regulations; ISO Catastrophe Modeling

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit US ZIP code for the address. Used for territory rating, catastrophe zone assignment, and USPS mail delivery routing.

attributes.name: zip_plus4
attributes.description: Four-digit ZIP+4 extension providing carrier route precision for USPS delivery. Enhances geocoding accuracy for catastrophe modeling and territory rating.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

domains.name: policy
domains.description: Authoritative record of the insurance contract lifecycle. Owns Policy (one row per policy), Policy Term (one row per policy per term), and Policy Transaction (NB, REN, END, CAN, RI, NR).
domains.references: ACORD Policy Model / ISO Policy Forms

products.name: policy
products.description: Policy: one row per policy. The master policy record representing the insurance contract between the insurer and the policyholder. Grain: one row per policy.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the policy. Primary key. One row per policy.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: P&C underwriting, territory rating, state regulatory filing, and cat exposure aggregation all require the specific rated/mailing address on the policy (e.g., garaging address for auto, property

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Policy issuance, agency portfolio aggregation, and producer compensation reporting require a direct policy-to-agency FK. The denormalized agency_code on policy is replaced by a proper FK.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Underwriters assign policies to catastrophe zones for PML accumulation management, reinsurance treaty attachment monitoring, and regulatory cat exposure reporting.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Commission schedule governs the rate applied at policy binding. Audit of commission rates, commission dispute resolution, and new-business commission calculation all require

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Policies issued in multiple currencies require currency master reference for FX conversion, financial consolidation, and multi-currency premium reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.distribution_channel. Business justification: Channel performance reporting, commission schedule selection, and regulatory channel-based filings require a proper FK from policy to distribution_channel.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Policy.type (STRING) currently stores policy type codes inline. Normalizing to policy_type reference table eliminates redundancy and enables centralized management of policy type

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Insured/policyholder party FK linking Party to Policy. Establishes the Party -> Policy lineage required by VREQ-015. One row per policy; party_id identifies the primary insured or policyholder on the policy record.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Producer-of-record at policy inception is required for licensing compliance, commission entitlement, and regulatory producer reporting.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the policy is set to automatically renew at expiration. True if auto-renew enabled.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, Renewal Processing Standards

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which premium is billed: direct bill, agency bill, list bill, or account current.

attributes.name: binding_date
attributes.description: Date the policy was bound and coverage became contractually obligated.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date the policy was cancelled, if applicable. Null if policy has not been cancelled.
attributes.references: State DOI Cancellation Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason for policy cancellation: non-payment, insured request, underwriting decision, fraud, material change, or non-renewal.
attributes.references: State DOI Cancellation Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the insurance carrier or legal entity issuing the policy.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Codes, State DOI Licensing

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage paid to the producer on this policy. Expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the policy record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Audit Trail Standards, Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current policy version or transaction is in force. Used for effective dating and loss date reconstruction.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the policy contract expires or is scheduled to expire. End of the current term.

attributes.name: facultative_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether facultative reinsurance was placed for this policy. True if facultative coverage exists.

attributes.name: form_code
attributes.description: ISO or proprietary form code identifying the base policy contract form.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date the policy contract first becomes effective. Start of the initial term.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the policy documents were issued to the policyholder.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the policy record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: Audit Trail Standards, Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Line of business classification: HO (Homeowners), PAP (Personal Auto), CGL (Commercial General Liability), CPP (Commercial Package), BOP (Business Owners), CA (Commercial Auto), WC (Workers Comp), EPLI, D&O, E&O.
attributes.references: NAIC Code Classification, ISO LOB Standards

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the legal entity issuing the policy.

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: non_renewal_notice_date
attributes.description: Date non-renewal notice was sent to the policyholder, if applicable. Null if policy is renewing.
attributes.references: State DOI Non-Renewal Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: non_renewal_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason for non-renewal: underwriting decision, loss history, non-payment, program exit, or regulatory requirement.
attributes.references: State DOI Non-Renewal Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique policy number assigned at issuance. Business identifier for the contract.

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Premium payment plan selected by the policyholder: full pay, monthly, quarterly, or semi-annual.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy contract. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|quoted|bound|in_force|cancelled|expired|non_renewed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: prior_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the prior term if this is a renewal or rewrite. Null for new business.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Internal program or product line identifier under which the policy is written.

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date the initial quote was generated for this policy.

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the reinsurance treaty under which this policy is ceded, if applicable.

attributes.name: renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this policy is a renewal of a prior term. True if renewal, false if new business.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score assigned by underwriting or rating engine. Higher score indicates higher risk.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the policy is domiciled and regulated.
attributes.references: NAIC State Codes, ISO Territory Codes

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the risk submission was received for underwriting evaluation.

attributes.name: term_months
attributes.description: Length of the policy term in months. Typically 12 for annual policies, 6 for semi-annual.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Rating territory code used for pricing and regulatory reporting. State-specific territory classification.
attributes.references: ISO Territory Codes, State DOI Rating Standards

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: Total insured value across all coverages and insured risks on the policy. Sum of all limits.

attributes.name: underwriting_tier
attributes.description: Risk tier assigned during underwriting: preferred, standard, non-standard, or declined.

attributes.name: written_premium_amount
attributes.description: DEPRECATED — do not use for reporting. Premium must be aggregated from premium.premium_transaction. Retained for legacy source-system compatibility only.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

products.name: term
products.description: Policy Term: one row per policy per term. A time-bounded period within a policy lifecycle (e.g., annual term, renewal term) with effective and expiration dates. Grain: one row per policy per term.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy term. Primary key. One row per policy per term.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the agency representing the producer. Used for agency-level commission and reporting.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Policy terms must map to accounting periods for premium earning calculations, reserve valuations, and GAAP/SAP financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: cat_model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_model_version. Business justification: State regulatory filings and internal audit require tracking which catastrophe model version was used to price each policy term.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Policy terms track written premium in transaction currency—FK to currency master required for FX conversion to functional currency, multi-currency financial reporting, and consolidation.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.distribution_channel. Business justification: Term-level channel tracking supports renewal channel migration analysis, commission schedule resolution per term, and channel-based retention reporting.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Policy terms require geography linkage for underwriting territory assignment, rate filing compliance by jurisdiction, exposure aggregation for catastrophe modeling, and

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Term.product_code and product_name currently store policy type information redundantly at the term level.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the underwriter who approved this term. Links to party role for underwriter.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the parent policy. Links this term to the overarching policy lifecycle.

attributes.name: prior_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the immediately preceding term. Null for new business, populated for renewals.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the producer who sold this term. Links to producer for commission calculation.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Each policy term (including renewal terms) originates from a specific quote. Renewal quote-to-bind conversion reporting and term-level written premium reconciliation against quoted premium

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Accident year for loss reserving and IBNR calculation. Derived from term effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: Date when the term was recorded in the accounting system. Used for financial reporting cutoffs.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: Method by which premium is billed and collected. Determines billing workflow and commission settlement.

attributes.name: bound_date
attributes.description: Date when the term was bound and coverage became contractually effective.

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for statutory and financial reporting. Derived from term effective date.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the term was cancelled. Null if term was not cancelled. Used for earned premium calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for term cancellation. Examples: non-payment, insured request, underwriting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: cancellation_type
attributes.description: Type of cancellation determining premium return calculation. Flat, short-rate, or pro-rata.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this term record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days between term effective and expiration dates. Typically 365 for annual policies.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this policy term becomes effective and coverage begins.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, ACORD Standards, SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this policy term expires and coverage ends. Nullable for open-ended terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, ACORD Standards, SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Original inception date of the first term of the policy. Carried forward across all renewals.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: is_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term is a renewal of a prior term. False for new business, true for renewals.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: issued_date
attributes.description: Date when the policy documents for this term were issued to the insured.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this term record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The insurance line of business for this term. Determines product type and regulatory treatment.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, ISO Forms

attributes.name: non_renewal_notice_date
attributes.description: Date when non-renewal notice was sent to the insured. Required by state law for non-renewals.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: non_renewal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for non-renewal. Must comply with state-specific non-renewal regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Sequential term number within the policy lifecycle. First term is 1, increments with each renewal.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the premium payment plan. Examples: annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy year for actuarial and loss reserving analysis. Derived from term effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the rate table used to price this term. Required for regulatory rate filings.
attributes.references: Rating Engine, State DOI Rate Filings

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the rating algorithm used to price this term. Enables rate change analysis.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date when a cancelled term was reinstated. Null if term was never reinstated.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: renewal_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date when the insured accepted the renewal offer. Null if renewal was not accepted.

attributes.name: renewal_offer_date
attributes.description: Date when renewal offer was extended to the insured. Used for renewal cycle tracking.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewal process. Indicates whether renewal was automatic, manual, or conditional.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy term. Indicates whether the term is active, expired, or cancelled.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, Policy Administration System

attributes.name: underwriting_company_code
attributes.description: NAIC company code of the insurer underwriting this term. Used for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: underwriting_company_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance company underwriting this term.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: written_premium_amount
attributes.description: DEPRECATED — do not use for reporting. Premium must be aggregated from premium.premium_transaction. Retained for legacy source-system compatibility only.

products.name: policy_transaction
products.description: Grain: one row per policy transaction. Records lifecycle events: New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement, Non-renewal. Drives written premium change and coverage versioning.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy transaction. Primary key. One row per transaction event applied to a policy term.

attributes.name: binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.binder. Business justification: The initial policy issuance transaction corresponds to the binder issued before the policy.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Policy transactions must be assigned to accounting/reporting periods for SAP, GAAP, and NAIC Schedule P written-premium reporting.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Endorsements, cancellations, and renewals may apply different commission schedules than the original policy.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Transactions record premium changes in transaction currency—FK to currency master enables FX translation for accounting entries, multi-currency GL posting, and audit trails.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underwriter who approved or processed this transaction. Links to party role for audit and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent policy contract. Links this transaction to the overarching policy lifecycle.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period affected by this transaction.

attributes.name: primary_prior_transaction_policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding transaction in the policy lifecycle. Enables transaction chain reconstruction.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer or agent of record at the time of this transaction. Used for commission calculation and distribution tracking.

attributes.name: uw_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.uw_decision. Business justification: Mid-term endorsements requiring underwriting approval must reference the UW decision that authorized the change.

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction is recognized for accounting and statutory reporting purposes. May differ from effective and processed dates.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, GAAP, IFRS 17, NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was approved. Distinct from processed and effective timestamps.

attributes.name: cancellation_basis
attributes.description: Legal or business basis for cancellation. Determines regulatory notice requirements and return premium method. Null for non-cancellation transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Cancellation Regulations

attributes.name: cancellation_type_code
attributes.description: Method used to calculate return premium for cancellations: flat (no return), short_rate (penalty), pro_rata (proportional). Null for non-cancellation transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: commission_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net change in producer commission resulting from this transaction. Used for commission settlement and payables.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the generated policy document, declarations page, or endorsement form associated with this transaction.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction becomes effective and changes take effect on the policy. Critical for loss date reconstruction.

attributes.name: endorsement_description
attributes.description: Business description of the endorsement changes. Summarizes coverage, limit, or risk modifications. Null for non-endorsement transactions.

attributes.name: endorsement_form_number
attributes.description: ISO or proprietary form number attached to this endorsement transaction. Null for non-endorsement transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction or its effects expire. Applicable for term-bounded endorsements or temporary changes.

attributes.name: is_backdated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective date is prior to the processed date. Used for audit and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: is_midterm_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction occurred mid-term (between policy inception and expiration). True for endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements.

attributes.name: is_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents a policy renewal. True for REN transaction type, false otherwise.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was issued and documents were generated. Marks final commitment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was last updated. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy year in which this transaction occurred. Used for loss ratio analysis and actuarial reserving by policy year cohort.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was processed and recorded in the system. May differ from effective date.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the transaction. Type-specific: endorsement reason, cancellation cause, reinstatement justification.
attributes.references: ISO Reason Code Tables, NAIC Standards

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the transaction was initiated. Supplements the reason code with context.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when regulatory filing was submitted. Null if no filing required or not yet filed.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction requires filing with state Department of Insurance or other regulatory body.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: reinstatement_lapse_days
attributes.description: Number of days the policy was lapsed before reinstatement. Used for underwriting and pricing adjustments. Null for non-reinstatement transactions.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggers reinsurance cession under treaty or facultative agreements.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Agreement Standards, NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: requires_underwriting_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggered underwriting referral or manual review based on risk appetite rules.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system for this transaction. Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing transaction number displayed on declarations pages and endorsements. Externally visible identifier.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the transaction. Tracks progression from draft through issuance or reversal.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Type of policy transaction: NB (New Business), REN (Renewal), END (Endorsement), CAN (Cancellation), RI (Reinstatement), NR (Non-renewal).

attributes.name: voided_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the transaction was voided. Null for active transactions.

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the transaction was voided or reversed. Null for active transactions.

attributes.name: written_premium_change_amount
attributes.description: Net change in written premium resulting from this transaction. Positive for increases, negative for returns. Used for premium accounting and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, IFRS 17

domains.name: coverage
domains.description: Bridge between the policy contract and the insured risk. Owns Coverage (one row per coverage per policy term) with attached Limit, Deductible, Exclusion, and Condition.
domains.references: ISO Coverage Forms & ACORD Coverage Model

products.name: submission
products.description: ACORD 125/126/140 submission record capturing prospect risk information submitted for UW evaluation. Grain: one row per submission. Tracks source, status, line of business, and submission date.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the submission record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the agency or brokerage firm associated with this submission.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Underwriters evaluate catastrophe exposure during submission intake to determine risk appetite, pricing tier, and referral triggers.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Submissions carry estimated_annual_premium and total_insured_value as monetary fields requiring proper currency denomination for multi-currency commercial lines.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Submissions capture risk location (risk_state, risk_country) which maps to geography hierarchy for territory rating, catastrophe zone assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. Submission currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB

attributes.name: primary_submission_applicant_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the party table identifying the applicant or prospect submitting the risk for underwriting evaluation.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the producer or agent who submitted or is associated with this submission.

attributes.name: reporting_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: New business production reporting requires submissions aggregated by fiscal period, accident year, and policy year.

attributes.name: risk_location_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: Underwriters rate submissions against the canonical geocoded party.address record (fire protection class, cat zone, distance to coast).

attributes.name: acord_form_type
attributes.description: ACORD standard form type used for this submission such as ACORD 125 for commercial, ACORD 126 for commercial supplemental, ACORD 140 for personal lines.

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of submission intake clearance process indicating whether all required information and documents have been received.

attributes.name: clue_report_date
attributes.description: Date the CLUE or Comprehensive Loss Underwriting Exchange report was pulled for this submission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this submission record was first created in the underwriting system.

attributes.name: credit_report_date
attributes.description: Date the credit report or insurance score was pulled for this submission.

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Insurance credit score or credit-based insurance score used in underwriting and rating where permitted by state regulation.

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for declining the submission if status is declined such as adverse loss history, unacceptable risk, or outside appetite.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Requested or proposed effective date for coverage to begin if the submission is bound.

attributes.name: eligibility_status
attributes.description: Result of automated eligibility screening indicating whether the submission meets basic acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_premium
attributes.description: Estimated or indicative annual premium for this submission prior to final rating.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Requested or proposed expiration date for coverage if the submission is bound.

attributes.name: inspection_completed_date
attributes.description: Date the required inspection was completed if applicable.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a physical inspection of the insured property or risk is required before binding.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance line of business for this submission such as Personal Auto, Homeowners, Commercial General Liability, Workers Compensation.

attributes.name: loss_history_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether prior loss history was reviewed via CLUE, ISO, or other loss database.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this submission record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: mvr_report_date
attributes.description: Date the Motor Vehicle Record report was pulled for auto submissions.

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code classifying the business or industry of the applicant for commercial submissions.

tag_set.value: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique submission number displayed to users and producers.

attributes.name: policy_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of policy being submitted such as HO3, PAP, BOP, CGL, WC.

attributes.name: prior_carrier_naic_code
attributes.description: NAIC company code of the prior insurance carrier.

attributes.name: prior_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the prior insurance carrier if the applicant is switching carriers.

attributes.name: prior_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the prior or expiring policy if this submission is a renewal or rewrite.

attributes.name: quote_count
attributes.description: Number of quotes generated from this submission.

attributes.name: referral_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or rule that triggered the referral requirement such as high TIV, adverse loss history, or non-standard risk.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this submission requires referral to senior underwriter or management for approval.

attributes.name: risk_appetite_score
attributes.description: Automated or manual risk appetite score indicating alignment with underwriting guidelines and risk tolerance.

attributes.name: risk_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the insured risk is located.

attributes.name: risk_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the primary insured risk is located.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code classifying the business or industry of the applicant for commercial submissions.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Channel or origin through which the submission was received. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agent|broker|direct|web_portal|mobile_app|call_center|renewal|endorsement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the submission was received or created in the system.

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the submission in the underwriting workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|quoted|bound|declined|withdrawn|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: submission_type
attributes.description: Classification of the submission as new business, renewal, rewrite, or remarketing of existing risk.

attributes.name: submitted_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier or login of the person who created or submitted this submission record.

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: Total insured value or sum insured across all risks and coverages in this submission.

attributes.name: withdrawn_reason
attributes.description: Reason the submission was withdrawn by the applicant or producer before binding.

products.name: uw_decision
products.description: Underwriter accept/decline/refer/modify decision for a submission or quote, including referral escalation (absorbs uw_referral): assigned UW, priority, SLA due date, resolution. Grain: one row per UW decision event.

attributes.name: uw_decision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underwriting decision event. Grain: one row per UW decision event.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: UW decisions record modified_premium_amount and modified_limit_amount as monetary values. Multi-currency commercial lines require currency context for these amounts.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: UW decisions are LOB-specific: authority levels, referral thresholds, and approval workflows differ by line.

attributes.name: primary_uw_approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party who provided final approval for the underwriting decision, if approval was required.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quote being evaluated or modified by this underwriting decision, if applicable.

attributes.name: reporting_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: UW performance reporting (approval rates, SLA compliance, referral volumes) is analyzed by fiscal period and accident year.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Reference to the submission being evaluated by this underwriting decision.

attributes.name: tertiary_uw_referred_to_underwriter_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior underwriter or specialist to whom the submission was escalated.

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.uw_referral. Business justification: UW decision can result from a referral being resolved. 1 decision resolves 1 referral. FK populated when referral is resolved with decision.

attributes.name: appetite_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission aligns with the insurers current risk appetite and strategic guidelines.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriting decision requires additional approval from management or a senior authority before being finalized.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the underwriting decision was approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: assigned_underwriter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the underwriter who rendered this decision, for reporting and audit purposes.

attributes.name: automated_decision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriting decision was rendered by an automated rules engine or AI model versus a human underwriter.

attributes.name: conditions_required
attributes.description: List of conditions or requirements that must be met for conditional acceptance, such as inspections, loss control measures, or additional documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this underwriting decision record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: decision_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the underwriting decision becomes effective, relevant for conditional acceptances or modified terms.

attributes.name: decision_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the underwriting decision expires if not acted upon, typically for quotes or conditional offers.

attributes.name: decision_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the automated underwriting model or rules engine used to render the decision, for audit and reproducibility.

attributes.name: decision_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the underwriting decision, used in correspondence and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reasoning behind the underwriting decision, including risk factors and business considerations.

attributes.name: decision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the underwriting decision within the workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_review|approved|rejected|escalated|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the underwriting decision was rendered by the underwriter.

attributes.name: decision_type
attributes.description: The type of underwriting decision rendered: accept, decline, refer to senior UW, modify terms, counter-offer, or conditional acceptance.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for declining the submission, aligned with regulatory disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: decline_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the decline reason, provided to the applicant per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the submission meets all eligibility criteria for the requested line of business and coverage.

attributes.name: endorsements_required
attributes.description: List of endorsements or policy forms that must be attached as part of the underwriting decision.

attributes.name: exclusions_added
attributes.description: List of exclusions added to the policy as part of the underwriting decision to mitigate specific risks.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this underwriting decision record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: modified_deductible_amount
attributes.description: The revised deductible amount proposed by the underwriter if the decision type is modify or counter-offer.

attributes.name: modified_limit_amount
attributes.description: The revised coverage limit proposed by the underwriter if the decision type is modify or counter-offer.

attributes.name: modified_premium_amount
attributes.description: The revised premium amount proposed by the underwriter if the decision type is modify or counter-offer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments recorded by the underwriter regarding the decision, for internal reference and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriter manually overrode an automated decision or system recommendation.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the underwriter overrode the automated decision, required for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: referral_due_date
attributes.description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) due date by which the referral must be resolved to meet business commitments.

attributes.name: referral_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the referral, determining the urgency of senior underwriter review.

attributes.name: referral_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the submission was referred to a senior underwriter or specialist for further review.

attributes.name: referral_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the submission requires escalation or specialist review.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score calculated for the submission, used to support the underwriting decision.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification assigned to the submission based on underwriting evaluation.

attributes.name: sla_actual_hours
attributes.description: The actual number of hours taken to render the underwriting decision, measured from submission intake to decision timestamp.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underwriting decision was rendered within the committed service level agreement timeframe.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The target number of hours within which the underwriting decision should be rendered per business commitments.

attributes.name: underwriter_authority_level
attributes.description: The authority level of the underwriter who made the decision, indicating approval limits and escalation tier.

products.name: uw_referral
products.description: Tracks submissions or quotes escalated beyond standard UW authority for senior review. Captures referral reason, assigned UW, priority, SLA due date, and resolution outcome.

attributes.name: uw_referral_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underwriting referral record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the agency representing the producer who submitted the business.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: UW referrals record premium_amount and prior_loss_amount as monetary fields. Multi-currency commercial lines require currency context for referral amounts used in authority level

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: UW referrals are triggered by specific risk attributes (coastal exposure, high TIV, prior losses); uw_referral.insured_risk_id enables risk-level referral tracking and underwriting

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Referrals are routed to underwriters by line of business expertise and authority limits.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the policy associated with this referral, if applicable for endorsements or renewals.

attributes.name: primary_uw_assigned_underwriter_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the senior underwriter or specialist assigned to review and resolve the referral.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the agent or broker who submitted the business that triggered the referral.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the quote that triggered this referral, if applicable.

attributes.name: reporting_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: UW referral SLA compliance and volume reporting is analyzed by fiscal period. Management dashboards track referral counts, resolution times, and outcomes by calendar period for underwriting

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the submission that triggered this referral.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Referrals occur at renewal (term-specific underwriting review triggered by loss activity, occupancy change, limit increase).

attributes.name: approval_conditions
attributes.description: Specific conditions or requirements that must be met for approval, such as additional documentation, coverage modifications, or premium adjustments.

attributes.name: assigned_underwriter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the assigned underwriter for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: authority_level_required
attributes.description: Level of underwriting authority required to approve this referral based on risk, premium, or policy limits.

attributes.name: catastrophe_exposure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the referral involves significant catastrophe exposure requiring senior review.

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created the referral record.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for declining the referral, if applicable.

attributes.name: decline_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the referral was declined, if applicable.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Number of times the referral has been escalated to higher authority levels. Zero indicates no escalation.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether fraud detection systems flagged this submission for potential fraud requiring special investigation unit review.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified the referral record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the referral record was last updated.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount associated with the referred submission or quote.

attributes.name: prior_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of prior losses for the insured or risk that contributed to the referral decision.

attributes.name: prior_loss_count
attributes.description: Number of prior losses reported for the insured or risk that contributed to the referral decision.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the referral for queue management and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code identifying the specific insurance product being underwritten.

attributes.name: referral_assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the referral was assigned to a senior underwriter for review.

attributes.name: referral_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the referral was first created in the underwriting workbench.

attributes.name: referral_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique referral number displayed to underwriters and stakeholders.

attributes.name: referral_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for referral. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE

attributes.name: referral_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the submission or quote was referred beyond standard authority.

attributes.name: referral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the referral: pending, under review, approved, declined, withdrawn, escalated, or returned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|under_review|approved|declined|withdrawn|escalated|returned — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference

attributes.name: referral_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction that triggered the referral: new business, renewal, endorsement, cancellation, reinstatement, or quote revision.

attributes.name: regulatory_concern_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the referral involves regulatory compliance concerns requiring legal or compliance review.

attributes.name: reinsurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether reinsurance placement or facultative coverage is required as part of the referral review.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes from the reviewing underwriter explaining the resolution decision and any special conditions or requirements.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision outcome of the referral review: approved, approved with conditions, declined, withdrawn, escalated, or returned for rework.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the referral was resolved with a final decision.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned to the submission or quote that triggered the referral.

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the referral must be resolved per underwriting service level agreements.

attributes.name: sla_due_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time by which the referral must be resolved per underwriting service level agreements.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the risk is located, relevant for regulatory and underwriting authority rules.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Internal territory code used for rating and underwriting segmentation.

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: Total insured value of all risks covered under the referred submission or quote.

products.name: underwriting_risk_score
products.description: UW risk scoring result for a submission or insured risk. Grain: one row per scoring event. Captures model version, composite score, component scores (COPE, MVR, CLUE), and score band classification.

attributes.name: underwriting_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underwriting risk score record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cat_model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_model_version. Business justification: Risk scores are produced by a specific cat model version; model governance, regulatory filings, and actuarial model validation all require tracing each score to its producing

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Risk scoring models incorporate catastrophe zone hazard scores (earthquake PML, hurricane AAL) as key underwriting factors.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Underwriting risk scores include total_incurred_3yr as a monetary field used in composite scoring.

attributes.name: driver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.driver. Business justification: Auto underwriting risk scores include driver-specific MVR components (mvr_score already on the table); underwriting_risk_score.driver_id enables driver-level score audit and supports regulatory

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Risk scores are geography-dependent (territory_score, catastrophe_score fields exist).

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the insured risk being scored. Links this risk score to the specific risk exposure (property, auto, etc.).

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the underwriter who performed the manual override. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Underwriting risk scores are computed per peril (wind score, quake score, wildfire score).

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy if this score was generated post-binding. Null for pre-bind scoring.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: A risk score is frequently run against a specific quote during the rating and UW evaluation cycle.

attributes.name: score_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Risk score trend analysis and model performance monitoring requires scores linked to calendar periods by score_timestamp.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the submission being scored. Links this risk score to the submission intake record.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Risk scores are recalculated per term for renewal underwriting (score changes term-over-term based on updated loss history, credit, MVR, territory).

attributes.name: auto_decline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this score triggered an automatic decline decision. True if risk is outside appetite.

attributes.name: auto_decline_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for automatic decline. Describes which rule or threshold caused the decline decision.

attributes.name: catastrophe_score
attributes.description: Component score for catastrophe exposure including hurricane, earthquake, wildfire, and flood risk.

attributes.name: claim_count_3yr
attributes.description: Number of claims filed in the prior 3 years. Key indicator of loss frequency.

attributes.name: claim_count_5yr
attributes.description: Number of claims filed in the prior 5 years. Extended loss history view for high-value risks.

attributes.name: clue_score
attributes.description: Component score derived from prior loss history via CLUE database. Reflects historical claim frequency and severity.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Overall composite risk score calculated by the model. Primary output of the scoring process.

attributes.name: cope_score
attributes.description: Component score for property risk factors: construction type, occupancy class, fire protection, and external exposure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this risk score record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Component score derived from credit-based insurance score. Used where permitted by state regulation.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Percentage score reflecting completeness and accuracy of input data used for scoring. Range 0-100.

attributes.name: itv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of insured value to actual replacement cost. Used to assess adequacy of coverage limits.

attributes.name: lapse_in_coverage_days
attributes.description: Number of days without insurance coverage prior to this application. Zero indicates continuous coverage.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Insurance line of business this score applies to. Determines which scoring model and rules are used.

attributes.name: loss_free_years
attributes.description: Number of consecutive years without a reported claim. Used for experience rating and NCB calculation.

attributes.name: mvr_score
attributes.description: Component score derived from driver motor vehicle records. Includes violations, accidents, and license status.

attributes.name: occupancy_score
attributes.description: Component score for business occupancy classification and associated hazards. Uses SIC or NAICS codes.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an underwriter manually overrode the system-generated score. True if overridden.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for manual score override. Required for audit and compliance when override occurs.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manual override was performed. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: prior_carrier_score
attributes.description: Component score reflecting prior insurance history, carrier quality, and continuity of coverage.

attributes.name: protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC) code for fire protection. Ranges from 1 (best) to 10 (worst).

attributes.name: score_band
attributes.description: Risk classification band derived from the composite score. Used for underwriting decisioning and pricing tier assignment.

attributes.name: score_confidence_level
attributes.description: Model confidence in the score result. Reflects data completeness and model certainty.

attributes.name: score_reason_code_1
attributes.description: Primary reason code explaining the score result. Top adverse action factor per FCRA requirements.

attributes.name: score_reason_code_2
attributes.description: Secondary reason code explaining the score result. Second adverse action factor per FCRA requirements.

attributes.name: score_reason_code_3
attributes.description: Tertiary reason code explaining the score result. Third adverse action factor per FCRA requirements.

attributes.name: score_reason_code_4
attributes.description: Quaternary reason code explaining the score result. Fourth adverse action factor per FCRA requirements.

attributes.name: score_run_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the scoring batch or run. Enables traceability and audit of scoring execution.

attributes.name: score_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the risk score was calculated. Business event timestamp for the scoring event.

attributes.name: scoring_engine
attributes.description: Name of the scoring engine or platform that executed the model (e.g., ISO ERC, Earnix, proprietary).

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the risk is located. Determines regulatory rules and scoring factors.

attributes.name: territory_score
attributes.description: Component score based on geographic territory risk factors including crime, weather, and loss history.

attributes.name: total_incurred_3yr
attributes.description: Total incurred loss amount (paid plus reserves) for claims in the prior 3 years. Measures loss severity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this risk score record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: uw_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this score triggered a referral to manual underwriting review. True if referral required.

attributes.name: uw_referral_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for underwriting referral. Describes which rule or threshold triggered manual review.

attributes.name: years_with_prior_carrier
attributes.description: Number of years the applicant was insured with their prior carrier. Indicates stability and insurability.

products.name: quote
products.description: Priced insurance proposal generated from a submission. Grain: one row per quote. Captures quoted premium, LOB, effective date, expiration date, quote status, and binding eligibility flag.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance quote. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the agency through which the quote was submitted.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Quotes are priced with catastrophe load factors based on the risk's cat zone. Rating worksheets apply zone-specific surcharges for wind, earthquake, and other cat perils.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Quotes carry base_premium_amount, quoted_premium_amount, commission_amount, fee_amount, and tax_amount requiring proper currency denomination.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Quote rating uses geography for territory assignment, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory filing compliance.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Quotes are classified by line of business for premium aggregation, loss ratio analysis, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underwriter who reviewed and approved the quote.

attributes.name: producer_id
