domains.name: premium
domains.description: Transactional ledger for all premium activity. Owns Premium Transaction (one row per financial transaction: Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, Insured Risk, and Accounting Period, with Charge, Tax, Fee, and
domains.references: NAIC SAP Premium Accounting / ACORD Premium Model

products.name: premium_transaction
products.description: Premium Transaction: one row per financial transaction. Records each premium financial movement (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to policy, term, coverage, insured risk, and accounting period. Grain: one row per financial transaction.
products.reference: ACORD Premium Transaction / SAP Written Premium Ledger

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium financial movement record. Grain: one row per financial premium movement (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return). Primary key.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.audit. Business justification: For auditable policies (WC, GL, CGL), a completed audit generates premium adjustment transactions (additional or return premium).

attributes.name: binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.binder. Business justification: The binder is the instrument that triggers the initial premium booking. 'Binder premium reconciliation' — verifying that the written premium transaction matches the binder's stated premium —

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Premium transactions posted to accounting periods require calendar dimensions for fiscal/accident/policy year reporting.

attributes.name: cat_model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_model_version. Business justification: Actuarial and regulatory rate filings require tracing which cat model version was active when premium was written.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat zone drives rating surcharges and is required for zone-level written premium aggregation used in PML monitoring and reinsurance treaty attachment analysis — a core cat accumulation

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the policy term to which this premium transaction is allocated. Enables per-coverage premium analytics.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Premium transactions record amounts in specific currencies. Multi-currency operations require proper FK for FX validation, conversion, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: endorsement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_endorsement. Business justification: A premium_endorsement records the net premium change from a policy endorsement and generates one or more premium_transactions (additional written, return, tax, fee).

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Premium transactions require geographic attribution for statutory state pages, territorial profitability analysis, regulatory reporting, and geographic concentration

attributes.name: installment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.installment_plan. Business justification: Premium transactions are allocated to specific installment plan schedules for earned premium calculation per installment.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk or exposure unit (property, vehicle, driver) to which this premium transaction is allocated.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. Premium transaction currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which this premium transaction was generated. Links the premium ledger entry to the master policy record.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term (time-bounded period) to which this premium transaction belongs. Enables reconstruction of premium in force at any date.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy transaction (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement) that triggered this premium movement.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer (agent or broker) associated with this premium transaction for commission settlement and distribution channel reporting.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.quote. Business justification: Premium transactions originate from bound quotes; accounting audit trail requires quote reference for rate reconciliation, variance analysis between quoted and booked premium, and

attributes.name: rating_worksheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.rating_worksheet. Business justification: Premium transactions reference rating worksheets for rate reconciliation, audit defense of filed rates, and regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: retrospective_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.retrospective_adjustment. Business justification: A retrospective_adjustment for retro-rated policies generates premium transactions reflecting the calculated retro premium.

attributes.name: audit_basis
attributes.description: Exposure basis used for auditable policies (e.g., WC, CGL) to determine final earned premium: Payroll, Revenue, Units, Receipts, or None for non-auditable policies.

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: Portion of gross written premium ceded to reinsurers under treaty or facultative agreements. Used for Schedule F and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62, NAIC Schedule F, IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or profit center code to which this premium transaction is allocated for management accounting and segment reporting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: days_in_force
attributes.description: Number of days the coverage was in force during the accounting period for this premium transaction. Used in pro-rata earning and exposure calculations.

attributes.name: direct_billed_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium is billed directly to the policyholder (True) or through the producer/agency (False = agency billed). Drives billing workflow routing.

attributes.name: earned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium recognized as earned for the accounting period based on pro-rata or other earning methodology. Core input to loss ratio (LR) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: earning_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize written premium as earned over the policy period: Pro-Rata (daily), 1/365, 1/24 (monthly), Flat (fully earned at inception), or Other.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this premium transaction takes effect for coverage and financial recognition purposes. Used to reconstruct premium in force at any given date.

attributes.name: endorsement_type
attributes.description: Type of endorsement premium adjustment: Additional (increase), Return (decrease/credit), Flat (no change), Audit (audit-based adjustment), or None for non-endorsement transactions.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, ACORD

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the premium coverage period ends for this transaction. Used for unearned premium (UEP) calculation and pro-rata earning.

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: Quantitative exposure measure (e.g., payroll dollars, vehicle count, property TIV) underlying the premium calculation. Used for rate adequacy and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this premium transaction is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Required for financial close and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SAP/SSAP, SOX, US GAAP

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium amount for this transaction before cessions, taxes, fees, and commissions. Core ledger amount for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P, IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_written_premium
attributes.description: Written premium net of reinsurance cessions. NWP = GWP minus ceded written premium. Used for net retention reporting and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, RBC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by underwriters, billing staff, or system processes to explain the reason for or context of this premium transaction.

attributes.name: payment_plan_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the installment or payment plan under which this premium is billed (e.g., Annual, Semi-Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Pay-As-You-Go).

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction was posted to the general ledger and accounting system. Distinct from the business event date.

attributes.name: pro_rata_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor (0.0 to 1.0) representing the proportion of the policy period elapsed as of the accounting period end date. Used to compute earned premium.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The rate applied to the exposure base to calculate the premium for this transaction. Expressed per unit of exposure (e.g., per $100 payroll, per $1000 TIV).
attributes.references: ISO ERC, Earnix, State DOI rate filings

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate used for this premium transaction became effective. Required for rate adequacy monitoring and DOI rate filing compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI, ISO ERC, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: return_premium
attributes.description: Premium amount returned to the policyholder due to cancellation, mid-term endorsement reduction, or audit adjustment. Negative financial movement in the ledger.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this premium transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. True = reversal entry; False = original entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this premium transaction (e.g., PAS for PolicyCenter, BILLING for BillingCenter, RATING for rating engine).
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy, Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the risk is located or the policy is written. Required for state-level statutory reporting and DOI filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, State DOI, ISO

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which this premium movement was generated or triggered (e.g., policy effective date, endorsement effective date, cancellation date).

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this premium transaction as assigned by the Policy Administration System or billing system. Used in bordereaux and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD, Guidewire PolicyCenter, Duck Creek Policy

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the premium transaction in the accounting ledger: Pending (awaiting posting), Posted (booked to GL), Reversed, Voided, or Error.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the premium financial movement: Written (new/renewed/endorsed), Earned (pro-rata recognition), Unearned (UEP reserve), Return (cancellation/endorsement credit), or Adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: unearned_premium
attributes.description: Portion of written premium not yet earned as of the accounting period end date. Represents the UEP reserve liability on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 53, NAIC Annual Statement, IFRS 17

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this premium transaction record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data loading.

products.name: charge
products.description: Child of Premium Transaction. One row per charge component (base premium, surcharge, credit, minimum premium) within a transaction. Enables granular decomposition of gross written premium by rating element and LOB.
products.reference: ISO Rating Element / Guidewire PolicyCenter Charge

attributes.name: charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the charge component within a premium transaction.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Charges posted to accounting periods. FK enables period-based charge analysis, fiscal year reporting, and ensures charges align with calendar dimensions for financial statements.

attributes.name: cat_model_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_model_version. Business justification: Cat-related surcharges and model-driven loadings are computed using a specific cat model version.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat surcharges, wind pool assessments, and FAIR plan charges are zone-specific. Linking charge to cat_zone enables zone-level charge aggregation for regulatory reporting and reinsurance

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Individual charges (earthquake coverage, flood buyback, wind deductible) are peril-specific for pricing transparency, regulatory compliance, coverage verification, and claims

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurance_cession. Business justification: Charge records ceded_amount and is_ceded flag per rating element. Linking to reinsurance_cession enables Schedule F ceded charge reconciliation and cession-level premium

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Commissionable charges (is_commissionable=true) are governed by a commission schedule that defines the applicable rate and basis.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the coverage to which this charge applies, if coverage-specific.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Charges have amounts denominated in currency. FK enables currency validation, FX conversion for consolidated reporting, and ensures charge amounts reference valid active currencies for

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Individual charges require geographic assignment for tax calculation, surplus lines allocation, territorial rating factors, and jurisdictional compliance.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the insured risk to which this charge applies, if risk-specific.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Charges apply to specific lines of business. FK enables LOB-specific charge analysis, regulatory reporting by line, and ensures charges reference valid active LOBs.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_plan. Business justification: Installment surcharges and plan-specific fees are defined per payment plan. Linking charge to payment_plan lets billing analysts reconcile plan-driven surcharge amounts against the plan

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy to which this charge applies.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term during which this charge is effective.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Each charge (surcharge, discount, minimum premium) is generated by a specific policy transaction.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Charge records commissionable amounts (commission_amount, commission_rate, is_commissionable).

attributes.name: rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.rate_table. Business justification: Each charge component (base premium, surcharge, credit, minimum premium) is calculated using a specific versioned rate table published by the rating engine.

attributes.name: rating_worksheet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.rating_worksheet. Business justification: Individual premium charges reference rating worksheets that calculated them for audit trail, rate justification to regulators, and insured disputes.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the charge component in the policy currency.

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: Base amount to which the charge rate is applied to derive the charge amount.

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the charge: premium, fee, penalty, refund, or adjustment.

attributes.name: ceded_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the charge amount ceded to reinsurers under applicable reinsurance agreements.

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the charge: active, voided, reversed, adjusted, or pending.

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge component: base premium, surcharge, credit, discount, minimum premium, flat charge, or adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: base_premium|surcharge|credit|discount|minimum_premium|flat_charge|adjustment — 7 candidates stripped

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission amount payable to the producer based on this charge, if commissionable.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to this charge to calculate producer commission, if commissionable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the charge component and its purpose.

attributes.name: earned_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the charge amount that has been earned as of the accounting period date.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this charge becomes effective and applies to the policy or coverage.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this charge expires and no longer applies to the policy or coverage.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this charge is posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: is_ceded
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is subject to reinsurance cession under a treaty or facultative agreement.

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is subject to producer commission calculation.

attributes.name: is_earned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge has been earned as of the accounting period date.

attributes.name: is_minimum_premium
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge represents a minimum premium requirement for the policy or coverage.

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charge amount has been prorated for a partial term or endorsement period.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net charge amount retained by the insurer after reinsurance cession, calculated as charge amount minus ceded amount.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the charge, unique within the premium transaction context.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage applied to the basis amount to calculate the charge, if applicable.

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Factor applied to prorate the charge for a partial term, typically a fraction of the full term.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: Rate or factor applied to calculate the charge amount, if applicable.

attributes.name: rating_element_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the rating element or factor that generated this charge, per the rating engine.

attributes.name: rating_element_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the rating element or factor that generated this charge.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for voiding or reversing this charge, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the reason for voiding or reversing this charge.

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordering sequence of this charge within the premium transaction for display and calculation purposes.

attributes.name: statutory_line_code
attributes.description: NAIC statutory line of business code for regulatory reporting and Schedule P aggregation.

attributes.name: unearned_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the charge amount that remains unearned as of the accounting period date.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was last modified in the system.

products.name: tax_levy

attributes.name: calendar_id

attributes.name: cat_zone_id

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: naic_company_code

attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code of the insurer responsible for remitting the tax, used for statutory reporting and reconciliation.

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: policy_transaction_type_code
attributes.description: Type of policy transaction that triggered the premium and associated tax levy: new business, renewal, endorsement, cancellation, or reinstatement.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that originated the tax levy record, such as billing system or policy administration system.

attributes.name: stamping_office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the surplus lines stamping office responsible for processing and collecting the tax, if applicable.

attributes.name: surplus_lines_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax levy applies to a surplus lines policy, subject to surplus lines tax and stamping requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, Surplus Lines Stamping Offices

attributes.name: tax_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax levy record represents an adjustment or correction to a previously recorded tax levy.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governmental authority to which the tax is remitted, such as State Department of Insurance or Surplus Lines Stamping Office.
attributes.references: State DOI, Surplus Lines Stamping Offices

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method_code
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax levy: statutory rate, flat fee, tiered rate schedule, or minimum tax threshold.

attributes.name: tax_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax levy becomes effective, typically aligned with the premium transaction effective date.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premium transaction qualifies for a tax exemption under statutory or regulatory provisions.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: tax_exemption_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for tax exemption: exempt entity, reinsurance, export, federal program, or other statutory exemption.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The statutory tax rate applied to the taxable premium base, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025 for 2.5 percent).
attributes.references: State DOI Rate Tables, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: tax_remittance_batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the remittance batch or payment run in which this tax levy was included for payment to the authority.

attributes.name: tax_remittance_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the tax was remitted to the taxing authority. Null if not yet remitted.

attributes.name: tax_remittance_due_date
attributes.description: The statutory due date by which the tax must be remitted to the taxing authority to avoid penalties.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: tax_remittance_status
attributes.description: Current remittance status of the tax levy: pending, remitted, overdue, waived, or adjusted.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category_code
attributes.description: Reporting category for statutory and regulatory tax filings: direct written premium, assumed reinsurance, or ceded reinsurance.

attributes.name: tax_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the tax levy: state premium tax, surplus lines tax, stamping fee, municipal tax, fire marshal tax, or guaranty fund assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: taxable_premium_amount
attributes.description: The base premium amount subject to tax, after any exemptions or adjustments, in US dollars.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax levy record was last modified in the data platform.

products.name: policy_fee

attributes.name: policy_fee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy fee transaction record.

attributes.name: coverage_id

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: line_of_business_id

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the payment plan under which this fee is financed; null for full-pay policies.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy to which this fee applies.

attributes.name: policy_term_id

attributes.name: billing_method

attributes.name: fee_amount

attributes.name: fee_basis

attributes.name: fee_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of fee charged, aligned with rating engine and billing system fee schedules.

attributes.name: fee_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fee, displayed on declarations pages and billing statements.

attributes.name: fee_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity or count used to calculate the fee when charged on a per-unit basis; null for flat or percentage fees.

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: Rate applied when fee is calculated as a percentage or per-unit charge; null for flat fees.

attributes.name: fee_status

attributes.name: fee_type

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: is_commission_bearing
attributes.description: Indicates whether producer commission is calculated on this fee; typically false for most policy fees.

attributes.name: is_refundable

attributes.name: is_taxable

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction code for fee compliance and reporting, may include county or municipal codes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee was reversed or refunded; null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for fee reversal or refund; null if not reversed.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this fee transaction.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code where the fee applies, for regulatory and tax jurisdiction purposes.

attributes.name: statutory_line_code
attributes.description: NAIC statutory line of business code for regulatory reporting classification.

attributes.name: transaction_booking_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee transaction was recorded in the financial ledger.

attributes.name: transaction_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee transaction becomes effective for policy accounting purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of financial movement: charge for new fee, reversal for cancellation, adjustment for correction, or refund for return.

attributes.name: waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee was waived as part of underwriting discretion or customer service exception.

attributes.name: waiver_authorized_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the underwriter or manager who authorized the fee waiver; null if not waived.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for fee waiver; null if not waived.

products.name: commission
products.description: Child of Premium Transaction. One row per producer commission calculation on a transaction: type (new/renewal/contingent), rate, basis, and computed payable. Calculation-only; commission settlement/payout is owned by the producers domain.

attributes.name: commission_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commission transaction record.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the agency associated with this commission.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Commissions posted to accounting periods. FK enables period-based producer accounting, fiscal year commission expense reporting, and ensures commissions align with calendar dimensions for

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Commission records must reference the governing commission schedule to support commission audit trails, rate validation, and producer compensation disputes.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Producer commission statements and regulatory Schedule T filings require commission allocated by coverage line. The 'commission by coverage' report is a named producer settlement process.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Commission amounts in specific currencies. Multi-currency producer accounting requires proper FK for currency validation, FX conversion, and accurate producer compensation reporting across

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Commission rates vary by line of business. FK enables LOB-specific producer compensation analysis, commission schedule management by line, and ensures commissions reference valid LOBs.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.license. Business justification: Commission eligibility and payment often depend on active license status at transaction date.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy associated with this commission.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term during which this commission was earned.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Commission is earned and charged back per transaction event (new business, endorsement, cancellation).

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the producer earning this commission.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The computed dollar amount of commission payable to the producer, calculated as basis amount multiplied by commission rate.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The premium or fee basis on which the commission is calculated: written premium, earned premium, policy fee, or installment fee.

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of premium or fee on which the commission is calculated.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the commission: flat rate, tiered structure, sliding scale, or manual override.

attributes.name: chargeback_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this commission is a chargeback reversing a previously paid commission due to policy cancellation or return premium.

attributes.name: chargeback_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the commission was charged back, typically due to policy cancellation, non-payment, or return premium.

attributes.name: commission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commission: calculated, approved, pending payment, paid, reversed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Type of commission: new business, renewal, endorsement, contingent, override, or bonus.

attributes.name: contingent_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a contingent commission based on volume, profitability, or other performance criteria.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: earned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commission was earned, typically aligned with premium earning.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the commission becomes effective and eligible for payment.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this commission expense is posted.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net commission amount payable to the producer after deductions, offsets, and withholdings.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this commission transaction, including manual adjustments or special circumstances.

attributes.name: override_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this commission is an override commission paid to a managing or supervising producer.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commission was paid to the producer.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to pay the commission: ACH, wire transfer, check, offset against debit balance, or direct deposit.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Payment status indicating whether the commission has been paid to the producer.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_type
attributes.description: The type of policy transaction that triggered this commission: new business, renewal, endorsement, cancellation, or reinstatement.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the basis to calculate the commission amount, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this commission transaction is a reversal of a prior commission entry.

attributes.name: split_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total commission allocated to this producer when commission is split among multiple producers.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the commission payment, if applicable.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: The producer tier or level within a tiered commission structure, affecting the commission rate.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the commission transaction was recorded.

products.name: earned_premium_schedule
products.description: Pro-rata or short-rate earning schedule for a Coverage within a Policy Term. Defines daily or monthly earned and unearned premium amounts used to compute EP at any in-force date. Supports IFRS 17 and Schedule P actuarial triangles.
products.reference: SAP Earned Premium / IFRS 17 Coverage Units

attributes.name: earned_premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the earned premium schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Earning schedules span accounting periods. FK enables period-based earning analysis, GAAP/IFRS17 reporting by period, and ensures schedules align with calendar dimensions for financial

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Zone-level earned premium aggregation is required for reinsurance treaty monitoring (attachment point tracking) and PML management.

attributes.name: catastrophegeography_peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Earned premium schedules are peril-segregated for Schedule P reporting, loss ratio monitoring by peril, reinsurance accounting, and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage for which this earning schedule applies.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Earning schedules track premium amounts in currency. FK enables FX-adjusted earning calculations, multi-currency GAAP/IFRS17 reporting, and ensures earned amounts reference valid currencies

attributes.name: endorsement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_endorsement. Business justification: When a policy endorsement changes the premium, a new or revised earned premium schedule is generated to reflect the updated earning pattern.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Earned premium schedules are geography-segregated for state-level statutory reporting, territorial profitability analysis, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk exposure associated with this earning schedule.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Earning patterns vary by line of business. FK enables LOB-specific earning analysis, GAAP/IFRS17 reporting by line, and ensures schedules reference valid LOBs for financial statements.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy contract for which premium is being earned.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period during which premium is earned.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Earned premium schedules are recalculated on each policy transaction (mid-term endorsements change the earning curve; cancellations trigger short-rate or pro-rata earning).

attributes.name: prior_schedule_earned_premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous earning schedule that this schedule supersedes or adjusts.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: Layered XL treaties require earned premium allocation to specific treaty layers based on attachment and exhaustion points.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating reason for schedule adjustment: endorsement, rate change, correction, audit, etc.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy or coverage was cancelled, affecting earned premium calculation.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating reason for policy cancellation: non-payment, insured request, underwriting, etc.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this earning schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_earned_amount
attributes.description: Total premium earned from effective date through the schedule date, cumulative sum.

attributes.name: daily_earned_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount earned per day, used for daily pro-rata earning calculations.

attributes.name: days_elapsed
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed from effective date to schedule date, used in pro-rata calculations.

attributes.name: days_in_period
attributes.description: Total number of days in the coverage period for which premium is being earned.

attributes.name: days_remaining
attributes.description: Number of days remaining from schedule date to expiration date, representing future coverage period.

attributes.name: earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount earned as of the schedule date, representing coverage provided to date.

attributes.name: earning_method
attributes.description: Granularity at which premium is earned: daily, monthly, quarterly, annual, or event-based.

attributes.name: earning_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total premium earned as of the schedule date, expressed as decimal.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this earning schedule becomes active and premium begins to earn.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this earning schedule ends and premium is fully earned or terminated.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which earned and unearned premium amounts are posted.

attributes.name: ifrs17_cohort_code
attributes.description: IFRS 17 cohort identifier for grouping contracts issued in same period with similar risk characteristics.

attributes.name: is_minimum_earned
attributes.description: Indicates whether minimum earned premium rule applies, ensuring minimum premium is retained regardless of cancellation timing.

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium earning is calculated using pro-rata method based on time elapsed.

attributes.name: is_short_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium earning uses short-rate method with penalty for mid-term cancellation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this earning schedule record was last modified or recalculated.

attributes.name: minimum_earned_amount
attributes.description: Minimum premium amount that must be earned regardless of cancellation date, per policy terms.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding special earning rules, adjustments, or exceptions for this schedule.

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor used to calculate earned premium, typically days elapsed divided by days in period.

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis for which this earning schedule is prepared: statutory, GAAP, IFRS 17, or tax.

attributes.name: schedule_date
attributes.description: Specific date for which earned and unearned premium amounts are calculated in this schedule entry.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the earning schedule, typically derived from policy and coverage identifiers.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the earning schedule: active, cancelled, expired, suspended, or adjusted.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Method used to calculate earned premium: pro-rata, short-rate, or custom earning pattern.

attributes.name: short_rate_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount applied when policy is cancelled mid-term using short-rate method, reducing return premium.

attributes.name: short_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage applied for short-rate cancellation, typically higher than pro-rata to penalize early termination.

attributes.name: statutory_line_code
attributes.description: NAIC statutory accounting line code used for Schedule P and regulatory financial reporting.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total written premium amount subject to earning over the coverage period.

attributes.name: unearned_premium_amount
attributes.description: Premium amount not yet earned as of the schedule date, representing future coverage obligation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: GL period-close, GAAP/SAP period-level transaction reconciliation, and NAIC quarterly billing transaction summaries require linking billing transactions to fiscal reporting periods via the

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim. Business justification: Claim-related billing transaction traceability: billing transactions for deductible collections, salvage credits, and claim-related fees must be traceable to the originating claim for loss ratio

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_payment. Business justification: Deductible offset transaction matching: a billing transaction recording a deductible receipt must reference the specific claim payment it offsets to support the deductible offset

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this transaction is recognized.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: GL posting and charge reconciliation on multi-coverage policies require billing_transaction to reference the specific coverage line.

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_exposure. Business justification: Per-coverage GL reconciliation: billing transactions for deductible collections, LAE, and recovery credits must reference the claim exposure for coverage-level GL posting, reinsurance

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that generated or is affected by this transaction.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Regulatory premium reporting, combined ratio analysis, and GL account segregation by line require LOB attribution on billing transactions.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (policyholder, payor, or payee) involved in this transaction.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy associated with this billing transaction.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific policy term period for this transaction.

attributes.name: policy_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy_transaction. Business justification: Every billing ledger entry (written premium, return premium, fee) originates from a specific policy_transaction.

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producer associated with this transaction for commission or attribution purposes.

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_billing_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original transaction that this transaction reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the transaction. Positive for debits (charges), negative for credits (payments, reversals).

attributes.name: balance_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net impact of this transaction on the billing account balance. Signed value reflecting debit or credit effect.

attributes.name: charge_code
attributes.description: Specific code identifying the type of charge, fee, or tax represented by this transaction.

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge, fee, tax, or financial movement.

attributes.name: commission_payable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction triggers a commission payable to a producer or agency.

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this transaction record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction is a debit (increases balance owed) or credit (decreases balance owed).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the transaction is effective for billing and accounting calculations.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or reference number for this transaction (e.g., payment gateway transaction ID).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this transaction is posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this transaction record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this transaction record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context or explanation for the transaction.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was posted to the general ledger for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the reversal transaction was executed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previous transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the transaction was reversed.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating system that created this transaction (e.g., PAS, billing system, payment gateway).

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is held in suspense pending allocation or resolution.

attributes.name: suspense_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the transaction is held in suspense (e.g., unidentified payment, policy not found).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Business date when the transaction occurred or was effective.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Human-readable unique transaction number for external reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transaction in the billing ledger.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the transaction was recorded in the billing system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the financial movement: charge, credit, payment, reversal, adjustment, fee, tax, commission, or write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charge|credit|payment|reversal|adjustment|fee|tax|commission|write_off — 9 candidates stripped; promote to

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction represents a write-off of uncollectible amounts.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for writing off the amount (e.g., bankruptcy, uncollectible, small balance).

domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Manages risk transfer to reinsurers. Owns Reinsurance Agreement, Treaty (QS/XOL/SL/CAT XL), Facultative Agreement, Cession, and Reinsurance Recovery linked to ceded Policy and Claim.
domains.references: ACORD Reinsurance Standards / NAIC Schedule F

products.name: ri_agreement
products.description: Master record for a reinsurance agreement between the cedant and one or more reinsurers. One row per agreement. Captures agreement type (Treaty/Facultative), status, inception/expiry, governing law, and currency.
products.reference: Reinsurance Agreement / SICS ReinsurancePro Agreement Master

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reinsurance agreement record. Primary key. One row per reinsurance agreement between the cedant and one or more reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: broker_agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Treaty agreements are placed through reinsurance brokers (agencies). Formalizing broker_name as FK enables producer performance tracking on treaty placements, commission reconciliation, and

attributes.name: agreement_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the calendar dimension, identifying the calendar period associated with this reinsurance agreement.

attributes.name: cedant_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Schedule F regulatory reporting and cedant credit-monitoring require resolving the cedant to the party master.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Treaty reinsurance broker commissions are governed by commission schedules used for payment calculation, Schedule F regulatory reporting, and profit commission accounting.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Reinsurance agreements are multi-currency contracts; currency master provides exchange rates, rounding rules, and display formats for financial reporting, settlement, and collateral

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. RI agreement currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB

attributes.name: ri_calendar_id
attributes.description: add column effective_date (DATE) with FK to shared.calendar.calendar_id — RI agreements need calendar linkage for temporal analysis

attributes.name: aggregate_limit_amt
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative reinsurance recovery across all losses in the treaty period. Caps total reinsurer exposure for Stop Loss and aggregate XOL structures. Null if no aggregate cap.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the reinsurance agreement (e.g., '2024 Property CAT XL Layer 1'). Used for human-readable identification in reports and workbenches.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the reinsurance agreement by the cedant or reinsurance management system. Used in bordereaux and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance agreement. Active indicates the agreement is in force and cessions may be made. Expired indicates the term has ended with no renewal.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the reinsurance arrangement: Treaty (automatic cession under standing contract), Facultative (individual risk negotiation), or Facultative-Obligatory.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: arbitration_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains a mandatory arbitration clause for dispute resolution in lieu of litigation. True if arbitration is required.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: attachment_point_amt
attributes.description: The loss threshold at which the reinsurance layer attaches and begins to respond for XOL and CAT XL treaties. Expressed in agreement currency. Null for proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: authorized_status
attributes.description: Regulatory authorization status of the lead reinsurer in the cedant's domicile state: Authorized, Unauthorized, Certified (under NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law), or Reciprocal.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State DOI

attributes.name: cat_event_scope
attributes.description: Defines the loss aggregation basis for CAT XL treaties: Per Risk, Per Occurrence, Per Event (hours clause), or Aggregate. Determines how losses from a single CAT event are combined.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant as a ceding commission under proportional (QS/Surplus) treaties to offset acquisition and overhead costs.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: cession_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share treaty (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). Null for XOL and non-proportional treaties where cession is loss-triggered.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: collateral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is required to post collateral (LOC, trust, funds withheld) due to unauthorized/alien reinsurer status. Drives Schedule F credit allowance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the reinsurer: Letter of Credit (LOC), Trust Account, Funds Withheld, Cash, or None. Required for unauthorized reinsurer credit under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Defines which losses are covered: Losses Occurring (loss event in treaty period), Risks Attaching (policy incepting in treaty period), or Claims Made (claim reported in treaty period).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards; IFRS 17

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurance agreement record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: deposit_premium_amt
attributes.description: Initial premium paid by the cedant at inception of the treaty year, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium. Used in ROL and premium settlement calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance agreement expires and no new cessions may be made. Null for evergreen or open-ended agreements. Used in Schedule F run-off reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: funds_withheld
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cedant withholds ceded premium reserves rather than remitting to the reinsurer. Affects Schedule F credit and collateral requirements under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of the agreement (e.g., 'New York', 'England and Wales'). Required for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; SAP SSAP No. 62R; Solvency II

attributes.name: hours_clause_hrs
attributes.description: Number of consecutive hours within which losses from a single occurrence are aggregated for CAT XL recovery purposes (e.g., 72 hours for wind, 168 hours for flood). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance agreement becomes effective and cessions may begin. Aligns with the treaty year start for annual treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: insolvency_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement contains an insolvency clause ensuring reinsurer obligations survive cedant insolvency. Required under SAP SSAP No. 62R for credit as reinsurance.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Model Laws; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lead Reinsurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code for the lead reinsurer. Required for Schedule F counterparty identification and credit risk assessment under SAP SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SAP SSAP No. 62R

tag_set.value: Lead Reinsurer National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the lead reinsurer on the agreement. For syndicated treaties, this is the lead market that sets terms. Used in bordereaux and Schedule F counterparty reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: limit_amt
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer will pay per risk, per occurrence, or in aggregate under this agreement. Defines the top of the reinsurance layer for XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: loss_corridor_pct
attributes.description: Loss ratio band within which the cedant retains losses before the reinsurer re-engages, used in Stop Loss and aggregate structures. Null if no loss corridor provision.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amt
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of actual subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against cedant portfolio shrinkage.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: offset_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement permits mutual offset of amounts owed between cedant and reinsurer. Relevant for credit risk management and Schedule F balance netting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to the cedant under a profit commission clause. Calculated on the treaty year result after losses and expenses. Null if no profit commission.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: program_layer
attributes.description: Identifies the layer within a multi-layer reinsurance program (e.g., 'Layer 1', 'Layer 2', 'Top Layer'). Used to sequence layers for loss allocation and PML modeling.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of times the reinsurance limit may be reinstated after a loss exhausts the layer. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatement provision.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original reinsurance premium charged to reinstate the limit after a loss. Expressed as a percentage of the annual deposit premium (e.g., 100% = pro-rata reinstatement).
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: retention_amt
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained amount per risk or per occurrence before reinsurance responds. For XOL, this is the attachment point (SIR). For QS, this is the retained share in currency.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement is a retrocession (reinsurer ceding risk to another reinsurer) rather than a primary cession from the cedant. Affects Schedule F netting.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a percentage: reinsurance premium divided by the reinsurance limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL layers used in actuarial and underwriting analysis.
attributes.references: ISO Reinsurance Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC ORSA

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date the reinsurance agreement was formally executed and signed by all parties. May differ from inception date for retroactive or late-signed treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of risks covered by the agreement (e.g., 'USA and Canada', 'Worldwide excluding War Zones'). Drives exposure aggregation and CAT model alignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ISO Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification for Treaty agreements: Quota Share (QS), Excess of Loss (XOL), Stop Loss (SL), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), Surplus Share, or Other. Null for Facultative agreements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: unl_basis
attributes.description: Defines how Ultimate Net Loss is calculated for recovery purposes: Gross (before other RI), Net of Inuring RI (after lower layers), or Net of All RI. Critical for layered program structures.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurance agreement record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: treaty
products.description: Defines a proportional or non-proportional treaty under a reinsurance agreement. One row per treaty. Captures treaty type (QS/XOL/SL/CAT XL), layer, retention, limit, ROL, and UNL basis.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a reinsurance treaty record. Primary key. One row per treaty under a reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference (BIGINT) linking calendar id in the treaty product to the calendar product in the shared domain.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Treaty financial terms require currency master for exchange rate application, premium settlement, and multi-currency reporting.

attributes.name: intermediary_agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Treaties track intermediary/broker by name; should formalize as FK to agency. Enables broker performance analysis on treaty placements, commission tracking for reinsurance intermediation

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Treaty structuring, rate adequacy analysis, and regulatory reporting require LOB master for NAIC line codes, loss ratio targets, and treaty applicability rules.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurer. Business justification: Treaty has denormalized reinsurer attributes (reinsurer_name, reinsurer_naic_code, reinsurer_share_pct). Adding FK to reinsurer master and removing redundant name and NAIC code.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance agreement under which this treaty is placed. Links treaty to the master agreement record.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: treaty_calendar_id
attributes.description: Date on which the treaty becomes binding and cessions may attach. Policies with inception on or after this date are eligible for cession under this treaty.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: aggregate_deductible
attributes.description: Cumulative loss amount the cedant must absorb before aggregate stop loss or aggregate XOL reinsurance attaches. Also known as the annual aggregate retention.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total reinsurance recovery across all occurrences during the treaty period. Caps cumulative recoveries for aggregate XOL and Stop Loss treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Dollar amount at which reinsurance coverage attaches for XOL and CAT XL treaties. Losses below this threshold are retained by the cedant. Null for proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized/accredited in the cedant's domicile state. Affects credit for reinsurance on the statutory balance sheet per NAIC requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Credit for Reinsurance; SAP SSAP No. 62R; State DOI

attributes.name: brokerage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium paid to the reinsurance intermediary as brokerage commission. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.5%).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: catastrophe_event_type
attributes.description: Peril type covered by a CAT XL treaty. Restricts recovery eligibility to specified catastrophe perils. Null for non-CAT treaties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WINDSTORM|EARTHQUAKE|FLOOD|WILDFIRE|HAIL|ALL_PERILS|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink; AIR Touchstone; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant as ceding commission under a proportional treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Null for XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cession_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%). Null for non-proportional treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer must post collateral (letter of credit or trust fund) to support credit for reinsurance on the cedant's statutory balance sheet.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Credit for Reinsurance; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Defines which losses are covered: Risks Attaching (policies incepting in treaty period), Losses Occurring (losses occurring in treaty period), or Claims Made.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treaty record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: deposit_premium
attributes.description: Provisional premium paid at treaty inception, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium. Common in proportional and adjustable XOL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the treaty expires and no new cessions may attach. Null for evergreen treaties. Used in Schedule F period-end calculations.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: hours_clause
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive hours within which losses from a single catastrophe event are aggregated for recovery purposes (e.g., 72 hours for windstorm, 168 hours for flood).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO CAT Reinsurance Standards; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: inception_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the treaty incepted. Used for underwriting year (UY) and policy year (PY) loss triangle segmentation in actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Sequential layer number within a tower of XOL or CAT XL protection (e.g., Layer 1, Layer 2). Distinguishes multiple treaties in the same program year.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery available under this treaty per occurrence or in aggregate. Defines the top of the layer for XOL/CAT XL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: loss_corridor_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the loss ratio corridor retained by the cedant in a Stop Loss treaty. Expressed as a decimal loss ratio (e.g., 0.7000 = 70%). Null for non-SL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: loss_corridor_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the loss ratio corridor at which Stop Loss reinsurance attaches. Expressed as a decimal loss ratio (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Null for non-SL treaties.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: minimum_premium
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of ceded subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against low-volume years.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: treaty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the treaty (e.g., 'Property CAT XL Layer 1 2024'). Used for human identification in reinsurance management system and bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the treaty by the cedant or reinsurer. Used in bordereaux reporting and Schedule F filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 790; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: occurrence_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery per single occurrence or event under this treaty. Distinct from aggregate limit. Applies to per-occurrence XOL and CAT XL structures.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: placement_pct
attributes.description: Total percentage of treaty capacity placed with all reinsurers combined. A value less than 1.0000 indicates a partially placed treaty with net retained gap.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: premium
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premium ceded to reinsurers under this treaty for the treaty period. For QS treaties, this is the ceded written premium. For XOL, this is the flat or deposit premium.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of treaty profit returned to the cedant as profit commission under a sliding scale or profit-sharing arrangement. Null if no profit commission applies.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty module

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of times the treaty limit may be reinstated after a loss exhausts the layer. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatements available.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original treaty premium charged to reinstate the treaty limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement).
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 62R; ISO Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the treaty capacity subscribed by the lead reinsurer. For fully placed treaties this may be 100%; for syndicated treaties it reflects the lead line.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained loss amount before reinsurance attaches. For XOL, this is the attachment point per occurrence. For QS, this is the retained percentage expressed as a dollar floor.
