attributes.description: Reference to the underlying cession record that this bordereaux line represents. Links to the Cession entity in the reinsurance domain.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim for claim-cession bordereaux lines. Null for premium-only cession lines. Links to the Claim entity in the claims domain.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Bordereaux line-level multi-currency aggregation is required for FX-adjusted ceded premium and loss reporting to foreign reinsurers.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event associated with this claim-cession line. Used for CAT XL treaty aggregation and PML/AAL reporting.
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink; Verisk AIR Touchstone; NAIC CAT reporting; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_exposure. Business justification: Bordereaux submissions to reinsurers report ceded loss at per-coverage-exposure granularity.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: Bordereaux lines submitted to reinsurers must identify each ceded insured risk directly for TIV, sum insured, and risk detail reporting.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Bordereaux reporting aggregates cessions by line for statutory filings; LOB master provides NAIC/ISO mappings and regulatory line definitions required for Schedule P and Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ceded policy. Enables linkage from the bordereaux line back to the full policy lifecycle in the policy domain.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; ACORD 715; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Each bordereaux line reports ceded written premium, earned premium, and reserves for a specific policy term. Reinsurers and cedants reconcile bordereaux lines against term-level premium records.

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to premium.premium_transaction. Business justification: Bordereaux lines report individual cessions to reinsurers with transaction-level detail.

attributes.name: reinsurer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer party record. Identifies the specific reinsurance counterparty receiving this cession for credit risk and Schedule F counterparty reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Customer/Party MDM; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which this cession is reported.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty/Facultative Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: ri_claim_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.ri_claim_cession. Business justification: reinsurance_bordereaux_line represents individual line items within a bordereaux submission, covering both premium and loss activity.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: reinsurance_bordereaux_line currently carries denormalized treaty_type and treaty_year but has no direct FK to treaty_layer.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Human-readable external identifier of the reinsurance treaty or facultative agreement under which this cession is reported. Used in bordereaux submissions to reinsurers.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 715

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cession is under a treaty (automatic) or facultative (individually negotiated) reinsurance agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: The loss threshold at which the XOL or CAT XL reinsurance layer attaches for this cession. Losses below this amount are retained by the cedant.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; ISO reinsurance standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: bordereaux_line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of this bordereaux line: premium cession, claim cession, adjustment, return premium, or reinstatement. Drives financial processing logic.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: catastrophe_code
attributes.description: Industry or internal catastrophe event code (e.g., PCS event number) associated with this cession line. Denormalized for bordereaux reporting and CAT XL aggregation.
attributes.references: PCS (Property Claim Services); RMS RiskLink; NAIC CAT reporting standards

attributes.name: ceded_earned_premium
attributes.description: The portion of earned premium ceded to the reinsurer for the reporting period. Used for loss ratio calculations and IFRS 17 insurance revenue reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_reserve
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve
attributes.description: Reinsurer's share of IBNR reserves allocated to this cession line. Used in actuarial reserving and Schedule F statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Actuarial Standards of Practice

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve

attributes.name: ceded_lae_paid
attributes.description: Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) paid by the reinsurer under this cession line. Includes ALAE and ULAE components ceded per agreement terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC LAE definitions

attributes.name: ceded_lae_reserve
attributes.description: Outstanding LAE reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer for this line. Represents the reinsurer's share of unpaid loss adjustment expenses.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_loss_paid
attributes.description: Losses paid by the reinsurer under this cession line to date. Represents actual cash recoveries received from the reinsurer for indemnity payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_loss_reserve
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer for this line. Represents the reinsurer's share of unpaid loss reserves (OSLR/RBNS).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: ceded_unearned_premium
attributes.description: The unearned portion of ceded written premium as of the reporting date. Represents the reinsurer's liability for unexpired risk. Used in balance sheet reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_written_premium
attributes.description: The portion of written premium ceded to the reinsurer under this agreement for this line. Key metric for Schedule F and bordereaux reporting. Expressed in reporting currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid by the reinsurer to the cedant on ceded premium for this line. Offsets acquisition costs. Applicable to quota share and surplus treaties.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module

attributes.name: ceding_commission_rate
attributes.description: The contractual rate applied to ceded premium to compute the ceding commission (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%). Defined in the reinsurance agreement terms.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the risk ceded to the reinsurer under this agreement line (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Applicable primarily to quota share treaties.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Cession Module; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and MAR.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); GLBA; SAP/SSAP No. 62

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert cession amounts to the reporting currency. Applicable when the ceded policy is denominated in a currency other than USD.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP/SSAP No. 23

attributes.name: gross_written_premium
attributes.description: Total gross written premium on the ceded policy for the cession period before reinsurance. Basis for computing ceded written premium. Expressed in reporting currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 62; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Name of the insured party on the ceded policy as reported on the bordereaux. Required by reinsurers for risk identification and facultative certificate matching.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cession line represents a retrocession (cession of assumed reinsurance) rather than a direct cession. True = retrocession; False = direct cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Retrocession Module

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this record within the parent bordereaux run. Used for ordering, reconciliation, and error identification during bordereaux processing.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; ACORD data standards

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this bordereaux line in the reinsurer settlement workflow. Tracks lifecycle from draft through acceptance or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the insured loss event for claim-cession lines. Used to determine treaty year applicability (accident year basis) and XOL layer attachment. Null for premium lines.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule P; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the ceded policy term became effective. Used to determine the applicable treaty year and cession period for bordereaux allocation.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the ceded policy term expires. Used with effective date to compute the cession period and pro-rata premium calculations.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC Schedule F; ACORD 125

attributes.name: rate_on_line
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a decimal — the ratio of reinsurance premium to the reinsurer's limit. Key pricing metric for XOL and CAT XL treaties.
attributes.references: ISO reinsurance standards; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer is liable to pay above the attachment point for this cession line. Defines the XOL layer limit (e.g., $5M xs $1M).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; ISO reinsurance standards; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_percentage
attributes.description: The specific reinsurer's participation percentage in the reinsurance agreement for this line (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% of a 100% placed treaty layer).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Treaty Module; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported (FNOL date) for claim-cession lines. Used for IBNR analysis and claims-made policy trigger determination.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Schedule P; ACORD 715

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux line. Together with start date defines the bordereaux reporting window.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; IFRS 17

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux line. Defines the window for premium and loss movements included in this submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; IFRS 17

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained loss amount for this cession line after reinsurance recovery. For XOL treaties, this is the SIR/retention layer below the attachment point.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; ISO reinsurance standards

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The originating system's unique identifier for this bordereaux line record (e.g., Sapiens ReinsurancePro internal line ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux Module; NAIC Schedule F reconciliation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was last modified. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR); GLBA; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

domains.name: risk
domains.description: Provisional description for user-specified domain 'risk_exposure'. Awaiting a generated description of what this domain owns.

products.name: insured_risk
products.description: Supertype master for every insurable object underwritten on a policy. One row per insured risk. Subtypes property_risk and auto_risk extend it via shared PK (explicit subtype FK).
products.reference: ACORD Insured Risk / ISO Risk Unit

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insured_risk data product (auto-inserted during validation).

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: insured_risk is the master risk record used for all accumulation, PML, and reinsurance reporting.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the geography hierarchy for this risk. Enables aggregation by state, county, city, postal code.

attributes.name: insured_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Core P&C underwriting process: every insured risk must be traceable to the named insured party for risk evaluation, premium booking, regulatory filings, and loss history lookup.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Every insured risk must be classified to a line of business for rating, loss reserving, regulatory reporting (Schedule P), and reinsurance treaty attachment.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term under which this risk is insured.

attributes.name: tiv_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: insured_risk carries tiv_amount, sum_insured_amount, and deductible_amount. Multi-currency commercial portfolios require a proper currency FK for exposure aggregation, reinsurance cession

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: Coinsurance percentage applicable to this risk. Triggers penalty if insurance-to-value falls below this threshold.

attributes.name: construction_code
attributes.description: ISO or NAIC construction type code. Part of COPE data for property risks.

attributes.name: created_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this insured risk record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insured risk record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Standard deductible amount applicable to this risk. May be overridden at coverage level.
attributes.references: ISO Policy Forms, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: deductible_type
attributes.description: Type of deductible applied to this risk. Determines how the deductible is calculated and applied at claim time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when coverage for this insured risk begins. Must fall within the policy term effective period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, ISO Policy Forms

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when coverage for this insured risk ends. Nullable for open-ended risks. Must not exceed policy term expiration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, ISO Policy Forms

attributes.name: exposure_basis
attributes.description: Unit of measure for rating exposure. Examples: square footage, payroll, sales, number of vehicles, number of employees.
attributes.references: ISO Rating Manuals, NAIC Exposure Definitions

attributes.name: exposure_units
attributes.description: Quantity of exposure units for rating purposes. Used to calculate premium based on rate per unit.
attributes.references: ISO Rating Manuals, NAIC Exposure Reporting

attributes.name: flood_zone_code
attributes.description: FEMA flood zone designation for this risk. Determines flood coverage eligibility and pricing.

attributes.name: geocode_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score for the geocoded coordinates, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00. Higher scores indicate more precise geocoding.

attributes.name: hazard_score
attributes.description: Catastrophe hazard score for this risk location. Derived from catastrophe modeling platforms.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent physical inspection of this risk was completed.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical inspection is required for this risk before binding or renewal.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inspection requirement for this risk.

attributes.name: itv_percentage
attributes.description: Ratio of sum insured to total insured value, expressed as percentage. Used to identify underinsurance and apply coinsurance penalties.
attributes.references: ISO Coinsurance Clause, NAIC Underwriting Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geocoded latitude coordinate for the risk location. Used in catastrophe modeling and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geocoded longitude coordinate for the risk location. Used in catastrophe modeling and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this insured risk record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insured risk record was last modified.

attributes.name: occupancy_code
attributes.description: ISO or NAIC occupancy classification code. Part of COPE data for property risks.

attributes.name: prior_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of prior losses for this risk or similar risks. Used in underwriting evaluation and pricing.

attributes.name: prior_loss_count
attributes.description: Number of prior losses reported for this risk or similar risks. Used in underwriting evaluation and pricing.

attributes.name: protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification or equivalent fire protection grade. Part of COPE data for property risks.
attributes.references: ISO PPC, NAIC Fire Protection Standards

attributes.name: rating_territory_code
attributes.description: Territory code used for rating and pricing this risk. Links to rating tables and catastrophe zones.
attributes.references: ISO Territory Definitions, State DOI Filings

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the insured risk. Appears on policy declarations and endorsements.

attributes.name: risk_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the insured risk, unique within the policy. Used on declarations pages and endorsements.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Underwriting risk score assigned to this insured risk. Higher scores indicate higher risk. Used in pricing and underwriting decisions.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insured risk within the policy term.

attributes.name: sum_insured_amount
attributes.description: Sum insured representing the policy limit applicable to this risk. May differ from total insured value based on underwriting decisions.

attributes.name: tiv_amount
attributes.description: Total insured value representing the maximum exposure for this risk. Used in catastrophe modeling and aggregate exposure reporting.
attributes.references: RMS RiskLink, AIR Touchstone, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: underwriter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the underwriter regarding this insured risk. May contain risk assessment details and special conditions.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the insured value was last assessed or updated. Used for insurance-to-value calculations.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the insured value of the risk. Drives claims settlement basis.
attributes.references: ISO Policy Forms, NAIC Model Laws

products.name: property_risk
products.description: Property-line subtype of insured_risk. One row per property risk. Captures COPE attributes (Construction, Occupancy, Protection, Exposure), ITV, year built, square footage, and ISO construction class for rating and CAT modeling.

attributes.name: property_risk_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the property_risk data product (auto-inserted during validation).

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat zone assignment on property_risk drives accumulation limit enforcement, reinsurance treaty attachment point calculation, and underwriting restriction checks.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: property_risk holds replacement_cost_value, actual_cash_value, and total_insured_value. Multi-currency commercial property portfolios require currency linkage for accurate TIV aggregation

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Property underwriting, cat accumulation reporting, and reinsurance treaty attachment all require property_risk to be assigned to a catastrophe geography.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the parent insured risk supertype record.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Property risks span multiple LOBs (commercial property, homeowners, dwelling fire, inland marine) with distinct ISO forms, rating plans, and state filing requirements.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the location record where this property risk is situated.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term under which this property risk is insured.

attributes.name: property_owner_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Property underwriting requires direct link to property owner party for title verification, loss payee validation, and insured interest determination.

attributes.name: actual_cash_value
attributes.description: The replacement cost value minus depreciation. Used for certain policy forms and loss settlement.

attributes.name: basement_finish_type
attributes.description: The level of finish in the basement, if present. Impacts valuation and loss potential.

attributes.name: basement_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a basement. Impacts flood and water damage risk.

attributes.name: burglar_alarm_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a burglar or intrusion alarm system. May provide premium credit.

attributes.name: central_station_monitoring_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether alarm systems are monitored by a central station. Provides additional premium credit.

attributes.name: coinsurance_percentage
attributes.description: The coinsurance percentage required by the policy form, typically 80%, 90%, or 100%. Used to calculate coinsurance penalties at claim time.

attributes.name: construction_type
attributes.description: The construction class of the building. Part of COPE attributes. Examples: frame, joisted masonry, non-combustible, masonry non-combustible, modified fire resistive, fire resistive.

attributes.name: cooling_type
attributes.description: The type of cooling or air conditioning system. Examples: central air, window units, evaporative, none.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this property risk record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_hydrant_feet
attributes.description: Distance in feet from the property to the nearest fire hydrant. Impacts protection class and rating.

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_station_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the property to the nearest responding fire station. Impacts protection class and rating.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this property risk record is effective under the policy term.

attributes.name: electrical_system_type
attributes.description: The type of electrical system. Examples: circuit breaker, fuse box, knob and tube. Impacts fire risk.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this property risk record expires or is no longer in force under the policy term.

attributes.name: exposure_description
attributes.description: Description of external exposures that may increase risk. Part of COPE attributes. Examples: proximity to brush, adjacent buildings, hazardous operations nearby.

attributes.name: fire_alarm_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a fire alarm or smoke detection system. May provide premium credit.

attributes.name: foundation_type
attributes.description: The type of foundation supporting the structure. Impacts flood and earthquake risk.

attributes.name: heating_type
attributes.description: The type of heating system. Examples: forced air, electric, oil, gas, heat pump, wood stove. Impacts fire and equipment breakdown risk.

attributes.name: insurance_to_value_percentage
attributes.description: The ratio of insured value to replacement cost value, expressed as a percentage. Used to assess adequacy of coverage and apply coinsurance penalties.

attributes.name: iso_construction_code
attributes.description: ISO standard construction classification code used for rating and catastrophe modeling.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the property risk, often used in underwriting and rating systems.

attributes.name: number_of_stories
attributes.description: The number of above-ground stories or floors in the building.

attributes.name: number_of_units
attributes.description: The number of dwelling units or rental units in the property, if applicable for multi-family or commercial properties.

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: The use or occupancy of the property. Part of COPE attributes for underwriting and rating. Examples: owner-occupied, tenant-occupied, retail, office, manufacturing, warehouse.

attributes.name: plumbing_type
attributes.description: The type of plumbing material. Examples: copper, PVC, galvanized, PEX. Impacts water damage risk.

attributes.name: property_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the property risk record within the policy term.

attributes.name: protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification or similar fire protection rating. Part of COPE attributes. Lower numbers indicate better fire protection.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_value
attributes.description: The estimated cost to replace the property with materials of like kind and quality at current prices.

attributes.name: roof_shape
attributes.description: The architectural shape of the roof. Impacts wind resistance and catastrophe modeling.

attributes.name: roof_type
attributes.description: The type of roofing material. Examples: asphalt shingle, tile, metal, flat, slate. Impacts wind and hail risk.

attributes.name: roof_year
attributes.description: The year the roof was installed or last replaced. Used for age-based rating and underwriting decisions.

attributes.name: sprinkler_system_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has an automatic fire sprinkler system. Provides premium credit and reduces fire loss potential.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the property. Used for rating, valuation, and catastrophe exposure aggregation.

attributes.name: total_insured_value
attributes.description: The total insured value of the property risk. Used for catastrophe exposure aggregation, reinsurance cession, and PML modeling.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this property risk record was last modified.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the property was last valued or appraised.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine the insured value. Examples: appraisal, cost estimator tool, market value, agreed value, stated amount.

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: The year the property was originally constructed. Used for age-based rating and risk assessment.

attributes.name: year_renovated
attributes.description: The year of the most recent major renovation or remodel, if applicable.

products.name: vehicle

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: garaging_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the address where the vehicle is primarily garaged. Used for territory rating.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Auto physical damage cat accumulation (hail, flood) is tracked by vehicle garaging geography. Reinsurance treaties and cat model runs require vehicle-level geography assignment.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Vehicles are rated and reported under Personal Auto or Commercial Auto LOB. Schedule P statutory reporting, rating algorithms, and regulatory filings (SR-22 eligibility, UM/UIM

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the policy term under which this vehicle is insured.

attributes.name: registered_owner_party_id

attributes.name: abs_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with anti-lock braking system. Safety feature for rating.

attributes.name: actual_cash_value
attributes.description: Current market value of the vehicle accounting for depreciation. Used for total loss settlements.

attributes.name: airbag_count
attributes.description: Number of airbags installed in the vehicle. Safety feature used for rating.

attributes.name: annual_mileage
attributes.description: Estimated or actual annual miles driven. Key rating variable for exposure calculation.

attributes.name: anti_theft_device_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with an anti-theft device. May qualify for premium discount.

products.name: claim
products.description: Claim: one row per reported loss. The master claim record representing a reported loss event against a policy. Grain: one row per reported loss.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the claim. Primary key. Grain: one row per reported loss.

attributes.name: binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.binder. Business justification: Claims occurring during the binder period must be adjudicated against binder terms (effective date, coverage limits, premium) before the formal policy is issued.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Claim loss location must be assigned to a cat zone for reinsurance treaty attachment point calculations, PML aggregation, and underwriting moratorium enforcement.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the catastrophe event if this claim is CAT-related.

attributes.name: fac_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.fac_agreement. Business justification: Facultative reinsurance recovery billing requires identifying which fac_agreement covers a given claim.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Catastrophe managers aggregate claims by geography for PML monitoring, CRESTA zone reporting, and state-level regulatory filings.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Normalize lob_code string to FK reference to shared.line_of_business master data. Claim currently stores lob_code as string; replacing with FK enables consistent LOB classification

attributes.name: loss_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference (BIGINT) linking loss event id in the claim product to the loss_event product in the claim domain.

attributes.name: loss_location_address_id

products.name: reserve
products.description: Reserve: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Records reserve transactions (Case, IBNR, LAE) per claim exposure and accounting period. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reserve position record. One row per reserve type per claim exposure per accounting period. Grain: one reserve movement per claim exposure per period.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjuster who authorized or last modified this reserve position. Required for reserve authority and audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (supervisor or manager) who approved this reserve movement when it exceeded adjuster authority limits. Null if no approval was required.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Reserve development triangles and IBNR calculations are the core of P&C actuarial work; each reserve movement must be period-keyed to the enterprise calendar.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Actuarial Schedule P loss development triangles are segmented by cat zone. Reserve records need cat_zone_id for aggregate reserve monitoring by zone, reinsurance recoverable calculations

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Reserves track ceded amounts (ceded_opening_balance_amount, ceded_movement_amount) requiring direct cession link for monthly reserve adequacy reporting and Schedule F preparation.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level aggregation and reporting without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this reserve position is recorded. Enables calendar year, accident year, and policy year reserve triangles.
attributes.references: SAP SSAP No. 55; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the coverage under which this reserve is established. Supports reserve analysis by coverage type and line of business.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency claim operations require currency master for exchange rate lookup, functional currency conversion, rounding rules, and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event record when the claim is associated with a declared CAT. Null for non-catastrophe claims. Supports CAT aggregate reserve reporting.
attributes.references: ISO PCS; NAIC Schedule P; RMS RiskLink / AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) to which this reserve position belongs. Links reserve to a specific coverage and insured risk within the claim.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Actuarial reserve triangles are developed by peril for loss development analysis, reinsurance reporting, and NAIC cause-of-loss statutory filings.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.policy. Business justification: Reserve adequacy reviews and reinsurance bordereau reporting require direct policy-level reserve aggregation for written premium vs. incurred loss ratio analysis.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Actuarial Schedule P triangle development and reinsurance bordereau reporting require reserves attributed to the specific policy term (policy year).

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: Actuaries segment reserve adequacy by risk characteristics (construction type, protection class, vehicle type, driver profile) for accurate loss development and catastrophe

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss triangle development and actuarial reserving analysis per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reserve movement was approved by the authorizing supervisor or manager. Null if no approval was required for this movement.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reserve amount the authorizing adjuster is permitted to set without escalation per the claims reserving authority matrix. Supports reserve governance and SOX controls.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserve amounts are stated on a Gross (before reinsurance), Net (after reinsurance), or Ceded (reinsurer share only) basis for this record.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: case_reserve_adequacy_flag
attributes.description: Actuarial or supervisory assessment of whether the case reserve is adequate relative to the expected ultimate loss. Used in reserve review and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; ASOP No. 43; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: catastrophe_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Enables CAT vs. non-CAT reserve segregation for PML analysis and reinsurance recovery tracking.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Bulletin; NAIC Schedule P; RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: Broad financial category of the reserve: Loss (indemnity), Expense (LAE/DCC/AO), Salvage (anticipated recovery from salvage), or Subrogation (anticipated recovery from third parties).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: ceded_closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing reserve balance ceded to reinsurers. Net reserve equals closing balance minus ceded closing balance. Required for Schedule F statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change in the ceded reserve portion during the accounting period. Supports net reserve calculation and reinsurance bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: ceded_opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the opening reserve balance ceded to reinsurers under applicable treaties or facultative agreements. Used for net reserve and Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance at the end of the accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Equals opening balance plus movement amount. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which this reserve is allocated for management accounting and expense reporting purposes. Supports departmental P&L and RBC capital allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reserve record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to the end of the accounting period. Used to position this reserve in the loss development triangle (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reserve position becomes effective for financial reporting purposes. May differ from the transaction date for period-end adjustments and actuarial entries.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this reserve movement is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems. Supports financial close and Schedule P reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP/Oracle GL; NAIC Annual Statement; SOX; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ibnr_factor
attributes.description: Actuarial development factor applied to derive the IBNR reserve component. Sourced from the actuarial reserving system loss development triangle for the applicable LOB and accident year.
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date of the underlying loss event that gave rise to this claim and reserve. Denormalized from the claim for accident year triangle development without additional joins.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Methodology used to establish or update this reserve: Case_Estimate (adjuster judgment), Formula (system-calculated), Actuarial (actuarial model output), Bulk (portfolio-level), or Tabular (mortality/morbidity table).
attributes.references: ASOP No. 43; NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: movement_amount
attributes.description: Incremental change to the reserve during the accounting period. Positive value indicates reserve strengthening; negative value indicates reserve release. Gross of reinsurance.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: movement_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the reserve movement in this period (e.g., NEW_RESERVE, STRENGTHENING, PARTIAL_RELEASE, FULL_RELEASE, PAYMENT_OFFSET, REOPEN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserving module; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: movement_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the adjuster or actuarial team explaining the basis for the reserve movement. Supports audit trail and reserve review documentation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this reserve record, typically assigned by the claims management system. Used in bordereaux and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Reserve balance carried forward from the prior accounting period for this claim exposure and reserve type. Starting point for the period movement calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was written. Supports policy year (PY) reserve development triangles distinct from accident year analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Estimated reinsurance recoverable on this reserve position based on applicable treaty or facultative cession. Supports Schedule F reporting and net reserve calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported to the insurer (FNOL date). Used to compute report lag and support IBNR development analysis in actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ASOP No. 43; Guidewire ClaimCenter FNOL module

attributes.name: requires_supervisor_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve movement exceeded the adjuster authority limit and required supervisor or management approval before posting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reserve position. Open reserves are active; Closed reserves have been fully settled or released; Reopened indicates a previously closed reserve reactivated.

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reserve: Case (known reported loss), IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported), LAE (Loss Adjustment Expense), ULAE (Unallocated LAE), ALAE (Allocated LAE), or DCC (Defense & Cost Containment).
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP; Schedule P Instructions

attributes.name: salvage_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated salvage recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is reported separately in NAIC statutory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system that originated this reserve record: ClaimCenter, DuckCreek, Legacy, Manual (spreadsheet entry), or Actuarial (reserving system upload).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Duck Creek Claims; Data Warehouse / Actuarial Reserving System

attributes.name: subrogation_anticipated_amount
attributes.description: Estimated subrogation recovery anticipated on this claim exposure. Reduces the net reserve position and is tracked separately for recovery management and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SSAP No. 55; SAP Statutory Accounting; Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the reserve movement was entered into the claims management system. Used for CY (Calendar Year) reporting and reconciliation to the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reserve record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trail, and change data capture in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; GLBA

products.name: claim_payment
products.description: Payment: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Records payment transactions per claim exposure and accounting period. Grain: one row per financial movement per claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim payment disbursement record. Primary key. One row per payment per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.adjuster. Business justification: Claim payments require adjuster authorization up to their authority_limit_amount. Linking claim_payment.adjuster_id to adjuster.adjuster_id records which adjuster authorized the payment

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Paid loss reporting by calendar period is required for GAAP financial close, NAIC Schedule P, and reinsurance bordereaux.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat zone on payment records enables reinsurance treaty layer allocation and aggregate excess-of-loss payment tracking.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this payment is issued. Links payment to the reported loss event.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claimant. Business justification: Indemnity payments are made to specific claimants. Linking claim_payment.claimant_id to claimant.claimant_id identifies which claimant receives each payment, supporting 1099 reporting, release

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this payment is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: International claim payments require currency master for exchange rate application, withholding tax calculation, bank account validation, and functional currency conversion.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Catastrophe claim payments must be aggregated by event for reinsurance bordereau submissions, FEMA disaster reporting, and cat bond trigger monitoring.

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this payment is charged. Grain anchor per VREQ-007.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Payment authority limits, commission calculations, and loss ratio monitoring are configured by line of business.

attributes.name: original_payment_claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payment record when this row represents a reissue or replacement. Null for original disbursements.

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Peril-level payment tracking is required for NAIC cause-of-loss statutory reporting and reinsurance cession calculations where treaty coverage is peril-specific.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: NAIC annual statement Schedule P and reinsurance treaty bordereau require paid losses attributed to the policy term.

attributes.name: primary_claim_party_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the claims examiner or supervisor who authorized this payment within the authority limit matrix.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: Subrogation departments track recovery potential by specific vehicle VIN or property address.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: ap_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the AP disbursement batch in which this payment was grouped for bank settlement. Used for batch reconciliation in Oracle/SAP AP module.

attributes.name: authority_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum payment amount the authorizing user was permitted to approve per the claims authority matrix at the time of authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter Authority Matrix

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Internal authorization or approval code assigned by the claims supervisor or authority matrix before payment release. Supports SOX payment controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter Authority Matrix; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: bank_account_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the company bank account from which the payment was funded. Supports multi-bank disbursement and reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP AP Module; SOX; PCI DSS

attributes.name: check_eft_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Check / Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Reference Number
attributes.description: Check number or EFT transaction reference issued by the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation and stop-payment processing.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Oracle/SAP AP Module; NACHA EFT Standards

tag_set.value: Check / Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Reference Number

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the payment instrument cleared the bank. Null until the check or EFT is confirmed settled. Used for outstanding check reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which the payment expense is allocated for management accounting and expense ratio reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL Module; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the coverage part under which this payment is charged (e.g., HO-Dwelling, PAP-Liability, CGL-BI). Aligns payment to the policy coverage for Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: ISO Forms Library; NAIC Schedule P; ACORD 125/126

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was first created in the claims management system. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: deductible_offset_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the payment attributable to the insured's deductible or Self-Insured Retention (SIR) that is to be collected back from the policyholder.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Policy terms; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which this payment is posted in the statutory and GAAP accounting systems for financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL Module; SAP/SSAP; US GAAP; IFRS 17

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount disbursed before any deductions, withholdings, or offsets. Denominated in the currency indicated by currency_code.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC. Drives year-end tax reporting extract.

attributes.name: is_final_payment
attributes.description: Indicates this payment closes the claim exposure financially. When true, triggers reserve release and exposure closure workflow in ClaimCenter.

attributes.name: is_structured_settlement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is part of a structured settlement annuity arrangement rather than a lump-sum disbursement.
attributes.references: Structured Settlement Protection Acts; IRC Section 130; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: loss_category
attributes.description: Detailed loss sub-category classifying the nature of the payment: Bodily Injury (BI), Property Damage (PD), Medical Payments (MP), Uninsured Motorist (UM), etc.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ISO CGL; PAP; ACORD

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the payee after withholding and deductions. Net = gross_payment_amount minus withholding_amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payment recipient as printed on the check or EFT remittance. May differ from the claimant name (e.g., attorney, lienholder, mortgagee).

attributes.name: payee_tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) of the payee for IRS 1099 reporting. Masked in non-privileged access tiers.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the payee. Used for calendar year (CY) and accident year (AY) loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP; Schedule P

attributes.name: payment_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the purpose or nature of the payment (e.g., 'Partial settlement for dwelling damage', 'Attorney fee disbursement').
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to disburse funds to the payee (paper check, ACH, wire transfer, EFT, draft, or virtual card).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; Guidewire BillingCenter

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the claims payment system or AP module. Used for reconciliation and payee inquiries.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment instrument. Tracks issuance through clearance, void, stop-payment, reissue, and return workflows in ClaimCenter.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by financial category: indemnity (loss), medical, Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE), Defense & Cost Containment (DCC), Adjusting & Other (AO), or recovery offset.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ISO

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of this payment expected to be recovered from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used for net loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R; IFRS 17; Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: reissue_date
attributes.description: Date a replacement payment was reissued after a void or stop-payment. Links to the original payment via original_payment_id for audit trail.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: remittance_memo
attributes.description: Short memo line printed on the check or included in the EFT remittance advice to the payee. Typically includes claim number and coverage description.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this payment was flagged for Special Investigations Unit (SIU) review due to suspected fraud. Payment may be held pending SIU clearance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Fraud Detection/SIU System; FCRA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this payment record was ingested into the lakehouse Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this payment for regulatory reporting and state DOI compliance purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; State DOI; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: stop_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates a stop-payment order has been placed on this check with the issuing bank. Triggers reissue workflow and outstanding check reconciliation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP AP Module; UCC Article 4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Guidewire ClaimCenter; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: void_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was voided. Populated only when payment_status is Voided. Triggers reversal entries in the general ledger.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Oracle/SAP GL Module; SOX

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross payment for tax withholding, Medicare Set-Aside (MSA), or other statutory deductions before net disbursement.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099; Medicare Secondary Payer Act; SAP

products.name: recovery
products.description: Recovery: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Records recovery transactions (Subrogation, Salvage, Reinsurance) per claim exposure and accounting period.

attributes.name: recovery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim recovery transaction. One row per recovery transaction per claim exposure per accounting period.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster or recovery specialist responsible for managing and pursuing this recovery transaction.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery collections are reported by calendar period for GAAP net loss reporting and reinsurance bordereaux.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery amounts must be allocated to cat zones for net reinsurance recovery calculations and treaty settlement.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance cession record when recovery_type is reinsurance. Null for subrogation and salvage recoveries.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Denormalized for direct claim-level reporting and aggregation without joining through claim exposure.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original claim payment transaction that this recovery offsets. Links recovery to the indemnity payment for net loss calculation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Payments module; SAP/SSAP No. 65

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this recovery transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries must tie to the coverage that paid the original loss for proper reserve relief, reinsurance accounting, and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency recovery operations (reinsurance collections, subrogation from foreign insurers, salvage auctions) require currency master for demand amount conversion, collection tracking

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) against which this recovery is applied.

attributes.name: geography_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.geography. Business justification: Geographic attribution of recoveries supports state-level net loss reporting and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery tracking, reinsurance recovery allocation, and net loss ratio calculation require LOB master for treaty participation rules, recovery expense

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recovery reporting by policy year for Schedule P net loss calculations and reinsurance net recovery bordereau requires term-level attribution.

attributes.name: responsible_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party from whom recovery is sought: tortfeasor for subrogation, salvage buyer for salvage, or reinsurer for reinsurance recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; ACORD standards

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which a reinsurance recovery is claimed. Null for subrogation and salvage.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsurancePro; NAIC Schedule F; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.salvage. Business justification: Recovery is the transaction record for collected amounts. Salvage is the master record for salvage activity.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for accident year (AY) loss development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: YYYY-MM formatted period for which this recovery is included in reinsurance bordereaux reporting to the reinsurer. Applicable for reinsurance recoveries.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux module; SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery file was formally closed, either after full collection, settlement, or abandonment of pursuit.

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount actually received from the responsible party or reinsurer prior to deducting collection expenses or attorney fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: collected_date
attributes.description: Date on which recovery funds were actually received and posted. Null if recovery has not yet been collected.

attributes.name: collection_expense_amount
attributes.description: Costs incurred to pursue and collect the recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation expenses. Deducted to derive net recovery.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; ALAE/DCC definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recovery record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount formally demanded from the responsible party or reinsurer. Represents the maximum expected recovery before negotiation or adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: demand_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal demand for recovery was first issued to the responsible party, tortfeasor, or reinsurer.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this recovery transaction is posted for statutory and GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; Oracle/SAP GL module

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal action has been filed to pursue this recovery. True when a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding is active.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Mechanism used to pursue or collect the recovery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demand_letter|litigation|negotiated_settlement|auction|bordereaux|direct_bill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation module; NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery amount after deducting collection expenses from collected amount. Used for statutory reporting and loss ratio calculations (NWP basis).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing adjuster commentary, negotiation history, legal strategy notes, or other contextual information about this recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this recovery transaction, used in bordereaux reporting, correspondence, and audit trails.
attributes.references: ACORD data standards; NAIC Bordereaux Reporting

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Check number, wire transfer reference, EFT trace number, or other payment instrument identifier for the collected recovery funds.
attributes.references: Guidewire BillingCenter; PCI DSS; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recovery transaction: open (demand issued), collected (funds received), closed (finalized), void (cancelled), or disputed.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the recovery: subrogation (pursuit of third-party tortfeasor), salvage (sale of damaged property), reinsurance (ceded loss recovery), or other.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 65; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: ri_participation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the ceded loss recoverable from the reinsurer under the applicable treaty or facultative agreement (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro Bordereaux

attributes.name: ri_recovery_basis
attributes.description: Reinsurance structure under which the recovery is claimed: quota share (QS), excess of loss (XOL), stop loss (SL), or facultative (FAC).
attributes.references: SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: salvage_item_description
attributes.description: Description of the salvaged property or item sold, including condition, make/model for vehicles, or material type for property salvage.

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of salvage recovery: total loss vehicle, damaged property, scrap material, or auction proceeds. Applicable only when recovery_type is salvage.
attributes.references: ISO P&C standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter Salvage module

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery has been referred to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) for fraud investigation or suspicious activity review.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this recovery transaction (e.g., ClaimCenter, ReinsurancePro, BillingCenter, or manual entry).
attributes.references: Data governance; SOX; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the right of recovery. Critical for subrogation diary management and SIU oversight.
attributes.references: State DOI regulations; NAIC Model Laws; FCRA

attributes.name: subrogation_basis
attributes.description: Legal theory under which subrogation is pursued: tort (negligence), contract (breach), statutory (workers comp lien), or equitable subrogation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws; State DOI regulations; ISO P&C standards

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The real-world date on which the recovery event occurred: demand issued, settlement agreed, payment received, or salvage sale completed.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 65; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17 para 38

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this recovery record. Used for change data capture, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR)

products.name: salvage
products.description: Master record for salvage activity on a total-loss insured item. Tracks salvage value estimate, auction proceeds, title transfer status, storage costs, net salvage amount, and disposition method per claim exposure.

attributes.name: salvage_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the salvage record. One row per salvage activity per claim exposure on a total-loss insured item.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.adjuster. Business justification: Salvage disposition is managed by an assigned adjuster responsible for coordinating auction, title transfer, and proceeds collection.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat zone on salvage records enables geographic concentration analysis of total-loss inventory and reinsurance salvage share calculations per treaty zone.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim under which this salvage activity is recorded.

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_payment. Business justification: Salvage auction proceeds are disbursed or offset via a claim payment. Claim accounting and GL reconciliation require direct traceability from salvage disposition to the payment

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which salvage proceeds are recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Salvage auction proceeds, storage costs, and net salvage calculations require currency master for multi-currency total loss settlements, reinsurance salvage share allocation, and functional

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Reinsurers require net-of-salvage loss reporting by catastrophe event for bordereaux and treaty settlement.

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) that generated this salvage activity.

attributes.name: insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insured risk (vehicle, property, etc.) that is the subject of salvage disposition.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Salvage disposition workflows and net salvage reporting differ materially by LOB (auto total-loss vs property salvage).

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.party. Business justification: Salvage has vendor_name and vendor_code (STRING) for the salvage vendor (auction house, salvage yard). Vendors are payees. Adding vendor_payee_id FK normalizes vendor master data.

attributes.name: storage_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to party.address. Business justification: Salvage storage location must reference a canonical geocoded address for vendor management, logistics routing, catastrophe zone tracking of stored assets, state title-transfer compliance, and

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage item was formally assigned to the salvage vendor or auction house for disposition.

attributes.name: auction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the salvaged item was auctioned or sold. Used to align proceeds recognition with the correct accounting period.

attributes.name: auction_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by the auction house or salvage vendor for facilitating the sale, deducted from gross proceeds to arrive at net salvage.

attributes.name: auction_proceeds
