attributes.description: Gross cash proceeds received from the auction or direct sale of the salvaged item before deducting storage, towing, and auction fees.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity that purchased the salvaged item at auction or direct sale.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: buyer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage buyer. Determines applicable title transfer rules and tax reporting obligations.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate of destruction or salvage certificate number issued by the state DMV or relevant authority for the disposed item.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the salvage activity was closed, indicating all proceeds collected, title transferred, and financials reconciled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the salvage record was first created in the claims management system.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter audit trail

attributes.name: disposition_method
attributes.description: Method by which the salvaged item is disposed of. Impacts net salvage calculation and title transfer obligations.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which the net salvage proceeds are posted in the statutory and GAAP general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; Oracle/SAP GL module; SOX

attributes.name: insured_retained_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured elected to retain the salvaged item, resulting in a deduction from the total-loss settlement payment.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; state DOI total-loss regulations

attributes.name: insured_retention_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the total-loss settlement when the insured elects to retain the salvaged item, equal to the salvage value estimate.
attributes.references: ISO PAP/CA forms; SAP/SSAP No. 55; state DOI regulations

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the salvaged item including make, model, year, condition, or property type to support valuation and disposition.

attributes.name: net_salvage_amount
attributes.description: Net proceeds from salvage after deducting storage, towing, and auction fees from gross auction proceeds. Credited against claim payments.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; NAIC Schedule P; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text adjuster notes capturing disposition decisions, buyer negotiations, title issues, or other relevant salvage activity details.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the salvage record, used in bordereaux, vendor communications, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the net salvage proceeds is recoverable by or creditable to a reinsurer under treaty or facultative agreement.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: reinsurance_salvage_share
attributes.description: Portion of net salvage proceeds attributable to reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreement, per SSAP No. 62R.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: salvage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the salvage activity. Drives workflow in ClaimCenter Recovery module and financial recognition timing.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: salvage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the salvage by asset category. Determines applicable disposition rules, title transfer requirements, and accounting treatment.
attributes.references: ISO forms; NAIC Annual Statement instructions

attributes.name: siu_referral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this salvage activity has been referred to the SIU for fraud investigation (e.g., staged total loss).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Fraud Act; Guidewire ClaimCenter SIU module

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the salvage activity occurs, used for state DOI reporting and title transfer jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC state codes; state DOI regulations; USPS state abbreviations

attributes.name: storage_cost
attributes.description: Cumulative cost of storing the salvaged item from date of loss to date of disposition, deducted from gross proceeds.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Expense module; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: storage_end_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item was removed from storage upon sale, transfer, or destruction.

attributes.name: storage_start_date
attributes.description: Date the salvaged item entered storage, used to calculate accrued storage costs and vendor billing.

attributes.name: title_number
attributes.description: State-issued salvage title number assigned to the vehicle or property after total-loss declaration, required for legal resale.
attributes.references: State DMV regulations; state DOI total-loss rules

attributes.name: title_received_date
attributes.description: Date the insurer physically received the signed title document from the insured, initiating the transfer process.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: title_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the title of the salvaged item was legally transferred from the insured to the insurer or designated buyer.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; DMV title transfer rules

attributes.name: title_transfer_status
attributes.description: Status of the vehicle or property title transfer from the insured to the insurer or salvage buyer. Required for total-loss compliance.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss regulations; DMV title transfer rules

attributes.name: total_loss_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured item was declared a total loss, triggering full salvage disposition and title transfer requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI total-loss threshold regulations; ISO PAP/CA forms

attributes.name: towing_cost
attributes.description: Cost of towing or transporting the salvaged item to the storage yard or auction facility, deducted from gross proceeds.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the salvage record, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GLBA; Guidewire ClaimCenter audit trail

attributes.name: value_estimate
attributes.description: Appraised or estimated market value of the salvaged item prior to auction or sale, used to set reserve and evaluate offers.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; Guidewire ClaimCenter Reserve module

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number for salvaged vehicles, used for title transfer, DMV reporting, and CLUE database updates.

products.name: expense
products.description: Expense: one row per financial movement per claim exposure. Records expense transactions (LAE, DCC, AO) per claim exposure and accounting period.

attributes.name: expense_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim expense transaction record. Primary key for the claim_expense table. One row per expense movement per claim exposure and accounting period.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster responsible for authorizing or submitting this expense. Links expense to the handling adjuster for workload and cost reporting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Adjuster entity; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (adjuster supervisor or manager) who approved this expense transaction. Required for audit trail and authority-level compliance.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.approvedBy; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: LAE expense reporting by calendar period is required for NAIC Schedule P DCC/ALAE reporting and GAAP financial close.

attributes.name: cat_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.cat_zone. Business justification: Cat zone on expense records supports treaty-level LAE cession calculations and aggregate stop-loss monitoring.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record. Enables direct claim-level aggregation of all expense transactions without joining through claim exposure.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Claim entity; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_payment. Business justification: LAE and DCC expenses are often disbursed via a claim payment (e.g., a check to a vendor or expert witness).

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claimant. Business justification: Claim expenses (medical, legal, expert) are often incurred on behalf of a specific claimant.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period in which this expense transaction is recognized for statutory and GAAP financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage. Business justification: LAE allocation to coverage line is required for Schedule P reporting, reinsurance bordereaux, and actuarial reserving.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency claim expense processing (foreign adjuster fees, international expert invoices, cross-border legal costs) requires currency master for functional currency conversion

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.catastrophe_event. Business justification: Cat LAE (Loss Adjustment Expenses) is a distinct reporting category for reinsurance bordereaux and NAIC Schedule P catastrophe reporting.

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claim exposure (coverage line within a claim) to which this expense is allocated. Links expense to the specific coverage and insured risk.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — ClaimExposure entity; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: LAE allocation, expense ratio monitoring, and reinsurance expense recovery require LOB master for ALAE vs ULAE classification rules, treaty expense participation, and regulatory

attributes.name: original_expense_claim_expense_id
attributes.description: For reversal transactions, references the claim_expense_id of the original expense being reversed. Null for original (non-reversal) expense transactions.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Transaction reversal linkage; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: LAE reporting by policy year for NAIC Schedule P Part 2 and reinsurance treaty bordereau requires expenses attributed to the specific policy term.

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: Expense management tracks inspection costs by property type, engineering report costs by construction class, and appraisal fees by vehicle type.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the underlying loss event occurred. Used for accident-year LAE development triangles and actuarial reserving analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the expense transaction in the policy currency before any adjustments or recoveries. Positive for charges; negative for reversals or credits.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 55; GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17 para 51

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the expense was approved by the authorized approver. Used for SLA measurement and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the expense. Expenses above authority thresholds require supervisor or management approval before payment can be issued.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense approval workflow; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check or EFT reference number issued for payment of this expense. Used for bank reconciliation and positive pay verification. Null for non-check payments.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center or department code responsible for this expense. Supports management reporting, expense allocation, and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this expense record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-retention compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: expense_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the services rendered or expense incurred as provided by the adjuster or vendor. Used for audit review and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.description; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the expense from transaction currency to functional currency at the transaction date. Stored for audit and restatement purposes.

attributes.name: expense_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expense was incurred or the service was rendered. Used for accident-year and policy-year LAE allocation in Schedule P reporting.

attributes.name: expense_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this expense transaction. Used in vendor correspondence, GL postings, and audit trails.

attributes.name: expense_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the expense transaction from initial entry through approval, payment, and potential voiding or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.status; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the nature of the expense. Drives GL account mapping and regulatory cost categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: legal_fee|expert_witness|medical_exam|investigation|appraisal|court_cost|adjuster_fee|other — promote to reference
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Expense.type; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Expense amount converted to the company functional currency (USD) using the exchange rate at transaction date. Used for consolidated statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account code to which this expense is posted in the general ledger. Drives statutory Schedule P line assignment and GAAP income statement classification.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date printed on the vendor invoice. Used for accounts payable aging, payment terms calculation, and late-payment penalty assessment.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice or billing reference number issued by the vendor. Used for three-way matching (PO, receipt, invoice) and duplicate payment prevention.

attributes.name: invoice_received_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was received by the claims department. Used to measure vendor billing timeliness and trigger payment due-date calculations.

attributes.name: is_dcc_expense
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) Expense Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense is classified as Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) per NAIC Schedule P definitions. Distinct from AO (Adjusting and Other) expenses.

tag_set.value: Defense and Cost Containment (DCC) Expense Flag

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense is subject to reinsurance recovery under a treaty or facultative agreement. Drives cession and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: Reinsurance treaty terms; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/SSAP No. 62R

attributes.name: lae_category
attributes.description: Classifies the expense into LAE sub-categories: ALAE (Allocated LAE), ULAE (Unallocated LAE), DCC (Defense and Cost Containment), or AO (Adjusting and Other). Required for Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP/SSAP No. 55; ISO standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expense was actually disbursed to the vendor or payee. Null if the expense has not yet been paid. Used for cash-basis reporting.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the expense was or will be disbursed to the vendor. Drives accounts payable processing and bank reconciliation workflows.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of this expense recoverable from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements. Used in Schedule F and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 62R; NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance treaty terms

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this transaction is a reversal of a previously posted expense. Reversals carry a negative amount and reference the original transaction via original_expense_id.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — Transaction reversal pattern; SAP/SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the service period covered by this expense. Together with service_start_date defines the billing period for period-based vendor engagements.

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the service period covered by this expense (e.g., legal retainer period, expert engagement). Used for period-based expense accrual.

attributes.name: siu_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates this expense has been flagged for SIU review due to suspected fraud, inflated billing, or unusual vendor patterns. Triggers SIU workflow.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter — SIU module; NAIC Model Fraud Regulation; FCRA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this expense record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration audits.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date the expense transaction was entered or posted in the claims management system. May differ from expense_date for late-reported or backdated entries.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this expense record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change-data-capture audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GLBA; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

products.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period
products.description: Reference calendar for financial close cycles. Defines calendar year, accident year, policy year, and fiscal period boundaries used to bucket premium, loss, and expense transactions for statutory and GAAP reporting. Grain: one row per financial movement.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounting period record. Primary key. _canonical_skip_reason: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this is a reference calendar/dimension table; per-role minimums are exempt.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: The claim accounting period must align to the enterprise calendar for combined ratio reporting, GAAP financial close, and cross-domain period reconciliation between claims, premium, and

attributes.name: prior_accounting_period_claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding accounting period. Supports period-over-period variance analysis, loss triangle chaining, and reserve roll-forward calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit accident year for loss development triangles and IBNR estimation. Losses are bucketed by the year the loss event occurred, per actuarial reserving standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: bordereaux_period_code
attributes.description: Period code used in reinsurance bordereaux submissions to treaty reinsurers. Aligns cession, premium, and loss data to the reinsurer's reporting calendar.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Bordereaux & Regulatory Reporting Repository, SICS/Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year (January–December). Used for CY loss ratio, CY written premium, and CY combined ratio analytics per NAIC Schedule P.

attributes.name: close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the accounting period was officially closed (soft close). After this date, new transactions require a journal entry adjustment or period reopening.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accounting period record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial transactions booked in this period (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date included in this accounting period (inclusive). Transactions with an effective date on or before this date fall within the period.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: Month number (1–12) within the fiscal year. Used for monthly close cycles, premium booking, and loss reserve movements in the GL.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Quarter number (1–4) within the fiscal year. Used for quarterly statutory filings, NAIC quarterly statements, and interim GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), NAIC Quarterly Statement

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the company's statutory and GAAP reporting year.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: fx_rate_to_usd
attributes.description: Exchange rate to USD applicable for this period's financial translations. Used for multi-currency consolidation in statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: gl_period_code
attributes.description: Period code as defined in the General Ledger system (Oracle/SAP). Used to reconcile premium, loss, and expense transactions between the data warehouse and the GL.

attributes.name: ifrs17_reporting_period
attributes.description: Period identifier as used in IFRS 17 insurance contract reporting (e.g., '2024-Q1'). Supports CSM amortization, loss component tracking, and IFRS 17 disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: is_quarter_end
attributes.description: True if this period is the last month of a fiscal quarter, triggering quarterly NAIC statement preparation and interim GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: is_stub_period
attributes.description: True if this period is a partial period (fewer days than a standard month), such as a company formation period or mid-year fiscal year change.

attributes.name: is_year_end
attributes.description: True if this period represents the final period of the fiscal or calendar year, triggering year-end statutory close, NAIC Annual Statement preparation, and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP/SSAP, RBC Requirements

attributes.name: lock_date
attributes.description: Date on which the period was hard-locked, preventing any further postings. Supports SOX controls and statutory filing integrity.

attributes.name: loss_development_lag
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to this period's end date. Used to position the period on loss development triangles for IBNR and IBNER estimation.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 43

attributes.name: naic_statement_period
attributes.description: NAIC filing period designation: Q1, Q2, Q3 for quarterly statements, or ANNUAL for the year-end NAIC Annual Statement. Drives statutory reporting schedules.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, NAIC Quarterly Statement, SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: period_basis
attributes.description: Actuarial and statutory basis: CY (Calendar Year), AY (Accident Year), PY (Policy Year), or FY (Fiscal Year). Drives loss triangle bucketing and Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the period (e.g., CY-2024-03 for calendar year 2024 March). Used in GL, statutory, and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, NAIC Annual Statement, Oracle/SAP GL

attributes.name: period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in this accounting period. Used for daily pro-rata premium earning, exposure day calculations, and IFRS 17 coverage unit computations.

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the period (e.g., 'March 2024', 'Q1 2024', 'AY 2023'). Used in reports, dashboards, and statutory filings.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current state of the period in the financial close lifecycle: OPEN (transactions posting), CLOSED (soft close), LOCKED (hard close, no further postings), REOPENED (adjustment window).
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), Oracle/SAP GL, SOX

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the period: MONTHLY for standard close cycles, QUARTERLY for interim reporting, SEMI_ANNUAL, or ANNUAL for year-end statutory filings.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), IFRS 17 (IASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit policy year for policy-year loss development. Losses and premium are bucketed by the year the policy was written, used in Schedule P and reinsurance bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP, Reinsurance Bordereaux

attributes.name: premium_earning_method
attributes.description: Method used to earn written premium into earned premium during this period: PRO_RATA (daily pro-rata), RULE_OF_78, DAILY, or MONTHLY. Drives UEP and EP calculations.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP No. 66, NAIC Annual Statement, ISO Rating

attributes.name: reopen_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously closed or locked period was reopened for adjustment postings. Null if the period has never been reopened.

attributes.name: reporting_framework
attributes.description: Accounting framework under which this period is reported: SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles), GAAP (US GAAP/FASB), IFRS17 (IASB IFRS 17), or STATUTORY for state-specific filings.
attributes.references: SAP/SSAP, US GAAP (FASB), IFRS 17 (IASB), NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: schedule_p_period_label
attributes.description: Label used to identify this period on NAIC Schedule P loss development exhibits (e.g., '2024 1 Year', '2023 2 Years'). Supports actuarial reserving and regulatory filing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this period definition (e.g., 'ORACLE_GL', 'SAP_FI'). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle/SAP GL, SOX, Model Audit Rule (MAR)

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date included in this accounting period. Transactions with an effective date on or after this date fall within the period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this accounting period record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX compliance.

products.name: financial_snapshot
products.description: Point-in-time financial position per claim exposure as of a valuation date. Stores total incurred (paid + case reserve), IBNR allocation, ceded amounts, net retained position, and prior-period comparison for statutory reporting. Grain: one row per.

attributes.name: financial_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each point-in-time financial position record per claim exposure and valuation date. Grain: one row per claim exposure per valuation date.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: Actuarial loss development triangles and GAAP/SAP period-end close require snapshots aligned to the enterprise calendar.

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reinsurance cession record for this claim exposure. Links to bordereaux reporting and RI recovery tracking.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim record for which this financial snapshot is captured.

attributes.name: claimfinancials_accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the accounting period (calendar month/quarter/year) in which this snapshot is valued for statutory and GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage (e.g., BI, PD, Comp, Collision) under which this claim exposure is adjudicated.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Multi-currency P&C books require currency denomination on financial snapshots for IFRS 17 and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the catastrophe event record when the claim is CAT-designated. Links to PCS bulletin or internal CAT event for aggregate PML reporting.
attributes.references: ISO PCS, RMS RiskLink, Verisk AIR Touchstone

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line within the claim (Claim Exposure) for which this financial position is recorded.

attributes.name: line_of_business_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.line_of_business. Business justification: Schedule P and combined ratio snapshots are fundamentally organized by LOB. Actuarial and regulatory reporting requires a proper LOB FK on the snapshot grain.

attributes.name: peril_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to catastrophe.peril. Business justification: Peril-level financial snapshots are required for NAIC cause-of-loss statutory reporting and actuarial peril-specific loss development triangles.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy under which the claim was filed, enabling policy-year and underwriting-year loss aggregation.

attributes.name: policy_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.term. Business justification: Schedule P loss development triangles and IBNR calculations require snapshots attributed to the exact policy term.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.reserve. Business justification: Actuarial Schedule P and IBNR development analysis require drilling from a period-end financial snapshot back to the source reserve record that drove the snapshot balance.

attributes.name: ri_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary reinsurance agreement (treaty or facultative) under which ceded amounts are reported for this claim exposure.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, Sapiens ReinsurancePro

attributes.name: riskexposure_insured_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.insured_risk. Business justification: Catastrophe modelers aggregate incurred losses by geocoded property locations and construction types for event loss estimation.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Used for Schedule P loss triangle development and actuarial reserving by accident year.

attributes.name: case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding case reserve (OSLR) set by the adjuster for this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Represents the estimated future loss payment.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: catastrophe_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim exposure is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Drives CAT loss reporting and reinsurance CAT XL recovery.
attributes.references: ISO PCS Catastrophe Bulletins, NAIC, RMS RiskLink

attributes.name: ceded_ibnr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the IBNR reserve ceded to reinsurers as of the valuation date. Used for net IBNR and Schedule F reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, IFRS 17

tag_set.value: Ceded Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Amount

attributes.name: ceded_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments ceded to and recovered from reinsurers on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the outstanding case reserve ceded to reinsurers under treaty or facultative agreements as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F, SAP/SSAP No. 62R, Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current adjudication status of the claim as of the valuation date. Drives reserve adequacy assessment and closure rate analytics.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: coverage_type_code
attributes.description: Specific coverage type within the LOB (e.g., BI, PD, COMP, COLL, MED, UMBI) identifying the peril or benefit being claimed.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Policyholder deductible applicable to this claim exposure. Reduces the insurer's gross loss payment obligation.

attributes.name: development_period
attributes.description: Number of months elapsed from the accident year start to the valuation date. Used as the x-axis in loss development triangles (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: ibnr_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Actuarially allocated IBNR reserve for this claim exposure or cohort as of the valuation date. Includes IBNER development on known claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43, SAP/SSAP No. 55

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: lae_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Case reserve for allocated loss adjustment expenses (ALAE/DCC) associated with this claim exposure as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: net_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Net retained total incurred loss after reinsurance cessions and recoveries. Key metric for net loss ratio and RBC capital calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, RBC requirements

attributes.name: net_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Net retained case reserve after cessions to reinsurers (gross case reserve minus ceded reserve). Represents the company's retained liability.

attributes.name: paid_lae_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative allocated loss adjustment expense (ALAE) payments made on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative loss payments made on this claim exposure through the valuation date, net of recoveries. Excludes LAE payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: policy_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage limit applicable to this claim exposure as of the loss date. Used to cap incurred amounts and assess limit adequacy.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated this claim was written. Used for policy-year loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.

attributes.name: prior_period_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred amount as of the immediately preceding valuation period. Enables period-over-period reserve development and redundancy/deficiency analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43

attributes.name: prior_period_paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative paid loss as of the immediately preceding valuation period. Used to compute incremental paid loss development in loss triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: report_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the claim was first reported (FNOL). Used for reported-year loss triangles and IBNR analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Actuarial Standards of Practice

attributes.name: reserve_basis
attributes.description: Identifies the reserving methodology basis for this snapshot record (case, IBNR, LAE, ULAE, or bulk). Supports actuarial triangle segmentation.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice No. 43, NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: reserve_change_amount
attributes.description: Change in total incurred from prior period to current valuation date (current incurred minus prior incurred). Positive = strengthening; negative = release.

attributes.name: salvage_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Estimated future salvage recovery reserved against this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Reduces net incurred loss.

attributes.name: sir_amount
attributes.description: Self-insured retention amount applicable to this claim exposure for large commercial accounts. Insurer pays above the SIR threshold.

attributes.name: snapshot_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial snapshot record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX, NAIC Model Audit Rule (MAR), SAP/SSAP

attributes.name: snapshot_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this financial snapshot record indicating whether it is the current active position or has been superseded by a later valuation.

attributes.name: snapshot_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial snapshot record was last modified. Used to detect restatements and track reserve re-estimations over time.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this financial data (e.g., CLAIMCENTER, RESERVING_DW, ACTUARIAL). Supports data lineage.

attributes.name: subrogation_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Estimated future subrogation recovery reserved against this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Reduces net incurred loss.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, Guidewire ClaimCenter Recovery module

attributes.name: total_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Total incurred loss = paid loss + case reserve + IBNR allocation as of the valuation date. Primary metric for Schedule P and loss ratio reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P, SAP/SSAP No. 55, IFRS 17

attributes.name: total_incurred_lae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Incurred Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) Amount
attributes.description: Total incurred LAE = paid LAE + LAE reserve as of the valuation date. Used for combined ratio and expense ratio statutory reporting.

tag_set.value: Total Incurred Loss Adjustment Expense (LAE) Amount

attributes.name: total_recovery_collected_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative subrogation, salvage, and other third-party recoveries actually collected on this claim exposure through the valuation date.

attributes.name: ulae_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Allocated portion of the ULAE reserve for this claim exposure as of the valuation date. Covers overhead claims handling costs not directly assignable.

tag_set.value: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this financial snapshot. All reserve, paid, and incurred amounts reflect the financial position as of this date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement, SAP/SSAP No. 55, IFRS 17

products.name: claimant
products.description: Grain: one row per claimant per claim. Records each party asserting a loss under a claim, distinguishing First Party (insured) from Third Party (injured/damaged third party). Links Claim to Party.

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier (BIGINT) for the claimant id attribute within the claimant product of the claim domain.

attributes.name: assigned_adjuster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.adjuster. Business justification: Litigation and represented-claimant management requires assigning a specific adjuster to each claimant file.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: FK to claim.claim

attributes.name: claimant_attorney_party_id
attributes.description: FK to party.party for the attorney representing this claimant. Nullable; populated only when represented_by_attorney is true.

attributes.name: claimant_contact_party_id
attributes.description: References the Party record for the designated contact person for this claimant, if different from the claimant party.

attributes.name: claimant_party_id
attributes.description: FK to party.party

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Currency in which settlement and payment amounts for this claimant are denominated. FK to shared.currency.

attributes.name: exposure_id
attributes.description: Optional FK to claim.claim_exposure — links the claimant to a specific coverage line within the claim when the claimant is exposure-specific.

attributes.name: mailing_address_id
attributes.description: FK to party.address for the claimant mailing address used for correspondence and payment disbursement.

attributes.name: role_id
attributes.description: FK to party.role — the specific party role (e.g. Named Insured, Additional Insured, Claimant) this party is playing on this claim.

attributes.name: attorney_firm
attributes.description: Law firm name representing the claimant, if applicable.

attributes.name: claimant_status
attributes.description: Current status of the claimant record, e.g. Active, Withdrawn, Settled, Denied. Supports claim lifecycle tracking per claimant.

attributes.name: claimant_type
attributes.description: Classifies the claimant as First Party (the insured) or Third Party (an external party). Drives coverage applicability, subrogation eligibility, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for this claimant during the claim lifecycle.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for this claimant during the claim lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the claimant record was first created. Used for audit trail and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the claimant, used for age-related coverage and benefit calculations.

attributes.name: date_of_loss
attributes.description: Date the loss or injury occurred for this claimant. May differ from the claim loss date when multiple claimants have distinct loss dates within the same event.

attributes.name: date_of_loss_reported
attributes.description: Date this claimant formally reported their portion of the loss. May differ from the master claim report date when claimants report independently.

attributes.name: date_reported
attributes.description: Date this claimant was reported to the insurer. Used to measure reporting lag and trigger statutory acknowledgment deadlines.

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount demanded by the claimant as of the most recent demand letter or filing.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the claimant was added to the claim.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the claimant was removed or resolved on the claim. Null if still active.

attributes.name: injury_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the injury, damage, or loss alleged by this claimant.

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: Type of injury or loss suffered by the claimant, e.g. Bodily Injury, Property Damage, Medical Only. Used for reserving and coverage matching.

attributes.name: injury_type_code
attributes.description: Code describing the nature of injury or loss for this claimant (e.g., Bodily Injury, Property Damage, Medical Only).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this claimant record. Used for change tracking and audit.

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Set to true when the claimant has initiated or threatened legal action. Escalates the claim to litigation management workflows.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payee_flag

attributes.name: release_obtained_flag

attributes.name: release_signed_flag

attributes.name: reported_date

attributes.name: representation_type

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`billing_account`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per billing account. Tracks account-level balances, delinquency exposure, write-offs, and payment behavior to steer collections, credit risk, and retention strategy."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`billing`.`account`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "account_status"
      expr: account_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the billing account (Active, Cancelled, Suspended, etc.) for segmenting balance and delinquency KPIs."
    - name: "account_type"
      expr: account_type
      comment: "Type of billing account (Direct Bill, Agency Bill, etc.) used to compare collection performance across distribution channels."
    - name: "billing_frequency"
      expr: billing_frequency
      comment: "How often the account is billed (Monthly, Quarterly, Annual) to analyze installment plan adoption and delinquency by frequency."
    - name: "billing_method"
      expr: billing_method
      comment: "Billing delivery method (Paper, Paperless, EFT) to measure digital adoption and its impact on payment timeliness."
    - name: "payment_plan_type"
      expr: payment_plan_type
      comment: "Payment plan selected by the policyholder (Full Pay, 2-Pay, Monthly, etc.) for plan-level delinquency and fee analysis."
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Tender type used for payments (Credit Card, ACH, Check) to track preferred payment channels and return-payment risk."
    - name: "delinquency_status"
      expr: delinquency_status
      comment: "Current delinquency classification (Current, 30-Day, 60-Day, etc.) for aging bucket analysis and collections prioritization."
    - name: "auto_pay_enabled"
      expr: auto_pay_enabled
      comment: "Whether the account is enrolled in automatic payment, used to compare delinquency rates between auto-pay and manual-pay accounts."
    - name: "cancellation_reason"
      expr: cancellation_reason
      comment: "Reason code for account cancellation (Non-Payment, Request, Underwriting) to identify preventable cancellations."
    - name: "effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date)
      comment: "Month the billing account became effective, used for cohort-based balance and delinquency trending."
    - name: "cancellation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', cancellation_date)
      comment: "Month the account was cancelled, used to track cancellation volume trends over time."
  measures:
    - name: "total_outstanding_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total premium receivable outstanding across all billing accounts. A primary collections KPI watched by CFO and billing operations."
    - name: "total_outstanding_fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_fees AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fee receivables outstanding. Tracks installment and late-fee collection efficiency."
    - name: "total_outstanding_taxes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_taxes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax receivables outstanding. Regulatory obligation; unpaid taxes create compliance risk."
    - name: "total_current_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of current account balances (premium + fees + taxes). The headline receivables figure for the billing ledger."
    - name: "total_unapplied_cash"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unapplied_cash AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Cash received but not yet applied to invoices. High unapplied cash signals posting backlogs and inflates apparent receivables."
    - name: "total_credit_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_balance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of credit balances owed back to policyholders. Drives refund disbursement workload and cash-flow planning."
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total premium and fees written off as uncollectable. A direct bad-debt expense KPI tracked by finance and underwriting."
    - name: "avg_days_past_due"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_past_due AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days past due across delinquent accounts. Measures collections velocity and early warning of deteriorating receivables."
    - name: "total_last_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(last_payment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of most recent payment amounts across accounts. Proxy for cash collected in the most recent payment cycle."
    - name: "count_delinquent_accounts"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN days_past_due > 0 THEN account_id END)
      comment: "Number of accounts with any past-due balance. Operational KPI for collections team sizing and outreach prioritization."
    - name: "count_active_accounts"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN account_status = 'Active' THEN account_id END)
      comment: "Number of active billing accounts. Portfolio size baseline used to normalize all other billing KPIs."
    - name: "delinquency_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN days_past_due > 0 THEN account_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(account_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of accounts with any past-due balance. Executive-level collections health indicator; triggers intervention when elevated."
    - name: "auto_pay_adoption_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN auto_pay_enabled = TRUE THEN account_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(account_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of accounts enrolled in auto-pay. Higher auto-pay adoption correlates with lower delinquency and cancellation rates."
    - name: "paperless_adoption_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN paperless_billing_flag = TRUE THEN account_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(account_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of accounts on paperless billing. Tracks digital transformation progress and reduces print/mail servicing costs."
    - name: "avg_outstanding_premium_per_account"
      expr: AVG(CAST(outstanding_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average outstanding premium per billing account. Normalizes receivables exposure across portfolio size changes."
    - name: "grace_period_days_avg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(grace_period_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average grace period granted across accounts. Informs policy on grace period standardization and its effect on cancellation rates."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per billing account. Tracks account-level balances, delinquency exposure, write-offs, and payment behavior to steer collections, credit risk, and retention strategy.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`billing_payment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per billing payment transaction. Measures payment volume, return/NSF rates, channel mix, and cash application efficiency to manage collections and fraud risk."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`billing`.`billing_payment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: method
      comment: "Payment tender type (ACH, Credit Card, Check, Wire) for channel-level payment volume and return-rate analysis."
    - name: "payment_type"
      expr: payment_type
      comment: "Classification of the payment (Premium, Fee, Tax, Reinstatement) to break down cash receipts by obligation type."
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Current status of the payment (Applied, Pending, Returned, Reversed) for cash application pipeline monitoring."
    - name: "payment_channel"
      expr: channel
      comment: "Channel through which the payment was received (Online, IVR, Agent, Mail) to optimize channel investment."
    - name: "payment_source"
      expr: source
      comment: "Originating system or source of the payment record for reconciliation and audit trail purposes."
    - name: "is_returned"
      expr: is_returned
      comment: "Flag indicating the payment was returned (NSF, stop payment). Used to segment returned-payment KPIs."
    - name: "card_type"
      expr: card_type
      comment: "Card network (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) for card-acceptance cost and chargeback risk analysis."
    - name: "receipt_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', receipt_date)
      comment: "Month payment was received, used for monthly cash receipt trending and seasonality analysis."
    - name: "applied_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', applied_date)
      comment: "Month payment was applied to an invoice, used to measure cash application lag."
    - name: "return_reason_code"
      expr: return_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for returned payments (NSF, Account Closed, Stop Payment) to identify root causes of return volume."
  measures:
    - name: "total_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross payment amount received. Primary cash receipts KPI for treasury and billing operations."
    - name: "total_applied_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(applied_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount successfully applied to invoices. Measures cash application throughput and posting efficiency."
    - name: "total_unapplied_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unapplied_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cash received but not yet applied. High unapplied balances signal posting backlogs and inflate receivables."
    - name: "total_nsf_fee_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nsf_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total NSF fees assessed on returned payments. Tracks fee revenue from returned items and signals payment quality issues."
    - name: "count_payments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of payment transactions processed. Volume baseline for staffing, system capacity, and SLA monitoring."
    - name: "count_returned_payments"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_returned = TRUE THEN billing_payment_id END)
      comment: "Number of returned (NSF/stop-payment) transactions. Elevated return counts signal collections risk and fraud exposure."
    - name: "returned_payment_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_returned = TRUE THEN billing_payment_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of payments that were returned. Key fraud and collections quality metric; triggers process review when above threshold."
    - name: "total_returned_payment_amount"

    - name: "count_distinct_payers"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`billing_transaction`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per billing transaction (charge, credit, reversal, write-off). Tracks ledger activity, reversal rates, write-off exposure, and GL posting health across the billing lifecycle."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`billing`.`billing_transaction`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Type of billing transaction (Premium Charge, Fee, Tax, Credit, Reversal, Write-Off) for ledger activity breakdown."
    - name: "transaction_status"
      expr: transaction_status
      comment: "Processing status of the transaction (Posted, Pending, Reversed, Suspended) for pipeline and exception monitoring."
    - name: "charge_code"
      expr: charge_code
      comment: "Charge type code (PREM, FEE, TAX, COMM) for granular revenue and cost categorization."
    - name: "debit_credit_indicator"
      expr: debit_credit_indicator
      comment: "Indicates whether the transaction increases (Debit) or decreases (Credit) the account balance."
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Marks transactions that have been reversed. Used to isolate net vs. gross transaction volumes."
    - name: "write_off_flag"
      expr: write_off_flag
      comment: "Marks transactions written off as uncollectable. Drives bad-debt expense reporting."
    - name: "suspense_flag"
      expr: suspense_flag
      comment: "Marks transactions held in suspense pending resolution. Elevated suspense balances indicate posting exceptions."
    - name: "commission_payable_flag"
      expr: commission_payable_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the transaction triggers a commission payable to a producer."
    - name: "gl_account_code"
      expr: gl_account_code
      comment: "General ledger account code for financial reporting and reconciliation."
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date)
      comment: "Month of the transaction date for monthly ledger activity trending and period-close analysis."
    - name: "posting_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', posting_date)
      comment: "Month the transaction was posted to the GL. Compared to transaction_month to measure posting lag."
  measures:
    - name: "total_transaction_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Gross sum of all billing transaction amounts. Top-line billing ledger activity measure for period-close reconciliation."
    - name: "total_balance_impact_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(balance_impact_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net impact of all transactions on account balances. Reconciles to the change in total outstanding balance over a period."
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN write_off_flag = TRUE THEN amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total amount written off as uncollectable. Direct bad-debt expense KPI for finance and underwriting profitability review."
    - name: "total_reversal_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reversal_flag = TRUE THEN amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total amount of reversed transactions. High reversal volumes indicate billing errors, fraud, or system issues."
    - name: "total_suspense_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN suspense_flag = TRUE THEN amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Total amount held in suspense. Unresolved suspense balances create reconciliation risk and delay cash application."
    - name: "count_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of billing transactions. Volume baseline for system capacity, staffing, and SLA monitoring."
    - name: "count_reversed_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reversal_flag = TRUE THEN billing_transaction_id END)
      comment: "Number of reversed transactions. Tracks billing error and correction frequency."
    - name: "reversal_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN reversal_flag = TRUE THEN billing_transaction_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of transactions that were reversed. Elevated rates signal billing quality issues requiring process improvement."
    - name: "write_off_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN write_off_flag = TRUE THEN billing_transaction_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of transactions written off. Measures bad-debt frequency and collections effectiveness."
    - name: "suspense_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN suspense_flag = TRUE THEN billing_transaction_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of transactions in suspense. Operational quality KPI; high rates indicate posting exception backlog."
    - name: "avg_transaction_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average billing transaction amount. Benchmarks typical charge size to detect anomalies and validate billing rules."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per billing transaction (charge, credit, reversal, write-off). Tracks ledger activity, reversal rates, write-off exposure, and GL posting health across the billing lifecycle.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`billing_commission_payable`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per commission payable record. Measures producer commission obligations, chargeback exposure, withholding, and payment status to manage distribution cost and producer relationships."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`billing`.`commission_payable`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "commission_type"
      expr: commission_type
      comment: "Type of commission (New Business, Renewal, Contingent, Override) for cost-of-distribution analysis by commission category."
    - name: "commission_basis"
      expr: commission_basis
      comment: "Basis on which commission is calculated (Written Premium, Earned Premium, Net Premium) for rate validation."
    - name: "payable_status"
      expr: payable_status
      comment: "Current status of the commission payable (Pending, Approved, Paid, Reversed, Withheld) for payables pipeline management."
    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Transaction type driving the commission (New Business, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement) for lifecycle cost analysis."
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Method used to pay the commission (ACH, Check, Wire) for disbursement channel analysis."
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Marks reversed commission payables. Used to isolate net vs. gross commission obligations."
    - name: "chargeback_flag"
      expr: chargeback_flag
      comment: "Indicates a commission chargeback (e.g., due to policy cancellation). Tracks producer chargeback exposure."
    - name: "override_flag"
      expr: override_flag
      comment: "Marks manually overridden commission amounts. Frequency of overrides signals schedule compliance issues."
    - name: "split_flag"
      expr: split_flag
      comment: "Indicates the commission is split between multiple producers. Used for co-broker and split-commission analysis."
    - name: "earned_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', earned_date)
      comment: "Month commission was earned, used for accrual-basis commission expense trending."
    - name: "paid_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_date)
      comment: "Month commission was paid, used for cash-basis disbursement trending and lag analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_commission_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_commission_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross commission earned by producers before chargebacks and withholding. Primary distribution cost KPI."
    - name: "total_net_payable_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_payable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net commission payable after chargebacks and withholding. Actual cash obligation to producers."
    - name: "total_chargeback_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(chargeback_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total commission chargebacks assessed (e.g., for cancelled policies). Measures recovery of unearned commission."
    - name: "total_withheld_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(withheld_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total commission withheld (e.g., pending E&O compliance, debt offset). Tracks producer withholding exposure."
    - name: "total_premium_basis_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total premium amount on which commission was calculated. Used to validate commission rates and reconcile to premium ledger."
    - name: "avg_commission_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(commission_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average commission rate across payable records. Benchmarks distribution cost efficiency and detects rate schedule drift."
    - name: "avg_split_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(CASE WHEN split_flag = TRUE THEN split_percentage END AS INT))
      comment: "Average split percentage on co-brokered commissions. Informs co-broker arrangement management."
    - name: "count_commission_payables"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of commission payable records. Volume baseline for accounts-payable workload and producer count estimation."
    - name: "count_chargebacks"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN chargeback_flag = TRUE THEN commission_payable_id END)
      comment: "Number of commission chargebacks. Elevated chargeback counts signal high cancellation rates or producer quality issues."
    - name: "chargeback_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN chargeback_flag = TRUE THEN commission_payable_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commission payables resulting in a chargeback. Measures cancellation-driven commission recovery rate."
    - name: "net_to_gross_commission_ratio_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(net_payable_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(gross_commission_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Net payable as a percentage of gross commission. Measures how much gross commission is retained after chargebacks and withholding."
    - name: "commission_expense_ratio_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(gross_commission_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(premium_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Gross commission as a percentage of premium basis. Core distribution cost ratio used in expense and combined ratio analysis."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per commission payable record. Measures producer commission obligations, chargeback exposure, withholding, and payment status to manage distribution cost and producer relationships.

      comment: "GL account code for the line item. Enables financial statement mapping and period-close reconciliation."
    - name: "effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date)
      comment: "Month the line item is effective, used for earned revenue trending and period allocation."
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date)
      comment: "Month the line item transaction was recorded, used for billing activity trending."
  measures:
    - name: "total_item_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(item_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total billed amount across all invoice line items. Granular revenue recognition KPI by charge type and coverage."
    - name: "total_paid_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount collected against invoice line items. Measures collection completeness at the charge level."
    - name: "total_outstanding_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(outstanding_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unpaid amount on invoice line items. Granular receivables KPI for charge-level collections analysis."
    - name: "total_write_off_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(write_off_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount written off at the line-item level. Enables bad-debt analysis by charge type and coverage."
    - name: "total_taxable_base_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(taxable_base_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total taxable premium base across line items. Required for tax remittance calculation and regulatory reporting."
    - name: "count_invoice_items"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of invoice line items. Volume baseline for billing complexity and system throughput analysis."
    - name: "count_waived_items"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN waived_flag = TRUE THEN invoice_item_id END)
      comment: "Number of waived invoice line items. Tracks fee waiver frequency and associated revenue leakage."
    - name: "waiver_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN waived_flag = TRUE THEN invoice_item_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of line items waived. Elevated waiver rates signal inconsistent billing practices or excessive customer accommodation."
    - name: "line_item_collection_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(item_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of billed line-item amount collected. Granular collection effectiveness KPI by charge type."
    - name: "avg_tax_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tax_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tax rate across taxable line items. Validates tax rate application and detects jurisdiction-level anomalies."
    - name: "avg_proration_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(proration_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average proration factor applied to line items. Measures mid-term endorsement activity and billing adjustment frequency."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per invoice line item. Enables granular analysis of billed amounts by charge type, coverage, tax jurisdiction, and proration to validate billing accuracy and revenue allocation.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`catastrophe_cat_model_version`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per catastrophe model version. Strategic KPIs for model governance, vendor coverage, regulatory approval status, and model lifecycle management supporting actuarial and underwriting model risk oversight."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`catastrophegeography`.`cat_model_version`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "vendor_name"
      expr: vendor_name
      comment: "Catastrophe model vendor (RMS, AIR, CoreLogic, etc.) for vendor-level model governance and dependency tracking."
    - name: "model_name"
      expr: model_name
      comment: "Name of the catastrophe model for model-level performance and version comparison reporting."
    - name: "model_type"
      expr: model_type
      comment: "Type of model (Stochastic, Deterministic, Hybrid) for model methodology governance."
    - name: "cat_model_version_status"
      expr: cat_model_version_status
      comment: "Status of the model version (Active, Deprecated, Under Review) for model lifecycle management."
    - name: "regulatory_approval_status"
      expr: regulatory_approval_status
      comment: "Regulatory approval status of the model version, required for rate filing and statutory reporting compliance."
    - name: "validation_status"
      expr: validation_status
      comment: "Internal validation status of the model version, used in model risk governance and actuarial sign-off workflows."
    - name: "climate_scenario"
      expr: climate_scenario
      comment: "Climate scenario embedded in the model version (e.g., RCP 4.5, RCP 8.5) for climate risk disclosure and TCFD reporting."
    - name: "primary_use_case"
      expr: primary_use_case
      comment: "Primary use case for the model version (Pricing, Reserving, Capital, Reinsurance) for model governance scoping."
    - name: "lob_applicability"
      expr: lob_applicability
      comment: "Lines of business for which the model version is applicable, used to scope model deployment."
    - name: "geographic_coverage"
      expr: geographic_coverage
      comment: "Geographic coverage of the model version, used to identify gaps in catastrophe model coverage relative to the portfolio footprint."
    - name: "resolution_level"
      expr: resolution_level
      comment: "Spatial resolution of the model (ZIP, County, Grid) affecting accuracy of location-level loss estimates."
    - name: "benchmark_comparison_flag"
      expr: benchmark_comparison_flag
      comment: "Flags model versions used as benchmarks for comparison, supporting model validation and actuarial review."
    - name: "release_date"
      expr: release_date
      comment: "Release date of the model version, used to track model currency and identify outdated versions in production."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: effective_date
      comment: "Effective date from which the model version is used in production, enabling point-in-time model version reconstruction."
  measures:
    - name: "model_version_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of catastrophe model versions in the catalog. Tracks model inventory breadth and version proliferation."
    - name: "active_model_version_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cat_model_version_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active model versions. Multiple active versions may indicate model transition periods requiring governance attention."
    - name: "regulatory_approved_version_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_approval_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of model versions with regulatory approval. Unapproved active versions signal compliance risk in rate filings."
    - name: "validated_version_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN validation_status = 'Validated' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of model versions that have passed internal validation. Tracks model risk governance completeness."
    - name: "total_event_set_size"
      expr: SUM(CAST(event_set_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total stochastic event set size across model versions. Larger event sets provide more stable loss estimates; used in model quality assessment."
    - name: "avg_event_set_size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(event_set_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average stochastic event set size across model versions. Benchmark for model simulation depth and statistical credibility."
    - name: "avg_simulation_years"
      expr: AVG(CAST(simulation_years AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average simulation years across model versions. Longer simulation periods improve tail loss stability; used in model selection decisions."
    - name: "distinct_vendor_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_name)
      comment: "Number of distinct catastrophe model vendors in use. Vendor diversification reduces model risk concentration and supports regulatory multi-model requirements."
    - name: "regulatory_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_approval_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of model versions with regulatory approval. Low rates signal compliance gaps in the model governance program."
    - name: "validation_completion_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN validation_status = 'Validated' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of model versions that have completed internal validation. Core model risk governance KPI tracked by actuarial and risk management."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per catastrophe model version. Strategic KPIs for model governance, vendor coverage, regulatory approval status, and model lifecycle management supporting actuarial and underwriting model risk oversight.
