CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`catastrophe_cat_zone`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per catastrophe zone per peril per model version. Strategic KPIs for underwriting exposure concentration, PML benchmarking, reinsurance attachment adequacy, and zone-level TIV monitoring across territory and peril."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`catastrophegeography`.`cat_zone`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "zone_code"
      expr: zone_code
      comment: "Unique code identifying the catastrophe zone for grouping exposure and loss metrics by zone."
    - name: "zone_name"
      expr: zone_name
      comment: "Human-readable name of the catastrophe zone for reporting and dashboard labeling."
    - name: "zone_tier"
      expr: zone_tier
      comment: "Risk tier classification of the zone (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2) used to stratify underwriting appetite and pricing."
    - name: "zone_status"
      expr: zone_status
      comment: "Operational status of the zone (Active, Inactive, Moratorium) for filtering live underwriting zones."
    - name: "peril_type"
      expr: peril_type
      comment: "Type of peril (Wind, Earthquake, Flood, etc.) associated with the zone for peril-level exposure analysis."
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "US state code for the zone, enabling state-level regulatory and underwriting aggregation."
    - name: "country_code"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "Country code for the zone, supporting multi-country exposure views."
    - name: "iso_territory_code"
      expr: iso_territory_code
      comment: "ISO territory code for the zone, used in regulatory reporting and rating territory analysis."
    - name: "naic_territory_code"
      expr: naic_territory_code
      comment: "NAIC territory code for the zone, required for NAIC statutory reporting and state filings."
    - name: "moratorium_flag"
      expr: moratorium_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether a binding moratorium is active on this zone, critical for underwriting workflow controls."
    - name: "underwriting_restriction_flag"
      expr: underwriting_restriction_flag
      comment: "Flags zones with active underwriting restrictions, used to enforce appetite guardrails."
    - name: "geographic_scope"
      expr: geographic_scope
      comment: "Scope of the geographic area covered by the zone (e.g., County, State, Region) for aggregation context."
    - name: "model_version"
      expr: model_version
      comment: "Version of the catastrophe model used to derive zone metrics, enabling model-version comparison."
    - name: "modeling_vendor"
      expr: modeling_vendor
      comment: "Vendor of the catastrophe model (e.g., RMS, AIR, CoreLogic) for vendor-level model performance tracking."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: effective_date
      comment: "Date from which the zone definition and metrics are effective, used for point-in-time exposure snapshots."
  measures:
    - name: "total_tiv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Insured Value (TIV) aggregated across all policies in the zone. Primary exposure metric used by underwriting and reinsurance teams to assess concentration risk."
    - name: "total_policy_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(policy_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of policies in force within the zone. Used alongside TIV to assess average insured value per policy and zone density."
    - name: "avg_tiv_per_policy"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average TIV per zone record. Proxy for average insured value concentration; high values signal large-risk accumulation zones."
    - name: "total_pml_100_year"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pml_100_year_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate 100-year Probable Maximum Loss across zones. Core metric for reinsurance tower sizing and capital adequacy assessment."
    - name: "total_pml_250_year"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pml_250_year_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate 250-year PML across zones. Used for stress testing, Solvency II/RBC capital modeling, and reinsurance limit adequacy."
    - name: "total_pml_500_year"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pml_500_year_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate 500-year PML across zones. Extreme tail risk metric used in board-level catastrophe risk reporting and ILS structuring."
    - name: "total_aal"
      expr: SUM(CAST(aal_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Average Annual Loss across zones. Fundamental pricing input representing the long-run expected catastrophe loss cost embedded in premium."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_limit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_limit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance limit available across zones. Compared against PML to assess whether reinsurance coverage is adequate for the exposure."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_attachment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_attachment_point AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance attachment point across zones. Used with PML to evaluate net retained loss before reinsurance responds."
    - name: "total_concentration_threshold"
      expr: SUM(CAST(concentration_threshold_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total concentration threshold amount across zones. Compared against TIV to identify zones approaching or breaching underwriting appetite limits."
    - name: "avg_concentration_threshold_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(concentration_threshold_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average concentration threshold percentage across zones. Indicates how close the portfolio is to triggering underwriting restrictions on average."
    - name: "zone_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Count of active catastrophe zone records. Used to track geographic footprint and model coverage completeness."
    - name: "moratorium_zone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN moratorium_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of zones currently under binding moratorium. Elevated counts signal active catastrophe events restricting new business."
    - name: "restricted_zone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN underwriting_restriction_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of zones with active underwriting restrictions. Tracks appetite tightening in high-risk geographies."
    - name: "pml_100yr_to_tiv_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(pml_100_year_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "100-year PML as a percentage of TIV. Key vulnerability ratio used by actuaries and reinsurance buyers to benchmark zone risk quality."
    - name: "aal_to_tiv_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(aal_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "AAL as a percentage of TIV. Represents the expected annual loss rate on insured value; directly informs catastrophe load in pricing."
    - name: "reinsurance_coverage_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(reinsurance_limit AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(pml_250_year_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "Reinsurance limit as a percentage of 250-year PML. Measures adequacy of reinsurance protection relative to modeled tail loss."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per catastrophe zone per peril per model version. Strategic KPIs for underwriting exposure concentration, PML benchmarking, reinsurance attachment adequacy, and zone-level TIV monitoring across territory and peril.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`catastrophe_cat_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per catastrophe event. Strategic KPIs for loss event severity, modeled vs actual loss accuracy, industry loss benchmarking, and catastrophe response tracking across peril type and geography."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`catastrophegeography`.`event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "event_type"
      expr: event_type
      comment: "Type of catastrophe event (Hurricane, Earthquake, Flood, Wildfire, etc.) for peril-level loss analysis."
    - name: "peril_type"
      expr: peril_type
      comment: "Peril classification of the event, used to segment loss experience by hazard type for pricing and reserving."
    - name: "event_status"
      expr: event_status
      comment: "Current status of the event (Open, Closed, Developing) for operational triage and reserve adequacy monitoring."
    - name: "pml_class"
      expr: pml_class
      comment: "PML classification of the event (e.g., Major, Moderate, Minor) for executive-level severity bucketing."
    - name: "affected_states"
      expr: affected_states
      comment: "States impacted by the event, enabling state-level loss aggregation and regulatory notification tracking."
    - name: "affected_countries"
      expr: affected_countries
      comment: "Countries impacted by the event for multi-country portfolio loss analysis."
    - name: "federal_disaster_declaration_flag"
      expr: federal_disaster_declaration_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether a federal disaster declaration was issued, which affects claims handling, FEMA coordination, and regulatory obligations."
    - name: "cat_bond_trigger_flag"
      expr: cat_bond_trigger_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the event triggered a catastrophe bond, relevant for capital markets and ILS reporting."
    - name: "reinsurance_trigger_flag"
      expr: reinsurance_trigger_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the event triggered reinsurance recoveries, critical for cession and recovery workflow initiation."
    - name: "nfip_participation_flag"
      expr: nfip_participation_flag
      comment: "Indicates NFIP participation relevance for the event, used in flood loss coordination and residual market analysis."
    - name: "magnitude_scale"
      expr: magnitude_scale
      comment: "Scale used to measure event magnitude (Richter, Saffir-Simpson, etc.) for scientific and regulatory reporting."
    - name: "data_source"
      expr: data_source
      comment: "Source of event data (ISO, PCS, internal, vendor) for data lineage and quality assessment."
    - name: "start_date"
      expr: start_date
      comment: "Start date of the catastrophe event, used for time-series loss trending and seasonal pattern analysis."
    - name: "end_date"
      expr: end_date
      comment: "End date of the catastrophe event, used to compute event duration and close out open event reserves."
  measures:
    - name: "event_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of catastrophe events recorded. Tracks event frequency by peril and period for trend analysis."
    - name: "total_actual_loss"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual incurred loss across all catastrophe events. Primary financial outcome metric for catastrophe program performance."
    - name: "total_modeled_loss"
      expr: SUM(CAST(modeled_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total modeled loss across events. Compared against actual loss to assess model accuracy and calibration quality."
    - name: "total_industry_loss_estimate"
      expr: SUM(CAST(industry_loss_estimate_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total industry-wide loss estimate across events. Used to benchmark company market share of catastrophe losses."
    - name: "avg_actual_loss_per_event"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual loss per catastrophe event. Severity metric used in frequency-severity modeling and reinsurance pricing."
    - name: "avg_modeled_loss_per_event"
      expr: AVG(CAST(modeled_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average modeled loss per event. Compared to avg actual loss to identify systematic model bias by peril or region."
    - name: "total_estimated_claim_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_claim_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated claim count across events. Used for claims staffing, vendor mobilization, and reserve adequacy planning."
    - name: "avg_estimated_claim_count_per_event"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_claim_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated claim count per event. Frequency metric used to size claims response resources for future events."
    - name: "total_pml"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pml_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Probable Maximum Loss across events. Aggregate tail risk metric used in reinsurance program design and capital planning."
    - name: "avg_duration_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average event duration in days. Longer events correlate with higher loss development and claims complexity."
    - name: "total_acres_burned"
      expr: SUM(CAST(acres_burned AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total acres burned across wildfire events. Physical severity metric used in wildfire exposure management and reinsurance reporting."
    - name: "avg_wind_speed_mph"
      expr: AVG(CAST(wind_speed_mph AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average wind speed in mph across wind events. Physical intensity metric correlated with loss severity for wind peril pricing."
    - name: "avg_magnitude_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(magnitude_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average event magnitude value. Physical severity indicator used to calibrate vulnerability functions in catastrophe models."
    - name: "modeled_vs_actual_loss_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(modeled_loss_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_loss_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "Ratio of modeled to actual loss. Values above 1 indicate model over-prediction; below 1 indicate under-prediction. Core model validation KPI."
    - name: "company_market_share_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_loss_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(industry_loss_estimate_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "Company actual loss as a percentage of industry loss estimate. Measures market share of catastrophe losses; deviations from premium market share signal adverse selection."
    - name: "avg_loss_development_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(loss_development_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average loss development factor across events. Used by actuaries to project ultimate losses from current paid/incurred amounts."
    - name: "reinsurance_triggered_event_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reinsurance_trigger_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of events that triggered reinsurance recoveries. Tracks reinsurance program utilization frequency."
    - name: "federal_declaration_event_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN federal_disaster_declaration_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of events with federal disaster declarations. Elevated counts signal systemic catastrophe activity requiring regulatory and FEMA coordination."
    - name: "avg_return_period_years"
      expr: AVG(CAST(return_period_years AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average return period in years across events. Indicates the average rarity of events in the portfolio; lower values signal more frequent severe events."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per catastrophe event. Strategic KPIs for loss event severity, modeled vs actual loss accuracy, industry loss benchmarking, and catastrophe response tracking across peril type and geography.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`catastrophe_geography`

      comment: "Total current caseload across all adjusters. Measures aggregate claims handling capacity utilization."

      comment: "Total maximum caseload capacity across all adjusters. Denominator for capacity utilization rate."
    - name: "avg_current_caseload"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_caseload_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average current caseload per adjuster. Tracks workload balance and burnout risk."
    - name: "avg_max_claim_authority"
      expr: AVG(CAST(max_claim_authority AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum claim settlement authority per adjuster. Informs authority limit adequacy and escalation rates."
    - name: "total_max_claim_authority"
      expr: SUM(CAST(max_claim_authority AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total settlement authority across the adjuster workforce. Measures aggregate authority capacity."
    - name: "avg_years_experience"
      expr: AVG(CAST(years_experience AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average years of experience across adjusters. Tracks workforce seniority and quality for complex claim handling."
    - name: "catastrophe_qualified_adjuster_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN catastrophe_qualified_flag = TRUE THEN adjuster_id END)
      comment: "Number of CAT-qualified adjusters. Critical capacity KPI for catastrophe response readiness."
    - name: "active_adjuster_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN adjuster_status = 'Active' THEN adjuster_id END)
      comment: "Number of currently active adjusters. Tracks available workforce for capacity and staffing decisions."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per adjuster. KPIs on adjuster capacity, caseload utilization, authority limits, and workforce quality for claims operations management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`claim`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per reported loss. Strategic KPIs on claim volume, litigation, catastrophe exposure, SIU referrals, and reinsurance flags to steer claims operations and reserving strategy."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`claimfinancials`.`claim`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "claim_status"
      expr: claim_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the claim (Open, Closed, Reopened, Denied) for operational segmentation."
    - name: "claimant_type"
      expr: claimant_type
      comment: "First-party vs third-party claimant classification driving coverage and liability analysis."
    - name: "catastrophe_flag"
      expr: catastrophe_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim is associated with a declared catastrophe event."
    - name: "litigation_flag"
      expr: litigation_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim has entered litigation, a key driver of LAE and settlement cost."
    - name: "siu_flag"
      expr: siu_flag
      comment: "Special Investigations Unit referral flag identifying potential fraud exposure."
    - name: "reinsurance_flag"
      expr: reinsurance_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the claim has been ceded to a reinsurer, affecting net retained loss."
    - name: "subrogation_flag"
      expr: subrogation_flag
      comment: "Indicates subrogation potential, enabling recovery pipeline tracking."
    - name: "salvage_flag"
      expr: salvage_flag
      comment: "Indicates salvage potential on the claim, relevant to total-loss property and auto lines."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year of the loss, the primary axis for actuarial loss development triangles."
    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year
      comment: "Policy year in which the loss occurred, used for underwriting year profitability analysis."
    - name: "report_year"
      expr: report_year
      comment: "Year the claim was reported, used to measure IBNR emergence and reporting lag."
    - name: "adjuster_type"
      expr: adjuster_type
      comment: "Type of adjuster handling the claim (Staff, Independent, TPA) for cost and quality benchmarking."
    - name: "loss_date"
      expr: loss_date
      comment: "Date of the loss event, the anchor for coverage-in-force reconstruction and development lag."
    - name: "report_date"
      expr: report_date
      comment: "Date the claim was reported to the insurer, used to compute reporting lag."
    - name: "close_date"
      expr: close_date
      comment: "Date the claim was closed, used to compute cycle time and closure rate."
  measures:
    - name: "total_claims_reported"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of claims reported. Baseline volume KPI for frequency analysis and staffing."
    - name: "catastrophe_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN catastrophe_flag = TRUE THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of claims flagged as catastrophe losses. Drives CAT response resourcing and reinsurance recovery activation."
    - name: "litigation_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN litigation_flag = TRUE THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of claims in litigation. High litigation rates signal reserve adequacy risk and legal cost exposure."
    - name: "siu_referral_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN siu_flag = TRUE THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of claims referred to SIU for fraud investigation. Tracks fraud exposure and leakage risk."
    - name: "reinsurance_ceded_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reinsurance_flag = TRUE THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of claims ceded to reinsurers. Informs net retained loss volume and RI program utilization."
    - name: "subrogation_potential_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN subrogation_flag = TRUE THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Claims with subrogation potential. Drives recovery pipeline sizing and third-party pursuit strategy."
    - name: "avg_reporting_lag_days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(report_date, loss_date))
      comment: "Average days between loss date and report date. Measures IBNR emergence speed and claimant reporting behavior."
    - name: "avg_closure_days"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(close_date, fnol_date))
      comment: "Average days from FNOL to claim closure. Core cycle-time KPI for claims efficiency and customer experience."
    - name: "open_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Open' THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of currently open claims. Drives workload management, reserve adequacy review, and staffing decisions."
    - name: "reopened_claims_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reopen_date IS NOT NULL THEN claim_id END)
      comment: "Number of claims that were reopened after closure. Elevated reopen rates signal premature closure or reserve deficiency."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per reported loss. Strategic KPIs on claim volume, litigation, catastrophe exposure, SIU referrals, and reinsurance flags to steer claims operations and reserving strategy.

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per financial payment transaction per claim. KPIs on gross/net payments, deductible offsets, reinsurance recoverables, and payment cycle efficiency."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`claimfinancials`.`claim_payment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_type"
      expr: payment_type
      comment: "Type of payment (Indemnity, LAE, Expense, Structured Settlement) for financial classification."
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Current status of the payment (Issued, Cleared, Voided, Stopped) for cash management."
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method (Check, EFT, Wire) for operational and fraud monitoring."
    - name: "loss_category"
      expr: loss_category
      comment: "Loss category on the payment (Property Damage, Bodily Injury, etc.) for line-level cost analysis."
    - name: "coverage_type_code"
      expr: coverage_type_code
      comment: "Coverage type code on the payment for coverage-level loss cost analysis."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year of the underlying claim for loss development and pricing analysis."
    - name: "is_final_payment"
      expr: is_final_payment
      comment: "Indicates whether this is the final payment on the claim, used to track closure completeness."
    - name: "is_structured_settlement"
      expr: is_structured_settlement
      comment: "Indicates structured settlement payments, which have different reserving and cash flow implications."
    - name: "stop_payment_flag"
      expr: stop_payment_flag
      comment: "Indicates a stop-payment was issued, flagging potential fraud or administrative issues."
    - name: "siu_referral_flag"
      expr: siu_referral_flag
      comment: "Indicates the payment was flagged for SIU review, tracking fraud leakage on payments."
    - name: "payment_date"
      expr: payment_date
      comment: "Date the payment was issued, used for cash flow and cycle-time analysis."
    - name: "state_jurisdiction_code"
      expr: state_jurisdiction_code
      comment: "State jurisdiction of the payment for regulatory reporting and compliance."
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_payment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross payments issued. Primary cash outflow KPI for claims financial management."
    - name: "total_net_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_payment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net payments after deductible offsets and withholding. Measures actual insurer cash outflow."
    - name: "total_deductible_offset_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(deductible_offset_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total deductible amounts offset against payments. Quantifies insured cost-sharing recovery."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_recoverable_on_payments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_recoverable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance recoverables on paid losses. Reduces net retained loss and informs RI program value."
    - name: "total_withholding_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(withholding_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total withholding amounts on payments. Tracks tax compliance and 1099 reporting obligations."
    - name: "payment_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of payment transactions. Baseline for payment volume and operational throughput analysis."
    - name: "voided_payment_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN void_date IS NOT NULL THEN claim_payment_id END)
      comment: "Number of voided payments. Elevated void rates signal fraud, administrative errors, or process failures."

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`claim_expense`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per LAE/DCC/AO expense transaction per claim exposure and accounting period. KPIs on claims handling costs, DCC vs. AO split, and reinsurance recoverables on expenses."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`claimfinancials`.`expense`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "expense_type"
      expr: expense_type
      comment: "Expense type (Legal, Medical, Expert, Investigative, Administrative) for LAE cost component analysis."
    - name: "expense_status"
      expr: expense_status
      comment: "Current expense status (Pending, Approved, Paid, Reversed) for payables management."
    - name: "lae_category"
      expr: lae_category
      comment: "LAE category (DCC or AO) for statutory expense ratio reporting and cost allocation."
    - name: "is_dcc_expense"
      expr: is_dcc_expense
      comment: "Flags Defense and Cost Containment expenses for DCC vs. AO expense ratio segmentation."
    - name: "is_recoverable"
      expr: is_recoverable
      comment: "Indicates the expense is recoverable from reinsurance or third parties, reducing net LAE."
    - name: "reversal_flag"
      expr: reversal_flag
      comment: "Flags reversed expense transactions for financial reconciliation and audit trail."
    - name: "siu_referral_flag"
      expr: siu_referral_flag
      comment: "Flags expenses linked to SIU investigations for fraud containment cost tracking."
    - name: "approval_status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Expense approval status for authority limit compliance and payables workflow monitoring."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year of the expense for actuarial LAE development triangle construction."
    - name: "expense_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', expense_date)
      comment: "Month of expense incurrence for period-over-period LAE trending and budget variance analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_expense_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total LAE/DCC/AO expense amount. Primary claims handling cost KPI for expense ratio management."
    - name: "total_dcc_expense"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_dcc_expense = TRUE THEN CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total Defense and Cost Containment expenses. Statutory DCC component of the expense ratio."
    - name: "total_ao_expense"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_dcc_expense = FALSE THEN CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total Adjusting and Other expenses. Statutory AO component of the expense ratio."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_recoverable_expense"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_recoverable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance recoverables on LAE expenses. Reduces net LAE for RI settlement and reporting."
    - name: "total_functional_currency_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(functional_currency_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total expenses in functional currency after FX conversion. Required for multi-currency financial reporting."
    - name: "expense_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total expense transactions. Volume KPI for claims handling activity and vendor invoice throughput."
    - name: "avg_expense_per_transaction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average expense amount per transaction. Benchmarks unit cost of claims handling activities."
    - name: "recoverable_expense_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_recoverable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of recoverable expense transactions. Tracks volume of expenses eligible for third-party offset."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per LAE/DCC/AO expense transaction per claim exposure and accounting period. KPIs on loss adjustment expense by type, adjuster, and coverage for expense ratio management.

      expr: claim_status

    - name: "reserve_basis"

    - name: "snapshot_status"

      comment: "Status of the snapshot record (Final, Preliminary, Revised) for period-end close management."

      expr: development_period
      comment: "Development period lag for loss triangle construction and tail factor estimation."
    - name: "valuation_date"
      expr: valuation_date
      comment: "Valuation date of the snapshot, the anchor for actuarial loss development analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_incurred_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_incurred_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incurred loss (paid + case reserve) at snapshot. Primary gross loss KPI for actuarial and financial reporting."
    - name: "total_paid_loss_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total paid losses at snapshot date. Tracks cumulative cash outflow for loss development triangles."
    - name: "total_case_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(case_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total case reserves at snapshot. Measures outstanding liability for balance sheet and reserving adequacy."
    - name: "total_ibnr_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ibnr_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total IBNR reserves at snapshot. Key actuarial KPI for unreported loss liability estimation."
    - name: "total_lae_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(lae_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total LAE reserves at snapshot. Informs total incurred LAE and expense ratio projections."
    - name: "total_net_incurred_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_incurred_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net incurred loss after reinsurance. Measures retained loss for net combined ratio calculation."
    - name: "total_net_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net reserves after ceded amounts. Measures net retained liability for solvency and capital adequacy."
    - name: "total_ceded_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded reserves at snapshot. Measures reinsurance recoverable asset on the balance sheet."
    - name: "total_ceded_paid_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded paid losses at snapshot. Tracks reinsurance cash recovery against ceded premium."
    - name: "total_ceded_ibnr_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_ibnr_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded IBNR at snapshot. Measures reinsurance recoverable on unreported losses."
    - name: "total_paid_lae_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_lae_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total paid LAE at snapshot. Tracks cumulative claims handling cost for expense ratio analysis."
    - name: "total_recovery_collected_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_recovery_collected_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total recoveries collected at snapshot (subrogation, salvage, RI). Reduces net incurred loss."
    - name: "total_reserve_change_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reserve_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reserve development in the period. Tracks reserve strengthening or release for P&L impact."
    - name: "total_prior_period_incurred_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(prior_period_incurred_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total prior period incurred amount. Enables period-over-period reserve development and redundancy analysis."
    - name: "total_ulae_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ulae_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unallocated LAE reserves. Informs total LAE liability and expense ratio completeness."
    - name: "total_subrogation_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subrogation_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total subrogation reserves anticipated. Reduces net incurred loss projections in reserving models."
    - name: "total_salvage_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(salvage_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total salvage reserves anticipated. Reduces net incurred loss projections for total-loss claims."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per financial snapshot per claim exposure and accounting period. Comprehensive period-end KPIs on total incurred, paid, IBNR, LAE, net reserves, and ceded amounts for actuarial and financial reporting.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`claim_reserve`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per financial reserve movement per claim exposure and accounting period. KPIs on reserve levels, movements, IBNR, ceded reserves, and development for actuarial and financial reporting."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`claimfinancials`.`reserve`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "reserve_type"
      expr: reserve_type
      comment: "Reserve category: Case, IBNR, or LAE. Drives actuarial segmentation and statutory reporting."
    - name: "reserve_status"
      expr: reserve_status
      comment: "Current status of the reserve record (Active, Closed, Superseded) for portfolio integrity."
    - name: "basis"
      expr: basis
      comment: "Reserving basis (e.g., case, bulk, actuarial) indicating the methodology used."
    - name: "reserve_category"
      expr: reserve_category
      comment: "Reserve sub-reserve_category for granular loss component tracking (e.g., BI, PD, LAE-DCC, LAE-AO)."
    - name: "catastrophe_indicator"
      expr: catastrophe_indicator
      comment: "CAT flag on the reserve for gross vs. net CAT reserve aggregation."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year of the reserve for Schedule P loss triangle development."
    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year
      comment: "Policy year of the reserve for underwriting year loss ratio analysis."
    - name: "development_period"
      expr: development_period
      comment: "Development lag period (months) for actuarial triangle construction and IBNR factor application."
    - name: "movement_reason_code"
      expr: movement_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for reserve movement (e.g., new information, settlement, actuarial adjustment)."
    - name: "requires_supervisor_approval"
      expr: requires_supervisor_approval
      comment: "Flags reserves requiring supervisor sign-off, used for authority limit compliance monitoring."
    - name: "transaction_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date)
      comment: "Month of reserve transaction for period-over-period reserve development trending."
    - name: "effective_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date)
      comment: "Month the reserve became effective for temporal reserve portfolio analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_closing_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CAST(closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total closing reserve balance. Primary balance-sheet liability KPI for period-end financial reporting."
    - name: "total_opening_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CAST(opening_balance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total opening reserve balance. Baseline for period reserve movement and development analysis."
    - name: "total_reserve_movement"
      expr: SUM(CAST(movement_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net reserve movement in the period (strengthening positive, release negative). Key actuarial development KPI."
    - name: "total_ibnr_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reserve_type = 'IBNR' THEN CAST(closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total IBNR reserve balance. Measures actuarially estimated liability for unreported losses."
    - name: "total_case_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reserve_type = 'Case' THEN CAST(closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total case reserve balance. Measures adjuster-set reserves on known open claims."
    - name: "total_lae_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN reserve_type = 'LAE' THEN CAST(closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total LAE reserve balance. Measures estimated future claims handling costs."
    - name: "total_ceded_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded reserve balance. Measures reinsurance recoverables on outstanding reserves."
    - name: "total_ceded_movement"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_movement_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net ceded reserve movement. Tracks changes in reinsurance recoverables for RI settlement."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_recoverable"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_recoverable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance recoverable on reserves. Key asset on the balance sheet offsetting gross reserves."
    - name: "avg_closing_reserve_per_claim"
      expr: AVG(CAST(closing_balance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average closing reserve per reserve record. Severity benchmark for reserve adequacy peer comparison."
    - name: "total_subrogation_anticipated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(subrogation_anticipated_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total anticipated subrogation recoveries. Informs net reserve and loss ratio projections."
    - name: "total_salvage_anticipated"
      expr: SUM(CAST(salvage_anticipated_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total anticipated salvage recoveries. Offsets gross incurred in net loss projections."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per financial reserve movement per claim exposure and accounting period. KPIs on reserve adequacy, IBNR, case reserve development, and reinsurance recoverables.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`claim_salvage`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per salvage item per claim. KPIs on salvage proceeds, net recovery, storage costs, and disposition efficiency for total-loss asset management."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`claimfinancials`.`salvage`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "salvage_type"
      expr: salvage_type
      comment: "Type of salvage (Auto, Property, Marine, Equipment) for portfolio segmentation."
    - name: "salvage_status"
      expr: salvage_status
      comment: "Current status of the salvage item (Pending, In Storage, Sold, Closed) for disposition tracking."
    - name: "disposition_method"
      expr: disposition_method
      comment: "Method of salvage disposition (Auction, Direct Sale, Scrap, Insured Retention) for proceeds optimization."
    - name: "buyer_type"
      expr: buyer_type
      comment: "Type of salvage buyer (Dealer, Auction House, Scrap Yard) for vendor performance analysis."
    - name: "total_loss_indicator"
      expr: total_loss_indicator
      comment: "Indicates total loss designation, the primary trigger for salvage processing."
    - name: "insured_retained_indicator"
      expr: insured_retained_indicator
      comment: "Indicates insured elected to retain the salvage, reducing gross proceeds but simplifying disposition."
    - name: "reinsurance_recoverable_indicator"
      expr: reinsurance_recoverable_indicator
      comment: "Indicates reinsurer has a share of salvage proceeds, affecting net retained recovery."
    - name: "title_transfer_status"
      expr: title_transfer_status
      comment: "Status of title transfer (Pending, Transferred, Disputed) for legal and regulatory compliance."
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "State where the salvage item is located, used for jurisdiction-specific title and disposal rules."
  measures:
    - name: "total_auction_proceeds"
      expr: SUM(CAST(auction_proceeds AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross auction proceeds from salvage dispositions. Primary revenue KPI for salvage program."
    - name: "total_net_salvage_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_salvage_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net salvage recovery after fees and costs. Measures true economic value of salvage program."
    - name: "total_auction_fee"
      expr: SUM(CAST(auction_fee AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total auction fees paid. Tracks vendor cost efficiency and fee negotiation opportunities."
    - name: "total_storage_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(storage_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total storage costs incurred. Elevated storage costs signal disposition delays and process inefficiency."
    - name: "total_towing_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(towing_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total towing costs incurred. Tracks logistics cost component of salvage handling."
    - name: "total_insured_retention_deduction"
      expr: SUM(CAST(insured_retention_deduction AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total deductions for insured-retained salvage. Measures gross-to-net proceeds reduction from retention elections."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_salvage_share"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_salvage_share AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total salvage proceeds shared with reinsurers. Tracks RI salvage participation and net retained proceeds."
    - name: "salvage_item_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of salvage items. Baseline for salvage volume and disposition pipeline management."
    - name: "avg_net_salvage_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(net_salvage_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average net salvage recovery per item. Benchmarks salvage program efficiency and vendor performance."
    - name: "total_loss_item_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN total_loss_indicator = TRUE THEN salvage_id END)
      comment: "Number of total-loss salvage items. Tracks total-loss volume for reserving and disposition capacity planning."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per salvage item per claim. KPIs on salvage proceeds, net recovery, storage costs, and disposition efficiency for total-loss asset management.

    - name: "binding_authority_type"

    - name: "issuing_state"

    - name: "risk_state"

      comment: "State where the insured risk is located — used for geographic exposure analysis."
    - name: "policy_type_code"
      expr: policy_type_code
      comment: "Policy type code on the binder — used for product-level segmentation of binding activity."
    - name: "payment_plan_code"

    - name: "replaced_by_policy_flag"

    - name: "bind_month"

      comment: "Month the binder was issued — used for trend analysis of binding activity."
    - name: "cancellation_reason"

      comment: "Reason for binder cancellation — used to diagnose post-bind cancellation drivers."
  measures:
    - name: "total_binders_issued"

      comment: "Total number of binders issued. Baseline binding activity metric used to track new business flow and binding authority utilization."
    - name: "total_binder_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of premium across all binders. Measures gross written premium committed at the binding stage."
    - name: "avg_binder_premium"
      expr: AVG(CAST(premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average premium per binder. Tracks average deal size at bind and detects shifts in risk profile."
    - name: "total_binder_commission"
      expr: SUM(CAST(commission_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total producer commission across all binders. Measures distribution cost committed at the binding stage."
    - name: "avg_commission_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(commission_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average producer commission rate across binders. Used to monitor distribution cost ratios and binding authority agreement compliance."
    - name: "total_binding_authority_limit"
      expr: SUM(CAST(binding_authority_limit AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of binding authority limits across all binders. Measures total delegated authority capacity committed."
    - name: "avg_binding_authority_limit"
      expr: AVG(CAST(binding_authority_limit AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "total_converted_to_policy"

    - name: "total_cancelled_binders"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN binder_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END)

    - name: "total_insured_value_bound"

    - name: "total_down_payment_amount"

    - name: "avg_term_days"

metric_views.description: Grain: one row per binder. Measures binding activity, premium at bind, commission costs, binding authority utilization, and binder-to-policy conversion across the underwriting workflow.

    - name: "deductible_type"

      expr: SUM(CAST(premium_amount AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "avg_written_premium_per_coverage"

    - name: "total_per_occurrence_limit"

      comment: "Total per-occurrence limit exposure across all coverages. Measures maximum single-event loss exposure in the portfolio."
    - name: "avg_per_occurrence_limit"

    - name: "verification_status"
      expr: verification_status
      comment: "Verification status of the loss record (e.g., Verified, Unverified, Disputed) — used to assess data quality for rating."
    - name: "at_fault_flag"
      expr: at_fault_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the insured was at fault — used to segment chargeable vs. non-chargeable losses."
    - name: "catastrophe_flag"
      expr: catastrophe_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the loss was catastrophe-related — used to exclude cat losses from experience rating."
    - name: "excluded_from_rating_flag"
      expr: excluded_from_rating_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the loss is excluded from rating — used to measure the impact of loss exclusions on pricing."
    - name: "within_lookback_flag"
      expr: within_lookback_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the loss falls within the rating lookback period — used to filter ratable losses."
    - name: "loss_year"
      expr: YEAR(loss_date)
      comment: "Year of the prior loss — used for loss development trend analysis and lookback period segmentation."
    - name: "prior_carrier_name"
      expr: prior_carrier_name
      comment: "Name of the prior carrier — used to analyze loss patterns by prior carrier and detect adverse selection."
  measures:
    - name: "total_prior_losses"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of prior loss records. Baseline loss history volume metric used to measure prior loss frequency across the portfolio."
    - name: "total_incurred_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incurred_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total incurred amounts across all prior losses. Measures the historical loss severity burden used in experience rating."
    - name: "avg_incurred_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(incurred_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average incurred amount per prior loss. Tracks average loss severity — used to calibrate rating factors and deductible adequacy."
    - name: "total_paid_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of paid amounts across all prior losses. Measures actual cash outflow from prior loss history."
    - name: "total_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of reserve amounts on prior losses. Measures outstanding liability from prior loss history used in experience rating."
    - name: "total_surcharge_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(surcharge_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of surcharge amounts applied based on prior loss history. Measures the premium impact of loss-based surcharges."
    - name: "avg_surcharge_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(surcharge_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average surcharge percentage applied based on prior losses. Used to monitor the pricing impact of loss history surcharges."
    - name: "total_chargeable_losses"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN at_fault_flag = TRUE AND excluded_from_rating_flag = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of chargeable prior losses (at-fault and not excluded from rating). Used to measure the ratable loss burden driving surcharges."
    - name: "total_cat_losses"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN catastrophe_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of catastrophe-related prior losses. Used to separate cat from non-cat loss experience in rating and selection."
    - name: "total_verified_losses"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN verified_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of verified prior loss records. Measures data quality of loss history used in underwriting decisions."
    - name: "avg_variance_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average variance between reported and verified loss amounts. Measures data quality and accuracy of prior loss reporting."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per prior loss record per insured risk. Measures prior loss frequency, severity, surcharge impact, and verification quality used in underwriting selection and experience rating.

    - name: "total_parties"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of party records. Baseline population count for market penetration and MDM completeness tracking."
    - name: "distinct_parties"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT party_id)
      comment: "Count of unique party IDs. Compared against total_parties to detect duplicate records and MDM quality issues."
    - name: "golden_record_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN golden_record_flag = TRUE THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Number of parties designated as MDM golden records. Measures MDM resolution coverage across the party population."
    - name: "fraud_flagged_party_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN fraud_indicator_flag = TRUE THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties flagged for fraud. Drives SIU referral volume and underwriting risk appetite decisions."
    - name: "ofac_match_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN ofac_match_flag = TRUE THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties with an OFAC sanctions match. Critical compliance KPI; any non-zero value triggers regulatory action."
    - name: "kyc_verified_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN kyc_status = 'Verified' THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties with completed KYC verification. Measures compliance onboarding throughput and regulatory readiness."
    - name: "avg_credit_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(credit_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average credit score across parties. Proxy for portfolio credit quality; informs pricing and underwriting guidelines."
    - name: "avg_years_in_business"
      expr: AVG(CAST(years_in_business AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average years in business for organizational parties. Longer tenure correlates with lower commercial risk; used in underwriting segmentation."
    - name: "do_not_contact_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN do_not_contact_flag = TRUE THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties marked do-not-contact. Governs outbound marketing suppression and regulatory compliance exposure."
    - name: "privacy_opt_out_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN privacy_opt_out_flag = TRUE THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties who have opted out of data sharing. Measures privacy compliance obligation scope."
    - name: "deceased_or_dissolved_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN date_of_death IS NOT NULL OR date_of_incorporation IS NOT NULL AND party_status = 'Dissolved' THEN party_id END)
      comment: "Count of parties that are deceased individuals or dissolved organizations. Flags stale records requiring policy and billing remediation."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per party. Strategic KPIs on the party master — population composition, data quality, compliance posture, and credit risk profile used by underwriting, compliance, and CX leadership.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`party_role`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per party role assignment. KPIs on role population, compliance posture, fraud exposure, and role lifecycle used by underwriting, claims, compliance, and distribution leadership."

    - name: "role_type_code"

      expr: subtype_code
      comment: "Granular sub-classification within a role type (e.g. First Party vs Third Party Claimant)."
    - name: "role_status"

      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the role assignment (Active, Expired, Terminated, Suspended)."
    - name: "acord_role_code"
      expr: acord_role_code
      comment: "ACORD-standard role code enabling cross-system and regulatory role classification."
    - name: "interest_type_code"

    - name: "relationship_to_insured"

    - name: "is_primary_role"
      expr: is_primary_role
      comment: "Indicates whether this is the primary role assignment for the party on the linked entity."
    - name: "ofac_match_flag"
      expr: ofac_match_flag
      comment: "OFAC sanctions match at the role level; may differ from party-level flag due to role-specific screening."
    - name: "siu_referral_flag"
      expr: siu_referral_flag
      comment: "Role has been referred to Special Investigations Unit; used to track fraud investigation pipeline."
    - name: "litigation_flag"

      comment: "Indicates the party in this role is involved in active litigation; drives legal expense forecasting."
    - name: "represented_by_counsel"

      comment: "Party in this role is represented by legal counsel; escalates claim complexity and settlement cost."
    - name: "kyc_verified"
      expr: kyc_verified
      comment: "KYC verification status at the role level; required for producer and payee roles."
    - name: "tax_reporting_required"

      comment: "Indicates whether a 1099 or other tax form must be issued for this role; drives finance reporting obligations."
    - name: "w9_on_file"

      comment: "W-9 form on file for this role; required before issuing payments to vendors and claimants."
    - name: "assignment_reason"
      expr: assignment_reason
      comment: "Business reason for the role assignment (e.g. Endorsement, Court Order, Acquisition)."
    - name: "termination_reason"
      expr: termination_reason
      comment: "Reason the role was terminated; used for attrition and compliance analysis."
    - name: "effective_year"
      expr: YEAR(effective_date)
      comment: "Year the role became effective; used for vintage and cohort analysis of role assignments."
    - name: "notification_preference"
      expr: notification_preference
      comment: "Preferred notification channel for this role (Email, Mail, SMS); governs regulatory notice delivery."
  measures:
    - name: "total_role_assignments"

      comment: "Total role assignment records. Baseline volume metric for role population sizing and MDM completeness."
    - name: "distinct_parties_with_roles"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT party_id)
      comment: "Count of unique parties holding at least one role. Measures active party engagement across the business lifecycle."
    - name: "active_role_count"

      comment: "Count of currently active role assignments. Drives operational workload sizing for underwriting, claims, and distribution."
    - name: "siu_referred_role_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN siu_referral_flag = TRUE THEN role_id END)
      comment: "Count of roles referred to SIU. Measures fraud investigation pipeline volume and SIU capacity utilization."
    - name: "litigation_role_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN litigation_flag = TRUE THEN role_id END)
      comment: "Count of roles in active litigation. Drives legal expense reserve adequacy and outside counsel capacity planning."
    - name: "represented_by_counsel_count"

    - name: "ofac_match_role_count"

    - name: "kyc_verified_role_count"

    - name: "w9_missing_taxable_role_count"

    - name: "avg_fraud_score"

    - name: "high_fraud_score_role_count"

    - name: "power_of_attorney_role_count"

    - name: "guardian_role_count"

      comment: "Count of roles where a guardian is designated. Identifies minor or incapacitated claimants requiring special handling."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per party role assignment. KPIs on role population, compliance posture, fraud exposure, and role lifecycle used by underwriting, claims, compliance, and distribution leadership.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`policy`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per policy. Strategic KPIs on the active policy portfolio: premium volume, risk concentration, renewal health, and underwriting tier mix to steer growth and profitability decisions."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`policy`.`policy`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "policy_status"
      expr: policy_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle status of the policy (Active, Cancelled, Expired, Non-Renewed). Primary filter for in-force portfolio analysis."
    - name: "lob_code"
      expr: lob_code
      comment: "Line of business code (e.g. HO, AUTO, CGL). Segments the portfolio by product line for underwriting and pricing review."
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "US state where the policy is written. Drives regulatory, rate, and geographic concentration analysis."
    - name: "underwriting_tier"
      expr: underwriting_tier
      comment: "Underwriting tier assigned at binding (Preferred, Standard, Non-Standard). Key dimension for loss ratio and profitability segmentation."
    - name: "territory_code"
      expr: territory_code
      comment: "Rating territory code. Used to aggregate exposure into catastrophe and geographic views."
    - name: "carrier_code"
      expr: carrier_code
      comment: "Writing company carrier code. Supports multi-carrier or fronting-company portfolio splits."
    - name: "program_code"
      expr: program_code
      comment: "Program or product code. Identifies specialty programs, affinity groups, or MGA programs within the portfolio."
    - name: "billing_method"
      expr: billing_method
      comment: "Billing method (Agency Bill, Direct Bill). Affects cash flow timing and producer settlement analysis."
    - name: "payment_plan_code"
      expr: payment_plan_code
      comment: "Installment or pay-in-full plan code. Informs billing delinquency and lapse risk analysis."
    - name: "renewal_indicator"
      expr: renewal_indicator
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating whether this policy is a renewal. Separates new business from renewal cohorts."
    - name: "auto_renew_flag"
      expr: auto_renew_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the policy is set to auto-renew. Supports retention and renewal automation reporting."
    - name: "facultative_flag"
      expr: facultative_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating facultative reinsurance is in place. Identifies policies with bespoke reinsurance arrangements."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_date)
      comment: "Policy effective date truncated to month. Enables written premium and new business cohort trending."
    - name: "expiration_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', expiration_date)
      comment: "Policy expiration date truncated to month. Supports renewal pipeline and expiring premium forecasting."
    - name: "inception_date_year"
      expr: YEAR(inception_date)
      comment: "Year the policy first incepted. Used for policy-year loss development and vintage analysis."
    - name: "cancellation_reason_code"
      expr: cancellation_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for cancellation (Non-Pay, Underwriting, Insured Request). Drives retention and underwriting quality analysis."
    - name: "term_months"
      expr: term_months
      comment: "Policy term length in months (6, 12). Affects earned premium calculation and renewal cycle planning."
  measures:
    - name: "policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of policies in the portfolio. Baseline measure for market share, growth rate, and capacity planning."
    - name: "total_written_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(written_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of written premium across all policies. Primary top-line revenue KPI for the underwriting portfolio."
    - name: "avg_written_premium_per_policy"
      expr: AVG(CAST(written_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average written premium per policy. Tracks pricing adequacy trends and mix shift between high- and low-premium segments."
    - name: "total_insured_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_insured_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of total insured value (TIV) across the portfolio. Core exposure metric for catastrophe accumulation and reinsurance purchasing."
    - name: "avg_insured_value_per_policy"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_insured_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average TIV per policy. Monitors concentration risk and adequacy of limits relative to exposure."
    - name: "avg_risk_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average underwriting risk score across the portfolio. Tracks portfolio quality drift and underwriting discipline over time."
    - name: "avg_commission_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(commission_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average producer commission rate across policies. Monitors distribution cost and producer incentive alignment."
    - name: "renewal_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN renewal_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of renewal policies. Numerator for retention rate; tracks the health of the renewal book."
    - name: "new_business_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN renewal_indicator = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of new business policies. Tracks organic growth and new customer acquisition volume."
    - name: "cancelled_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN policy_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of cancelled policies. Drives lapse rate, retention analysis, and underwriting quality review."
    - name: "facultative_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN facultative_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of policies with facultative reinsurance. Monitors bespoke reinsurance utilization and large-risk concentration."
    - name: "total_written_premium_new_business"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN renewal_indicator = FALSE THEN written_premium_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Written premium from new business policies only. Separates growth premium from renewal premium for pricing and channel analysis."
    - name: "total_written_premium_renewal"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN renewal_indicator = TRUE THEN written_premium_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Written premium from renewal policies only. Measures the retained book value and renewal pricing adequacy."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per policy. Strategic KPIs on the active policy portfolio: premium volume, risk concentration, renewal health, and underwriting tier mix to steer growth and profitability decisions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`policy_transaction`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per policy transaction (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement). Tracks policy lifecycle activity, premium change velocity, and underwriting workflow throughput."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`policy`.`policy_transaction`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_type_code"
      expr: type_code
      comment: "Transaction type (NB=New Business, RN=Renewal, EN=Endorsement, CN=Cancellation, RI=Reinstatement). Primary dimension for lifecycle activity analysis."
    - name: "transaction_status"
      expr: transaction_status
      comment: "Processing status of the transaction (Pending, Approved, Voided, Issued). Tracks workflow throughput and backlog."
    - name: "cancellation_type_code"
      expr: cancellation_type_code
      comment: "Cancellation type (Flat, Pro-Rata, Short-Rate). Affects return premium calculation and producer settlement."
    - name: "cancellation_basis"
      expr: cancellation_basis
      comment: "Basis for cancellation (Non-Pay, Underwriting, Insured Request, Regulatory). Drives retention and underwriting quality reporting."
    - name: "is_renewal_flag"
      expr: is_renewal_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating this transaction is a renewal. Separates renewal activity from new business and mid-term changes."
    - name: "is_midterm_flag"
      expr: is_midterm_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating a mid-term endorsement. Identifies policy changes occurring between inception and expiration."
    - name: "is_backdated_flag"
      expr: is_backdated_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag for backdated transactions. Flags potential accounting period mismatches and audit risk."
    - name: "requires_underwriting_review_flag"
      expr: requires_underwriting_review_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating the transaction requires underwriter review. Tracks referral volume and underwriting workflow load."
    - name: "reinsurance_cession_required_flag"
      expr: reinsurance_cession_required_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating a reinsurance cession must be created. Monitors reinsurance workflow compliance."
    - name: "regulatory_filing_required_flag"
      expr: regulatory_filing_required_flag
      comment: "Boolean flag for transactions requiring regulatory filing. Supports compliance monitoring and filing deadline tracking."
    - name: "source_system_code"
      expr: source_system_code
      comment: "Originating system code. Supports data lineage, system migration analysis, and reconciliation."
    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year
      comment: "Policy year of the transaction. Enables policy-year loss development and premium aggregation by accident year."
    - name: "accounting_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', accounting_date)
      comment: "Accounting date truncated to month. Aligns premium change transactions to accounting periods for financial reporting."
    - name: "effective_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_date)
      comment: "Transaction effective date truncated to month. Tracks when policy changes take effect for earned premium reconstruction."
    - name: "reason_code"
      expr: reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for the transaction. Provides operational context for endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements."
  measures:
    - name: "transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of policy transactions. Baseline measure for operational throughput, workflow volume, and system load."
    - name: "total_written_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(written_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net written premium change across all transactions. Tracks premium flow from endorsements, cancellations, and renewals."
    - name: "total_commission_impact"
      expr: SUM(CAST(commission_impact_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net commission impact from all transactions. Monitors producer compensation changes driven by mid-term and cancellation activity."
    - name: "avg_written_premium_change"
      expr: AVG(CAST(written_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average premium change per transaction. Tracks endorsement pricing adequacy and the magnitude of mid-term adjustments."
    - name: "endorsement_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN type_code = 'EN' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of endorsement transactions. Measures policy change activity volume and operational servicing cost."
    - name: "cancellation_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN type_code = 'CN' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of cancellation transactions. Key input to lapse rate, retention KPIs, and non-pay analysis."
    - name: "reinstatement_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN type_code = 'RI' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of reinstatement transactions. Tracks recovery of lapsed policies and billing effectiveness."
    - name: "avg_reinstatement_lapse_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(reinstatement_lapse_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days a policy was lapsed before reinstatement. Informs billing intervention timing and lapse recovery strategy."
    - name: "backdated_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_backdated_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of backdated transactions. Flags accounting period integrity risk and potential regulatory compliance issues."
    - name: "underwriting_referral_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN requires_underwriting_review_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions requiring underwriting review. Measures referral queue volume and underwriting workflow capacity demand."
    - name: "reinsurance_cession_required_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reinsurance_cession_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of transactions requiring a reinsurance cession. Monitors reinsurance workflow compliance and cession backlog."
    - name: "voided_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN transaction_status = 'Voided' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of voided transactions. Tracks data quality, processing errors, and operational rework volume."
    - name: "total_written_premium_change_cancellations"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN type_code = 'CN' THEN written_premium_change_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Return premium from cancellation transactions. Measures the financial impact of policy lapses on written premium."
    - name: "total_written_premium_change_endorsements"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN type_code = 'EN' THEN written_premium_change_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Net premium change from endorsements only. Tracks mid-term exposure changes and their revenue impact."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per policy transaction (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement). Tracks policy lifecycle activity, premium change velocity, and underwriting workflow throughput.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`policy_term`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per policy per term. Tracks term-level written premium, renewal lifecycle, underwriting company mix, and term duration to support earned premium, retention, and portfolio trend analysis."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`policy`.`term`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "term_status"
      expr: term_status
      comment: "Current status of the policy term (Active, Expired, Cancelled, Non-Renewed). Primary filter for in-force term analysis."
    - name: "lob"
      expr: lob
      comment: "Line of business for this term. Segments term premium and retention metrics by product line."
    - name: "is_renewal"
      expr: is_renewal
      comment: "Boolean flag indicating this term is a renewal of a prior term. Separates new business terms from renewal terms."
    - name: "renewal_type"
      expr: renewal_type
      comment: "Renewal type (Auto, Offered, Declined, Non-Renewed). Tracks renewal offer outcomes and retention funnel stages."
    - name: "cancellation_type"
      expr: cancellation_type
      comment: "Cancellation type for this term (Flat, Pro-Rata, Short-Rate). Affects return premium and producer settlement."
    - name: "cancellation_reason_code"
      expr: cancellation_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for term cancellation. Drives retention root-cause analysis and underwriting quality review."
    - name: "billing_method"
      expr: billing_method
      comment: "Billing method for this term (Agency Bill, Direct Bill). Affects cash flow and producer settlement timing."
    - name: "payment_plan_code"
      expr: payment_plan_code
      comment: "Installment plan code for this term. Informs billing delinquency and lapse risk segmentation."
    - name: "underwriting_company_code"
      expr: underwriting_company_code
      comment: "Code of the underwriting company writing this term. Supports multi-company portfolio and regulatory reporting splits."
    - name: "underwriting_company_name"
      expr: underwriting_company_name
      comment: "Name of the underwriting company. Human-readable label for company-level portfolio dashboards."
    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year
      comment: "Policy year of this term. Enables policy-year loss development triangles and premium aggregation."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year associated with this term. Aligns exposure to loss development and actuarial reserving views."
    - name: "calendar_year"
      expr: calendar_year
      comment: "Calendar year of the term. Supports calendar-year written and earned premium financial reporting."
    - name: "effective_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_date)
      comment: "Term effective date truncated to month. Enables monthly written premium trending and new business cohort analysis."
    - name: "expiration_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', expiration_date)
      comment: "Term expiration date truncated to month. Supports expiring premium forecasting and renewal pipeline management."
    - name: "rate_version"
      expr: rate_version
      comment: "Rate plan version applied to this term. Tracks rate change implementation and pricing adequacy over time."
    - name: "rate_effective_date_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', rate_effective_date)
      comment: "Rate effective date truncated to month. Monitors rate change rollout timing and its impact on written premium."
  measures:
    - name: "term_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of policy terms. Baseline measure for portfolio size, growth, and renewal volume tracking."

      expr: SUM(CAST(written_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of written premium across all terms. Primary top-line revenue KPI at the term grain for financial reporting."
    - name: "avg_written_premium_per_term"
      expr: AVG(CAST(written_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average written premium per term. Tracks pricing adequacy trends and average policy size over time."
    - name: "renewal_term_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_renewal = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of renewal terms. Numerator for term retention rate; measures the health of the renewal book."
    - name: "new_business_term_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_renewal = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of new business terms. Tracks organic growth and new customer acquisition at the term level."
    - name: "cancelled_term_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN term_status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of cancelled terms. Drives lapse rate calculation and retention performance monitoring."
    - name: "non_renewed_term_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN term_status = 'Non-Renewed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of non-renewed terms. Tracks voluntary and involuntary non-renewal volume for retention and regulatory reporting."
    - name: "avg_term_duration_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average term duration in days. Detects short-rate cancellations, mid-term lapses, and earned premium timing anomalies."
    - name: "total_written_premium_renewal"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_renewal = TRUE THEN written_premium_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Written premium from renewal terms only. Measures retained book value and renewal pricing adequacy."
    - name: "total_written_premium_new_business"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_renewal = FALSE THEN written_premium_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Written premium from new business terms only. Isolates growth premium for channel and pricing analysis."
    - name: "distinct_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct policies with at least one term. Measures the unique policy footprint independent of term count."
    - name: "total_written_premium_cancelled_terms"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN term_status = 'Cancelled' THEN written_premium_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
