CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`premium_audit`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Premium audit KPIs. Grain: one row per audit per policy per coverage period. Drives audit completion monitoring, exposure variance analysis, and audit premium recovery tracking for auditable commercial lines."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`premium`.`audit`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "audit_type"
      expr: audit_type
      comment: "Type of premium audit (Physical, Mail, Voluntary, Waived) — used to analyze audit method mix and cost efficiency."
    - name: "audit_status"
      expr: audit_status
      comment: "Current status of the audit (Scheduled, In Progress, Completed, Disputed) — drives audit workflow management."
    - name: "method"
      expr: method
      comment: "Audit methodology applied (Payroll, Sales, Units, Area) — used to classify audits by exposure basis."
    - name: "billing_adjustment_status"
      expr: billing_adjustment_status
      comment: "Status of the billing adjustment resulting from the audit (Billed, Collected, Waived) — drives audit receivables management."
    - name: "deposit_reconciliation_status"
      expr: deposit_reconciliation_status
      comment: "Status of deposit premium reconciliation against audited premium — used to identify outstanding audit balances."
    - name: "dispute_flag"
      expr: dispute_flag
      comment: "TRUE if the audit result is disputed by the policyholder — monitors audit dispute rate and resolution cycle time."
    - name: "is_minimum_premium_applied"
      expr: is_minimum_premium_applied
      comment: "TRUE if minimum premium was applied on the audit — identifies audits where exposure fell below minimum threshold."
    - name: "waiver_flag"
      expr: waiver_flag
      comment: "TRUE if the audit was waived — monitors audit waiver prevalence and its impact on premium accuracy."
    - name: "completion_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', completion_date)
      comment: "Month the audit was completed — used for audit completion trend analysis and cycle time monitoring."
    - name: "period_start_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', period_start_date)
      comment: "Month the audit period started — used to align audit results to the policy term being audited."
  measures:
    - name: "total_audited_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(audited_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total premium determined by audit. Represents the final premium obligation for auditable policies."
    - name: "total_estimated_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated (deposit) premium collected before audit. Used to compute audit premium variance and recovery."
    - name: "total_premium_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(premium_variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between audited and estimated premium. Positive values indicate additional premium due; negative values indicate return premium."
    - name: "total_return_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(return_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total return premium issued following audit. Measures over-collection of deposit premium requiring refund."
    - name: "total_audited_exposure"
      expr: SUM(CAST(audited_exposure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total audited exposure units (payroll, sales, etc.). Used to compute actual rate per unit of exposure."
    - name: "total_estimated_exposure"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_exposure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated exposure units at policy inception. Used to measure exposure estimation accuracy."
    - name: "total_exposure_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(exposure_variance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between audited and estimated exposure. Measures systematic under- or over-estimation of exposure at inception."
    - name: "avg_exposure_variance_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(exposure_variance_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average percentage variance between audited and estimated exposure. Key underwriting accuracy metric for auditable lines."
    - name: "total_minimum_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(minimum_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total minimum premium applied on audits. Quantifies the minimum premium floor impact on audit results."
    - name: "audit_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of audit records. Baseline volume metric for audit program throughput and workload management."
    - name: "disputed_audit_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dispute_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of disputed audits. Elevated dispute rates signal audit quality issues or policyholder dissatisfaction."
    - name: "waived_audit_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN waiver_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of waived audits. Monitors audit waiver prevalence and its impact on premium accuracy and revenue leakage."
$$
metric_views.description: Premium audit KPIs. Grain: one row per audit per policy per coverage period. Drives audit completion monitoring, exposure variance analysis, and audit premium recovery tracking for auditable commercial lines.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`premium_ceded_premium`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Reinsurance ceded premium KPIs. Grain: one row per ceded premium transaction per cession per policy term. Drives reinsurance cost analysis, net retention monitoring, and treaty/facultative performance reporting."

    - name: "cession_basis"

    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Type of ceded premium transaction (Original, Adjustment, Return) — used to reconcile ceded premium movements."
    - name: "settlement_status"
      expr: settlement_status
      comment: "Settlement status of the ceded premium with the reinsurer (Pending, Settled, Disputed) — drives reinsurance payables management."
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "State jurisdiction of the ceded risk — used for statutory ceded premium reporting by state."

    - name: "bordereaux_reporting_flag"

    - name: "transaction_month"

  measures:
    - name: "total_ceded_written_premium"

    - name: "total_net_ceded_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_ceded_premium AS DOUBLE))

      comment: "Total profit commission earned from reinsurers on profitable treaties. Measures performance-based reinsurance income."
    - name: "avg_cession_rate"

      comment: "Average cession rate across all ceded premium transactions. Monitors quota share treaty utilization and retention strategy."
    - name: "avg_ceding_commission_rate"

      comment: "Average ceding commission rate received from reinsurers. Tracks reinsurance terms and commission adequacy over time."
    - name: "cession_count"

    - name: "distinct_reinsurer_count"

metric_views.description: Reinsurance ceded premium KPIs. Grain: one row per ceded premium transaction per cession per policy term. Drives reinsurance cost analysis, net retention monitoring, and treaty/facultative performance reporting.

    - name: "transaction_reason_code"
      expr: transaction_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for the endorsement transaction — used to analyze drivers of mid-term policy changes."
    - name: "proration_method"
      expr: proration_method
      comment: "Method used to prorate the endorsement premium (Pro-Rata, Short-Rate, Flat) — affects premium change calculations."
    - name: "billing_status"
      expr: billing_status
      comment: "Billing status of the endorsement (Billed, Unbilled, Waived) — used for billing operations and receivables monitoring."
    - name: "statutory_line_code"
      expr: statutory_line_code
      comment: "NAIC statutory line code for regulatory endorsement premium reporting."
    - name: "is_billable"
      expr: is_billable
      comment: "TRUE if the endorsement generates a billable premium change — separates administrative from financial endorsements."
    - name: "transaction_effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_effective_date)
      comment: "Month the endorsement became effective — used for mid-term premium change trend analysis."
    - name: "source_system_code"
      expr: source_system_code
      comment: "Source system that originated the endorsement — used for data lineage and system reconciliation."
  measures:
    - name: "total_written_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(written_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total written premium change from endorsements. Measures the net premium impact of mid-term policy modifications."
    - name: "total_gross_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross premium change before cessions and commissions. Full financial impact of endorsement activity."
    - name: "total_net_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net premium change after ceded reinsurance. Measures the insurer's retained premium impact from endorsements."
    - name: "total_earned_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(earned_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total earned premium change from endorsements. Impacts current period revenue recognition and income statement."
    - name: "total_unearned_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unearned_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unearned premium change from endorsements. Impacts the unearned premium reserve balance sheet liability."
    - name: "total_ceded_premium_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_premium_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded premium change from endorsements. Used to reconcile reinsurance cession adjustments from mid-term changes."
    - name: "total_commission_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(commission_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total commission change from endorsements. Measures the producer compensation impact of mid-term policy modifications."
    - name: "total_tax_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax change from endorsements. Used for tax remittance adjustments and regulatory reporting."
    - name: "total_fee_change"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fee_change_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fee change from endorsements. Tracks fee revenue impact of mid-term policy modifications."
    - name: "endorsement_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of endorsement transactions. Baseline volume metric for endorsement processing throughput and operational capacity."
    - name: "avg_days_in_term_remaining"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_in_term_remaining AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average days remaining in the policy term at endorsement. Indicates how early or late in the term endorsements occur."
    - name: "avg_proration_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(proration_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average proration factor applied to endorsements. Validates proration accuracy and identifies systematic proration anomalies."
$$
metric_views.description: Policy endorsement premium impact KPIs. Grain: one row per endorsement transaction per policy term. Drives mid-term premium change analysis, endorsement volume monitoring, and billing adjustment tracking.

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML

    - name: "is_commission_bearing"

      comment: "TRUE if the fee is subject to producer commission — used to compute commissionable fee base."
    - name: "state_code"

    - name: "transaction_effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_effective_date)
      comment: "Month the fee transaction became effective — used for fee revenue trend analysis by period."
  measures:
    - name: "total_fee_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fee_amount AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "avg_fee_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fee amount per transaction. Tracks fee level trends and identifies fee adequacy or competitive pricing issues."
    - name: "total_fee_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fee_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of fee units assessed. Used for unit-based fee revenue analysis (e.g., per-vehicle inspection fees)."
    - name: "avg_fee_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fee_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fee rate applied. Monitors fee rate consistency and identifies rate anomalies across jurisdictions."
    - name: "fee_transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)

    - name: "refundable_fee_count"

    - name: "total_refundable_fee_amount"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`premium_transaction`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core premium financial KPIs. Grain: one row per premium financial transaction (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, and Insured Risk. Drives written premium, earned premium, and return premium analysis."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`premium`.`premium_transaction`"
  filter: reversal_indicator = FALSE
  dimensions:
    - name: "transaction_type"
      expr: transaction_type
      comment: "Type of premium transaction: New Business, Renewal, Endorsement, Cancellation, Reinstatement — enables lifecycle segmentation."
    - name: "transaction_status"
      expr: transaction_status
      comment: "Current processing status of the premium transaction (Posted, Pending, Reversed) for operational monitoring."
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "US state jurisdiction of the risk, used for statutory and regulatory premium reporting."
    - name: "earning_method"
      expr: earning_method
      comment: "Method used to earn premium over the policy term (Pro-Rata, Short-Rate) — affects unearned reserve calculations."
    - name: "endorsement_type"
      expr: endorsement_type
      comment: "Sub-classification of endorsement transactions (Coverage Change, Name Change, Address Change) for endorsement mix analysis."
    - name: "direct_billed_indicator"
      expr: direct_billed_indicator
      comment: "TRUE if premium is billed directly to the insured rather than through the producer — drives billing channel analysis."
    - name: "transaction_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', transaction_date)
      comment: "Calendar month of the premium transaction booking date for trend and period-over-period analysis."
    - name: "effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', effective_date)
      comment: "Month the premium transaction becomes effective — used to align written premium to policy inception cohorts."
    - name: "payment_plan_code"
      expr: payment_plan_code
      comment: "Installment or payment plan code associated with the transaction — used to analyze billing plan mix."
    - name: "audit_basis"
      expr: audit_basis
      comment: "Basis on which the premium was audited (Payroll, Sales, Units) — relevant for auditable commercial lines policies."
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_written_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_written_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross written premium across all transactions before cessions and commissions. Primary top-line revenue KPI for P&C insurers."
    - name: "total_net_written_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_written_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net written premium after ceded reinsurance. Measures the insurer's retained premium exposure and is a core solvency metric."
    - name: "total_earned_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(earned_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total earned premium recognized as revenue for the period. Denominator for loss ratio and combined ratio calculations."
    - name: "total_unearned_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(unearned_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total unearned premium reserve — the portion of written premium not yet earned. Key balance sheet liability metric."
    - name: "total_return_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(return_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total return premium issued to policyholders on cancellations and mid-term reductions. Monitors cancellation financial impact."
    - name: "total_ceded_written_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_written_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total written premium ceded to reinsurers. Measures reinsurance utilization and net retention strategy effectiveness."
    - name: "avg_gross_written_premium_per_transaction"
      expr: AVG(CAST(gross_written_premium AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average gross written premium per transaction. Tracks average policy size trends and mix shifts over time."
    - name: "avg_days_in_force"
      expr: AVG(CAST(days_in_force AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days a policy is in force per transaction. Indicates policy persistency and cancellation timing patterns."
    - name: "transaction_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of premium transactions. Baseline volume metric for throughput and operational capacity monitoring."
    - name: "policy_count_distinct"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct policies with premium transactions in the period. Measures active policy portfolio size."
    - name: "avg_pro_rata_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(pro_rata_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average pro-rata factor across transactions. Values significantly below 1.0 indicate high mid-term cancellation or endorsement activity."
    - name: "avg_exposure_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(exposure_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average exposure amount (e.g., payroll, vehicle count) per transaction. Tracks exposure base trends for rate adequacy monitoring."
    - name: "total_exposure_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(exposure_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total exposure amount across all transactions. Used to compute rate per unit of exposure for pricing adequacy analysis."
$$
metric_views.description: Core premium financial KPIs. Grain: one row per premium financial transaction (Written, Earned, Unearned, Return) tied to Policy, Policy Term, Coverage, and Insured Risk. Drives written premium, earned premium, and return premium analysis.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`premium_retrospective_adjustment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Retrospective premium adjustment KPIs. Grain: one row per retro adjustment per policy term evaluation. Drives retro-rated policy performance monitoring, loss-sensitive premium analysis, and adjustment cycle management."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`premium`.`retrospective_adjustment`"
  filter: reversal_indicator = FALSE
  dimensions:
    - name: "adjustment_type"
      expr: adjustment_type
      comment: "Type of retrospective adjustment (Interim, Final, Re-evaluation) — used to track adjustment cycle stage."
    - name: "adjustment_status"
      expr: adjustment_status
      comment: "Current status of the adjustment (Pending, Approved, Billed, Disputed) — drives retro billing workflow management."
    - name: "calculation_method_code"
      expr: calculation_method_code
      comment: "Method used to calculate the retro premium (Standard Retro, Large Risk, IRPM) — used to classify retro program types."
    - name: "loss_limitation_type"
      expr: loss_limitation_type
      comment: "Type of loss limitation applied (Per Occurrence, Aggregate) — used to analyze loss limitation program structure."
    - name: "is_maximum_applied"
      expr: is_maximum_applied
      comment: "TRUE if the maximum premium cap was applied — identifies policies where loss experience exceeded the retro maximum."
    - name: "is_minimum_applied"
      expr: is_minimum_applied
      comment: "TRUE if the minimum premium floor was applied — identifies policies where favorable loss experience triggered the minimum."
    - name: "statutory_line_code"
      expr: statutory_line_code
      comment: "NAIC statutory line code for regulatory retro premium reporting."
    - name: "evaluation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', evaluation_date)
      comment: "Month of the retro evaluation date — used to track adjustment timing and evaluation cycle adherence."
    - name: "adjustment_effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', adjustment_effective_date)
      comment: "Month the adjustment became effective — used for retro premium trend analysis by period."
  measures:
    - name: "total_calculated_retro_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(calculated_retro_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total calculated retrospective premium before min/max application. Measures raw loss-sensitive premium obligation."
    - name: "total_final_retro_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(final_retro_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total final retrospective premium after min/max caps. Actual premium billed to policyholders under retro programs."
    - name: "total_standard_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(standard_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total standard premium base for retro calculations. Used to compute retro premium as a percentage of standard premium."
    - name: "total_basic_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(basic_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total basic premium component of retro calculations. Represents the fixed cost element of the retrospective premium formula."
    - name: "total_incurred_losses"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incurred_losses_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total incurred losses used in retro premium calculations. Measures loss experience driving retro premium adjustments."
    - name: "total_converted_losses"
      expr: SUM(CAST(converted_losses_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total converted losses after loss conversion factor application. Represents the loss component entering the retro formula."
    - name: "total_adjustment_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjustment_variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between current and prior retro adjustment. Measures the financial impact of each evaluation cycle."
    - name: "avg_loss_conversion_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(loss_conversion_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average loss conversion factor applied in retro calculations. Monitors LCF trends and actuarial assumption changes."
    - name: "avg_tax_multiplier"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tax_multiplier AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tax multiplier applied in retro premium calculations. Tracks tax loading trends in retro programs."
    - name: "adjustment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of retrospective adjustments processed. Baseline volume metric for retro billing cycle throughput."
    - name: "maximum_applied_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_maximum_applied = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of adjustments where maximum premium cap was triggered. High counts indicate adverse loss experience in retro programs."
    - name: "minimum_applied_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_minimum_applied = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of adjustments where minimum premium floor was triggered. Measures favorable loss experience prevalence in retro programs."
$$
metric_views.description: Retrospective premium adjustment KPIs. Grain: one row per retro adjustment per policy term evaluation. Drives retro-rated policy performance monitoring, loss-sensitive premium analysis, and adjustment cycle management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`premium_tax_levy`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Premium tax and levy KPIs. Grain: one row per tax levy transaction per policy transaction. Drives tax compliance monitoring, remittance tracking, and surplus lines tax reporting across jurisdictions."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`premium`.`tax_levy`"
  filter: tax_adjustment_flag = FALSE OR tax_adjustment_flag IS NULL
  dimensions:
    - name: "tax_type_code"

    - name: "tax_reporting_category_code"
      expr: tax_reporting_category_code
      comment: "Reporting category for the tax — used to aggregate taxes for regulatory filings and statutory financial statements."
    - name: "tax_remittance_status"
      expr: tax_remittance_status
      comment: "Status of tax remittance to the taxing authority (Pending, Remitted, Overdue) — drives tax compliance monitoring."
    - name: "tax_calculation_method_code"
      expr: tax_calculation_method_code
      comment: "Method used to calculate the tax (Rate on Premium, Flat Fee, Tiered) — used to audit tax calculation accuracy."
    - name: "surplus_lines_flag"
      expr: surplus_lines_flag
      comment: "TRUE if this is a surplus lines tax — separates admitted and non-admitted market tax obligations."
    - name: "tax_exemption_flag"
      expr: tax_exemption_flag
      comment: "TRUE if the policy is exempt from this tax — monitors tax exemption prevalence and compliance."
    - name: "tax_authority_name"
      expr: tax_authority_name
      comment: "Name of the taxing authority (State DOI, FHCF, FAIR Plan) — used to aggregate tax obligations by authority."
    - name: "policy_transaction_type_code"
      expr: policy_transaction_type_code
      comment: "Policy transaction type that generated the tax (New Business, Renewal, Endorsement) — used to analyze tax by lifecycle stage."
    - name: "tax_effective_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', tax_effective_date)
      comment: "Month the tax became effective — used for period-end tax accrual and remittance scheduling."
    - name: "tax_remittance_due_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', tax_remittance_due_date)
      comment: "Month the tax remittance is due — used for cash flow planning and overdue tax identification."
  measures:
    - name: "total_tax_levy_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax and levy amount assessed. Primary tax expense metric for regulatory compliance and financial reporting."
    - name: "total_taxable_premium_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(taxable_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total premium base subject to taxation. Used to validate effective tax rates and identify taxable premium anomalies."
    - name: "avg_tax_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tax_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average tax rate applied across all levy transactions. Monitors effective tax rate trends by jurisdiction and line."
    - name: "tax_levy_count"

      comment: "Total number of tax levy transactions. Baseline volume metric for tax processing throughput."
    - name: "surplus_lines_tax_count"

      comment: "Count of surplus lines tax transactions. Monitors non-admitted market tax volume and compliance obligations."
    - name: "total_surplus_lines_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN surplus_lines_flag = TRUE THEN CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)

    - name: "overdue_remittance_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN tax_remittance_status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of overdue tax remittances. Critical compliance metric — elevated counts signal regulatory penalty risk."
    - name: "distinct_policy_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id)
      comment: "Count of distinct policies with tax levy transactions. Measures taxable policy portfolio breadth."
$$
metric_views.description: Premium tax and levy KPIs. Grain: one row per tax levy transaction per policy transaction. Drives tax compliance monitoring, remittance tracking, and surplus lines tax reporting across jurisdictions.

AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per bordereaux submission — the periodic reinsurance accounting statement sent to reinsurers. Tracks ceded premium, losses, reserves, commissions, and net settlement balances per reporting period and reinsurer."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`reinsurance`.`bordereaux`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "bordereaux_type"
      expr: bordereaux_type
      comment: "Type of bordereaux (Premium, Loss, Combined) for segmenting reinsurance accounting statements by purpose."
    - name: "bordereaux_status"
      expr: bordereaux_status
      comment: "Current status of the bordereaux (Draft, Submitted, Accepted, Rejected, Finalized) for settlement pipeline management."
    - name: "submission_format"
      expr: submission_format
      comment: "Format used for bordereaux submission (ACORD, Excel, EDI) for operational efficiency and automation tracking."
    - name: "submission_method"
      expr: submission_method
      comment: "Submission channel (Email, Portal, API) for process automation and SLA compliance monitoring."
    - name: "reporting_period_start_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', reporting_period_start_date)
      comment: "Reporting period start month for time-series premium and loss settlement analysis."
    - name: "reporting_period_end_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', reporting_period_end_date)
      comment: "Reporting period end month for bordereaux cycle completeness and timeliness monitoring."
    - name: "accepted_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', accepted_date)
      comment: "Month the bordereaux was accepted by the reinsurer. Used to measure submission-to-acceptance cycle time."
  measures:
    - name: "total_ceded_written_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_written_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded written premium reported on bordereaux. Primary reinsurance premium settlement metric."
    - name: "total_ceded_earned_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_earned_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded earned premium on bordereaux. Used to compute reinsurance cost ratios and net earned premium."
    - name: "total_ceded_unearned_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_unearned_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total ceded unearned premium reported. Balance-sheet metric for future reinsurance coverage obligations."
    - name: "total_ceded_loss_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total losses ceded as reported on bordereaux. Measures reinsurance recovery value per settlement period."
    - name: "total_ceded_paid_loss"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_paid_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total paid losses ceded on bordereaux. Cash-basis recovery metric for reinsurance settlement cash flow."
    - name: "total_ceded_outstanding_reserve"
      expr: SUM(CAST(ceded_outstanding_loss_reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding loss reserves ceded. Represents future expected reinsurance recoveries on open claims."
    - name: "total_ceded_ibnr"

    - name: "total_ceding_commission"

    - name: "commutation_flag"

    - name: "reinstatement_premium_flag"

    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year

    - name: "calendar_year"
      expr: calendar_year

    - name: "billed_date"

    - name: "collected_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', collected_date)

    - name: "total_outstanding_amount"

metric_views.description: Grain: one row per reinsurance recovery financial movement. Tracks billed, collected, and outstanding recovery amounts per claim, reinsurer, and accounting period. Core metric for reinsurance collectibility and cash management.

      comment: "Average replacement cost per building. Benchmarked against Marshall & Swift indices for adequacy."
    - name: "total_actual_cash_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cash_value_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual cash value. Compared to replacement cost to quantify depreciation exposure."
    - name: "avg_actual_cash_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_cash_value_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average ACV per building. Used in ACV policy pricing and claim reserve adequacy assessment."
    - name: "avg_roof_age_years"
      expr: AVG(CAST(roof_age_years AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average roof age in years. Older roofs drive higher wind/hail claims; key underwriting risk factor."
    - name: "avg_year_built"
      expr: AVG(CAST(year_built AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average year built. Older building stock correlates with higher loss frequency and severity."
    - name: "avg_total_floor_area_sqft"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_floor_area_sqft AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average floor area in square feet. Used to validate replacement cost per square foot adequacy."
    - name: "sprinklered_building_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sprinkler_system_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)

    - name: "avg_number_of_stories"
      expr: AVG(CAST(number_of_stories AS DOUBLE))

    - name: "total_floor_area_sqft"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_floor_area_sqft AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total insured floor area in square feet. Aggregate exposure metric for commercial property portfolios."

metric_views.description: Grain: one row per building per location. KPIs for the building subtype: replacement cost adequacy, construction quality, age-based risk, and protection features for property underwriting and cat modeling.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`risk_driver`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Grain: one row per driver per auto risk. KPIs for the driver subtype: MVR quality, telematics adoption, discount eligibility, and risk score distribution for auto underwriting and pricing segmentation."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`riskexposure`.`driver`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "license_state_code"
      expr: license_state_code
      comment: "State of driver license issuance. Used for regulatory compliance and geographic risk segmentation."
    - name: "license_status_code"
      expr: license_status_code
      comment: "License status (Valid, Suspended, Revoked). Suspended/revoked licenses are underwriting red flags."
    - name: "license_class_code"
      expr: license_class_code
      comment: "License class (A, B, C, CDL). Commercial license classes indicate professional driver status."
    - name: "marital_status"
      expr: marital_status
      comment: "Driver marital status. Married drivers statistically have lower loss frequency; used in pricing."
    - name: "gender"
      expr: gender
      comment: "Driver gender. Used in states where gender-based rating is permitted for actuarial segmentation."
    - name: "mvr_status_code"
      expr: mvr_status_code
      comment: "MVR order status (Ordered, Received, Clear, Violations). Tracks underwriting workflow completeness."
    - name: "is_principal_driver"
      expr: is_principal_driver
      comment: "Principal driver flag. Principal drivers carry the primary rating factors for the vehicle."
    - name: "is_excluded_driver"
      expr: is_excluded_driver
      comment: "Excluded driver flag. Excluded drivers are not covered; tracking prevents coverage disputes."
    - name: "sr22_required_flag"
      expr: sr22_required_flag
      comment: "SR-22 filing required flag. SR-22 drivers are high-risk; significant pricing and appetite implications."
    - name: "telematics_enrolled_flag"
      expr: telematics_enrolled_flag
      comment: "Telematics program enrollment. Telematics data enables usage-based pricing and loss prediction."
    - name: "good_student_discount_flag"
      expr: good_student_discount_flag
      comment: "Good student discount eligibility. Tracks discount program participation and pricing accuracy."
    - name: "type_code"
      expr: type_code
      comment: "Driver type code (Primary, Secondary, Occasional). Affects rating factor application."
  measures:
    - name: "total_driver_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total drivers in scope. Baseline count for auto portfolio driver exposure tracking."
    - name: "avg_mvr_violation_count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mvr_violation_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average MVR violations per driver. Key underwriting quality metric; high values signal adverse selection."
    - name: "avg_mvr_accident_count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mvr_accident_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average prior accidents per driver. Directly predicts future loss frequency; core pricing variable."
    - name: "avg_mvr_dui_count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mvr_dui_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average DUI count per driver. DUI history is a critical underwriting flag and surcharge trigger."
    - name: "avg_mvr_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mvr_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average MVR score across drivers. Composite driving record score used in pricing algorithms."
    - name: "avg_telematics_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(CASE WHEN telematics_enrolled_flag = TRUE THEN telematics_score ELSE NULL END AS INT))
      comment: "Average telematics score for enrolled drivers. Measures UBI program effectiveness and discount adequacy."
    - name: "telematics_enrollment_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN telematics_enrolled_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of drivers enrolled in telematics. Tracks UBI program adoption and pricing sophistication."
    - name: "sr22_driver_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sr22_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of drivers requiring SR-22 filings. High-risk segment requiring regulatory compliance tracking."
    - name: "sr22_driver_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN sr22_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of drivers with SR-22 requirements. Monitors high-risk driver concentration in the book."
    - name: "excluded_driver_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_excluded_driver = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of excluded drivers. Excluded drivers create coverage gap risk if they operate the vehicle."
    - name: "avg_rating_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(rating_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average driver rating factor. Tracks overall driver risk quality and pricing adequacy across the book."
    - name: "avg_years_licensed"
      expr: AVG(CAST(years_licensed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average years licensed per driver. Experience is inversely correlated with accident frequency."
    - name: "good_driver_discount_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN good_driver_discount_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of drivers qualifying for good driver discount. Tracks preferred driver mix in the portfolio."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per driver per auto risk. KPIs for the driver subtype: MVR quality, telematics adoption, discount eligibility, and risk score distribution for auto underwriting and pricing segmentation.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`risk_insured_risk`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Grain: one row per insured risk per policy term. Strategic KPIs for the insured risk supertype: TIV concentration, hazard scoring, exposure units, and prior-loss indicators used by underwriters and cat management."

      comment: "ISO/company rating territory code used for geographic pricing and cat aggregation."
    - name: "flood_zone"
      expr: flood_zone_code
      comment: "FEMA flood zone classification; critical for property cat exposure segmentation."
    - name: "occupancy_code"
      expr: occupancy_code
      comment: "Occupancy type (residential, commercial, industrial) for underwriting segmentation."
    - name: "valuation_method"
      expr: valuation_method
      comment: "Replacement cost vs. ACV valuation method; affects TIV accuracy and adequacy."
    - name: "cat_zone"

      expr: SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Insured Value (TIV) across all risks. Primary cat accumulation and capacity metric."
    - name: "avg_tiv_per_risk"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average TIV per insured risk. Indicates average risk size; outliers signal concentration."
    - name: "total_sum_insured"
      expr: SUM(CAST(sum_insured_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of all insured amounts. Used alongside TIV to measure insurance-to-value adequacy."
    - name: "avg_hazard_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(hazard_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average underwriter hazard score across risks. Tracks portfolio risk quality over time."
    - name: "avg_risk_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average composite risk score. Drives pricing adequacy and reinsurance attachment analysis."
    - name: "total_exposure_units"
      expr: SUM(CAST(exposure_units AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total exposure units (e.g. payroll, area, vehicles). Denominator for rate-per-unit pricing."
    - name: "total_prior_loss_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(prior_loss_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Aggregate prior loss amount on risks. Underwriting quality signal; high values flag adverse selection."
    - name: "avg_prior_loss_count"
      expr: AVG(CAST(prior_loss_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of prior losses per risk. Key underwriting acceptability and pricing factor."
    - name: "inspection_required_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN inspection_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of risks requiring inspection. Tracks underwriting workflow completeness."
    - name: "avg_geocode_quality_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(geocode_quality_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average geocode quality score. Low scores indicate location data gaps that impair cat modeling."
    - name: "avg_itv_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(itv_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average insurance-to-value percentage. Values below 100% signal underinsurance risk."
    - name: "avg_coinsurance_percentage"

metric_views.description: Grain: one row per insured risk per policy term. Strategic KPIs for the insured risk supertype: TIV concentration, hazard scoring, exposure units, and prior-loss indicators used by underwriters and cat management.

WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Grain: one row per insured location. Geographic concentration and cat exposure KPIs: TIV by territory, flood/wind/wildfire zone accumulation, and coastal exposure for reinsurance and cat management."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`riskexposure`.`location`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "state_code"
      expr: state_code
      comment: "US state code. Primary geographic dimension for regulatory, pricing, and cat accumulation views."
    - name: "county"
      expr: county
      comment: "County name. Sub-state geographic aggregation for cat zone and territory analysis."
    - name: "territory_code"
      expr: territory_code
      comment: "Company rating territory code. Maps to pricing relativities and reinsurance treaty zones."
    - name: "flood_zone_code"
      expr: flood_zone_code
      comment: "FEMA flood zone (A, AE, X, etc.). Critical for flood exposure accumulation and NFIP compliance."
    - name: "wind_zone_code"
      expr: wind_zone_code
      comment: "Wind zone classification. Drives windstorm cat model inputs and wind pool eligibility."
    - name: "wildfire_zone_code"
      expr: wildfire_zone_code
      comment: "Wildfire hazard zone. Increasingly critical for California and western US underwriting appetite."
    - name: "earthquake_zone_code"
      expr: earthquake_zone_code
      comment: "Seismic zone code. Used for earthquake cat accumulation and facultative reinsurance decisions."
    - name: "construction_type"
      expr: construction_type
      comment: "Construction type at location level. Aggregates building-level construction for territory analysis."
    - name: "occupancy_type"
      expr: occupancy_type
      comment: "Occupancy type at location level. Used for commercial vs. residential portfolio segmentation."
    - name: "coastal_indicator"
      expr: coastal_indicator
      comment: "Coastal location flag. Coastal TIV concentration is a key reinsurance and cat management metric."
    - name: "wind_pool_eligible"
      expr: wind_pool_eligible
      comment: "Wind pool eligibility flag. Identifies risks that must be ceded to state wind pools."
    - name: "protection_class"
      expr: protection_class
      comment: "ISO fire protection class at location. Aggregates protection class distribution by territory."
  measures:
    - name: "total_location_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total insured locations. Baseline count for geographic concentration and growth analysis."
    - name: "total_tiv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total insured value at location level. Primary cat accumulation metric by zone and territory."
    - name: "total_insured_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_insured_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total insured value (alternate field). Cross-validated against tiv_amount for data quality."
    - name: "avg_tiv_per_location"
      expr: AVG(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average TIV per location. Identifies high-value concentration risks requiring facultative reinsurance."
    - name: "coastal_tiv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN coastal_indicator = TRUE THEN tiv_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "TIV on coastal locations. Key metric for windstorm cat accumulation and coastal reinsurance treaties."
    - name: "coastal_tiv_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN coastal_indicator = TRUE THEN tiv_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(tiv_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Coastal TIV as percentage of total TIV. Monitors coastal concentration against reinsurance appetite limits."
    - name: "wind_pool_eligible_tiv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN wind_pool_eligible = TRUE THEN tiv_amount ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "TIV eligible for state wind pools. Drives mandatory cession calculations and residual market reporting."
    - name: "avg_wildfire_risk_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(wildfire_risk_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average wildfire risk score by segment. Tracks portfolio wildfire exposure quality and trend."
    - name: "avg_square_footage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(square_footage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average location square footage. Used to validate TIV adequacy per square foot by territory."
    - name: "distinct_zip_code_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT zip_code)
      comment: "Count of distinct ZIP codes with insured locations. Measures geographic diversification of the book."
$$
metric_views.description: Grain: one row per insured location. Geographic concentration and cat exposure KPIs: TIV by territory, flood/wind/wildfire zone accumulation, and coastal exposure for reinsurance and cat management.

    - name: "fiscal_year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year for grouping written premium, earned premium, and incurred loss KPIs by annual reporting cycle."
    - name: "fiscal_quarter"
      expr: fiscal_quarter
      comment: "Fiscal quarter (1-4) enabling quarterly combined ratio and reserve adequacy trend analysis."
    - name: "fiscal_month"
      expr: fiscal_month
      comment: "Fiscal month (1-12) for monthly earned premium and loss development tracking."
    - name: "policy_year"
      expr: policy_year
      comment: "Policy year dimension for accident-year vs. policy-year loss development triangle analysis."
    - name: "accident_year"
      expr: accident_year
      comment: "Accident year for Schedule P loss development and IBNR reserve adequacy evaluation."
    - name: "naic_reporting_year"
      expr: naic_reporting_year
      comment: "NAIC statutory reporting year for regulatory filing alignment and Schedule P triangle construction."
    - name: "naic_reporting_quarter"
      expr: naic_reporting_quarter
      comment: "NAIC statutory reporting quarter for quarterly statutory financial statement preparation."
    - name: "gaap_period_key"
      expr: gaap_period_key
      comment: "GAAP period identifier for US GAAP financial statement period alignment and earned premium recognition."
    - name: "sap_period_key"
      expr: sap_period_key
      comment: "Statutory Accounting Principles period key for NAIC statutory financial statement reporting."
    - name: "ifrs17_period_key"
      expr: ifrs17_period_key
      comment: "IFRS 17 period key for international insurance contract standard reporting and CSM roll-forward."
    - name: "is_closed"
      expr: is_closed
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the accounting period is closed; used to filter finalized vs. in-progress financial data."
    - name: "is_current_period"
      expr: is_current_period
      comment: "Flag identifying the current active accounting period for real-time dashboard filtering."
    - name: "period_name"
      expr: period_name
      comment: "Human-readable period label (e.g., Q1 2024) for display in executive dashboards and board decks."
    - name: "valuation_date"
      expr: valuation_date
      comment: "Actuarial valuation date for reserve adequacy assessment and loss development triangle construction."
    - name: "start_date"
      expr: start_date
      comment: "Period start date for effective-date range filtering of in-force policies and earned premium calculations."
    - name: "end_date"
      expr: end_date
      comment: "Period end date for boundary filtering of policy terms, premium transactions, and claim financials."
  measures:
    - name: "total_periods"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of calendar periods defined; baseline measure for period coverage completeness validation."
    - name: "closed_period_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_closed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of closed accounting periods; monitors financial close cadence and period lock compliance."
    - name: "open_period_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_closed = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of open accounting periods; identifies periods still accepting premium and loss postings."
    - name: "avg_days_per_period"
      expr: AVG(CAST(day_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of days per accounting period; validates period consistency for pro-rata earned premium calculations."
    - name: "total_days_in_fiscal_year"
      expr: SUM(CAST(day_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total calendar days across all periods in scope; used to validate annual earned premium pro-ration denominators."
    - name: "distinct_fiscal_years"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year)
      comment: "Number of distinct fiscal years in the calendar; indicates historical depth available for trend and development analysis."
    - name: "distinct_accident_years"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT accident_year)
      comment: "Number of distinct accident years; determines the depth of loss development triangles available for actuarial reserving."
    - name: "distinct_policy_years"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_year)
      comment: "Number of distinct policy years; supports policy-year loss ratio and profitability cohort analysis depth."
    - name: "distinct_naic_reporting_years"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT naic_reporting_year)
      comment: "Number of distinct NAIC reporting years; confirms statutory reporting history depth for Schedule P filings."
$$
metric_views.description: Accounting period and policy year analytics for P&C insurance financial reporting. Grain: one row per calendar period. Supports GAAP, SAP, IFRS17, and NAIC regulatory period slicing.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`shared_currency`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Currency reference analytics for multi-currency P&C insurance operations. Grain: one row per currency version. Supports FX exposure monitoring and currency lifecycle governance."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`shared`.`currency`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "ISO 4217 currency currency_code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP) for grouping premium, loss, and reserve amounts by transaction currency."
    - name: "country_name"
      expr: country_name
      comment: "Country associated with the currency; supports geographic premium and exposure aggregation by country."
    - name: "country_code"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "ISO country code for the currency; used in cross-border reinsurance cession and regulatory reporting segmentation."
    - name: "is_active"
      expr: is_active
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the currency is currently active for new policy and premium transaction booking."
    - name: "is_crypto"
      expr: is_crypto
      comment: "Flag identifying cryptocurrency denominations; relevant for emerging digital asset insurance product lines."
    - name: "is_precious_metal"
      expr: is_precious_metal
      comment: "Flag identifying precious metal denominations; relevant for inland marine and specialty commodity coverage pricing."
    - name: "rounding_method"
      expr: rounding_method
      comment: "Rounding convention applied to premium and loss amounts in this currency; ensures financial statement accuracy."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: effective_date
      comment: "Date from which this currency version is valid; supports point-in-time FX rate and currency rule lookups."
    - name: "expiration_date"
      expr: expiration_date
      comment: "Date on which this currency version expires; used to identify stale currency configurations requiring refresh."
  measures:
    - name: "total_currencies"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of currency records; baseline measure for currency reference data completeness."
    - name: "active_currency_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active currencies; monitors the breadth of multi-currency operations and FX exposure scope."
    - name: "inactive_currency_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = FALSE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of inactive currencies; identifies legacy currency configurations that may need archival or cleanup."
    - name: "distinct_countries_with_currency"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT country_code)
      comment: "Number of distinct countries with defined currencies; measures geographic reach of multi-currency insurance operations."
    - name: "active_currency_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of currency records that are active; monitors currency reference data health and operational readiness."
$$
metric_views.description: Currency reference analytics for multi-currency P&C insurance operations. Grain: one row per currency version. Supports FX exposure monitoring and currency lifecycle governance.

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`_metrics`.`shared_line_of_business`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Line of business portfolio analytics for P&C insurance strategic planning and profitability management. Grain: one row per line of business version. Drives underwriting strategy, pricing targets, and reinsurance decisions."
  source: "`vibe_pc_insurance_blog_v499`.`shared`.`line_of_business`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "lob_name"
      expr: lob_name
      comment: "Full line of business name (e.g., Personal Auto, Homeowners, Commercial GL) for executive portfolio reporting."
    - name: "lob_code"
      expr: lob_code
      comment: "Internal LOB code for system-level grouping of policies, premiums, and claims by line."
    - name: "lob_abbreviation"
      expr: lob_abbreviation
      comment: "Short LOB abbreviation for dashboard labels and regulatory filing line identifiers."
    - name: "lob_category"
      expr: lob_category
      comment: "High-level LOB category (Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, Specialty) for portfolio-level combined ratio analysis."
    - name: "lob_type"
      expr: lob_type
      comment: "LOB type classification (Property, Liability, Auto, Workers Comp) for cross-line exposure aggregation."
    - name: "line_of_business_status"
      expr: line_of_business_status
      comment: "Active or inactive status of the LOB; identifies lines being grown, maintained, or exited in the portfolio."
    - name: "is_admitted"
      expr: is_admitted
      comment: "Flag indicating admitted vs. non-admitted paper; drives regulatory filing requirements and rate/form compliance."
    - name: "is_surplus_lines"
      expr: is_surplus_lines
      comment: "Flag identifying surplus lines business; relevant for E&S market strategy and surplus lines tax reporting."
    - name: "catastrophe_exposed"
      expr: catastrophe_exposed
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the LOB carries catastrophe exposure; drives reinsurance purchasing and CAT model prioritization."
    - name: "reinsurance_treaty_applicable"
      expr: reinsurance_treaty_applicable
      comment: "Flag indicating whether a reinsurance treaty applies to this LOB; used in cession calculation and net retention reporting."
    - name: "requires_state_filing"
      expr: requires_state_filing
      comment: "Flag indicating state rate and form filing requirements; monitors regulatory compliance obligations by line."
    - name: "supports_package_policy"
      expr: supports_package_policy
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the LOB can be packaged with other lines; supports multi-line policy bundling strategy."
    - name: "naic_line_code"
      expr: naic_line_code
      comment: "NAIC statutory line code for Schedule P and Annual Statement line-of-business reporting alignment."
    - name: "iso_line_code"
      expr: iso_line_code
      comment: "ISO line code for industry benchmarking, loss cost filings, and actuarial industry data comparisons."
    - name: "schedule_p_line_number"
      expr: schedule_p_line_number
      comment: "NAIC Schedule P line number for statutory loss development triangle reporting and reserve adequacy disclosure."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: effective_date
      comment: "Date from which this LOB configuration is effective; supports point-in-time LOB attribute lookups."
    - name: "expiration_date"
      expr: expiration_date
      comment: "Date on which this LOB configuration expires; identifies LOBs with pending configuration changes."
    - name: "default_policy_term_months"
      expr: default_policy_term_months
      comment: "Standard policy term length in months for this LOB; used in earned premium pro-ration and renewal cycle planning."
  measures:
    - name: "total_lines_of_business"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of lines of business defined; baseline measure for portfolio breadth and product catalog completeness."
    - name: "active_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN line_of_business_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active lines of business; measures the active product portfolio size for strategic planning."
    - name: "catastrophe_exposed_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN catastrophe_exposed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of LOBs with catastrophe exposure; drives reinsurance purchasing strategy and CAT model investment decisions."
    - name: "reinsurance_treaty_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reinsurance_treaty_applicable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of LOBs covered by reinsurance treaties; monitors treaty coverage breadth and net retention exposure."
    - name: "surplus_lines_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_surplus_lines = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of surplus lines LOBs; tracks E&S market participation and associated surplus lines tax obligations."
    - name: "admitted_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_admitted = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of admitted LOBs; measures the admitted paper portfolio subject to state rate and form filing requirements."
    - name: "avg_loss_ratio_target_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(loss_ratio_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target loss ratio across all LOBs; benchmarks underwriting profitability expectations for portfolio planning."
    - name: "avg_expense_ratio_target_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(expense_ratio_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target expense ratio across all LOBs; benchmarks operational efficiency expectations for cost management."
    - name: "avg_combined_ratio_target_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(combined_ratio_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target combined ratio across all LOBs; the primary P&C underwriting profitability benchmark for executive steering."
    - name: "avg_default_commission_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(default_commission_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average default producer commission rate across LOBs; informs distribution cost management and commission adequacy review."
    - name: "avg_minimum_premium_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(minimum_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average minimum premium floor across LOBs; monitors pricing floor adequacy relative to expense and loss cost levels."
    - name: "total_minimum_premium_floor"
      expr: SUM(CAST(minimum_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of minimum premium floors across all LOBs; indicates aggregate minimum revenue floor for the full product portfolio."
    - name: "max_combined_ratio_target_pct"
      expr: MAX(CAST(combined_ratio_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Highest combined ratio target across LOBs; identifies the least profitable line by underwriting target for strategic review."
    - name: "min_combined_ratio_target_pct"
      expr: MIN(CAST(combined_ratio_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Lowest combined ratio target across LOBs; identifies the most profitable line by underwriting target for capital allocation."
    - name: "catastrophe_exposed_lob_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN catastrophe_exposed = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of LOBs with catastrophe exposure; measures CAT concentration risk in the product portfolio."
    - name: "reinsurance_treaty_coverage_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN reinsurance_treaty_applicable = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of LOBs covered by reinsurance treaties; monitors treaty protection breadth across the product portfolio."
    - name: "avg_default_policy_term_months"
      expr: AVG(CAST(default_policy_term_months AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average default policy term length in months; informs renewal cycle planning and unearned premium reserve duration."
    - name: "distinct_lob_categories"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT lob_category)
      comment: "Number of distinct LOB categories (Personal, Commercial, Specialty); measures portfolio diversification breadth."
    - name: "state_filing_required_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN requires_state_filing = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of LOBs requiring state rate and form filings; drives regulatory compliance workload and filing calendar management."
    - name: "package_policy_eligible_lob_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN supports_package_policy = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of LOBs eligible for package policy bundling; informs cross-sell strategy and multi-line discount program design."
$$
metric_views.description: Line of business portfolio analytics for P&C insurance strategic planning and profitability management. Grain: one row per line of business version. Drives underwriting strategy, pricing targets, and reinsurance decisions.
